gist: Standard channel disclaimer: no promotion of drugs, alcohol or intoxicants, content is for information and education, community guidelines followed, viewers asked to watch with care.
Greeting and thanks to everyone for joining the class.
Says today they will see whether last week's class can be completed, and that only God knows whether it will be.
Mock self-talk: what nonsense is this Brajesh Gautam making them listen to; he is used like a vessel and someone inside him is speaking through him.
Says many things come out that he himself does not know, and tells listeners to always give the command that begins 'I know everything'.
Completes the command: I know everything but do not know that I know; so from now on assume that someone inside him knows it all.
Says a thin membrane separates the realm of knowing from the 'I'; whoever learns to open it can search the Akashic records and know everything.
Says otherwise such a person meets someone who tells him directly, and the whole key to opening the records lies here.
Says we are realising things through fire, water and air, which we already know, and everything will strike somewhere.
Recap: last week's lesson finished up to Mercury and all is fine, so the class goes on.

hindi: आगे हम ले रहे हैं बृहस्पति बृहस्पति की राशि थी राशि नंबर नौ
says: The next planet of the series is Jupiter, and he gives Jupiter's sign as number 9, Sagittarius. He names only this sign for Jupiter here and not Pisces.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in its own sign Sagittarius reads differently by house, since the house sets which life area its strength serves and the lagna sets its lordships.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 1st (Sagittarius lagna). Own sign on the self house, with Jupiter ruling the 1st and 4th.
Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo, since 9 minus 4 plus 1 = 6). Own sign in the home house, with Jupiter ruling the 4th and 7th.
Derived: Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 10th (lagna Pisces, since 9 minus 10 plus 1 = 0 which is 12). Own sign in the career house, with Jupiter ruling the 1st and 10th.

ambiguity: 'राशि नंबर नौ' is taken as the sign number, Sagittarius; Pisces, also Jupiter's sign, is not mentioned in this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Sagittarius is Jupiter's own sign, and Pisces is the other.

hindi: यह राशि नंबर नौ बृहस्पति हमारे घर का नॉर्थ ईस्ट कंट्रोल करता है
says: Jupiter governs the north-east part of the home. This is a vastu link: the north-east corner is Jupiter's direction.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether the north-east link belongs to the planet or specifically to sign 9; I take it as the planet's rule.
classical_check: Agrees with the common vastu rule that the north-east (Ishanya) belongs to Jupiter; some texts give it to Ketu or Shiva.

hindi: बृहस्पति गुरु ग्रह है सबसे बड़ा ग्रह यानी हमारे जीवन के सारे चुंबकीय क्षेत्र सारे इसके पास है
says: Jupiter, the guru planet, is the biggest planet, so all the magnetic fields of our life are in its keeping. He makes Jupiter the planet of magnetic or attractive force in life.
ambiguity: 'Magnetic field' is used loosely for attractive force in a person's life.
classical_check: Jupiter is the largest planet and the classical karaka of guidance and expansion; the magnetic-field claim is his own.

hindi: जो गुरुत्वाकर्षण शब्द बना है गुरु त्व
says: The word gurutvakarshan (gravity) is built on guru, which he splits as guru-tva and 'your attraction'. So gravity and magnetism in life are Jupiter's department.
ambiguity: The sentence is split by the chunk edge; the word-play 'तेरा आकर्षण' is a folk etymology, not a proper derivation.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not derive gravity from guru; the link is his own word-play.

hindi: जब भी किसी व्यक्ति के पास चुंबक अच्छी होती है बॉडी के अंदर उसकी हड्डियां जमी रहती हैं और जब चुंबक ढीली होती है
says: A person with a good Jupiter magnet keeps firm bones, and when the magnet loosens the body's hold loosens. This is his tradition-claim link between Jupiter's strength and bone firmness, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off and continues into the next clause; the body-part link is stated loosely.
classical_check: Classical texts give Jupiter fat, liver and thighs, not bones; Saturn is the usual karaka of bones, so this differs.

hindi: यानी गुरु के ग्रह गुरु ग्रह के अंतर्गत हम पावर पकड़ते हैं तो ये चुंबक ढीला हो जाता है
says: When we take on power or authority under Jupiter's domain, the magnet is said to loosen. The caption is garbled, and the sense seems to be that grabbing power weakens Jupiter's pull.
ambiguity: Could mean that clinging to power loosens the magnet, or that power loosens the bones; I cannot tell which.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो गुरु ग्रह जो है इस ग्रह का जो स्वरूप है वो एक बूढ़ा ब्राह्मण दिखाया है कि ज्ञानी है ना क्योंकि संत साधु के समान बहुत परम ज्ञानी है
says: The form given to Jupiter is that of an old Brahmin, because he is learned like a saint or sadhu and a supreme knower. The personification stresses wisdom and age.
classical_check: Agrees with classical personification: Jupiter is a Brahmin, preceptor of the gods.

hindi: यह बूढ़ा ब्राह्मण है जिसकी सफेद दाढ़ी है सफेद बाल है और थोड़ा सा पेट निकला हुआ है
says: This old Brahmin is pictured with a white beard, white hair and a slightly protruding belly. It is the physical image he gives for Jupiter.
classical_check: Classical descriptions of Jupiter give a large body, yellowish tawny eyes and hair, and a stout build; the white beard is his own image.

hindi: वह ज्ञान ही बांच होता है सारे समय प्रोटेक्शन देता है
says: Jupiter is always dispensing knowledge and at all times gives protection. He makes protection a standing function of the planet alongside teaching.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the protector and counsellor among planets.

hindi: एक पूरे गांव का मुखिया जो है वह गुरु के समान होगा यानी जो सारे घर को संभालने वाले बड़े-बड़े दादाजी हैं बूढ़े उस वो गुरु ग्रह के समान है
says: The head of a whole village is like Jupiter, and so are the elderly grandfathers who hold a whole household together. People who head and protect a group are Jupiter figures in real life.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter signifies elders and community heads; Saturn is also linked with old age.

hindi: तो ऐसे व्यक्ति को यदि आप प्रणाम भी करते हैं तो आपका गुरु प्रसन्न होता है
says: If you simply bow to such an elder figure, your own Jupiter is pleased. Respectful greeting of elders is a simple remedy that strengthens Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'आपका गुरु' means your Jupiter, the planet, not your personal teacher.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard remedy of serving elders, teachers and Brahmins for Jupiter.

gist: Asks the rhetorical question how it can be that a bow pleases the planet, and says it is a strange thing.
Argument begins: chemical reactions start in your body when you merely see something, for example a lemon.
Says the eyes see a lemon and the mouth waters; even a lemon lying there has an effect on you.
More examples: the sight of a sword affects the mind, hearing an insult brings enzymes into the body, and a bad smell has effects.
Says if you catch sight of blood from the corner of the eye you react at once.

hindi: तो सोच के चलिए कि ऐसी नहीं हो सकता है कि दूर बैठे ग्रह ऐसी वाइब्रेशन दे रहे हैं जिनका असर हो रहा है
says: By that reasoning, he asks you to accept that distant planets can send vibrations that really have an effect on us. His argument for planetary influence is that small sights already affect the body, so remote bodies can too.
ambiguity: The caption reads 'ऐसी नहीं हो सकता' which I take as 'it is not impossible'.
classical_check: Classical texts assert planetary influence without such an argument; the vibration analogy is his own and not testable here.

gist: Says the TV works on wifi, with only frequencies and vibrations in the air and nothing else visible.

hindi: तो क्या दूर बैठे रंग राहु मंगल केतु बुध बृहस्पति से हम कनेक्टेड नहीं है 101 पर कनेक्टेड है
says: If a home router can connect us to unknown places, then we are surely connected to the far planets such as Rahu, Mars, Ketu, Mercury and Jupiter; he says 101 percent connected. Planetary connection is asserted as certain.
ambiguity: The caption has a stray word 'रंग' before Rahu, perhaps a planet name like Saturn, so the list may be longer than shown.
classical_check: Silent; this is an argument by analogy, not a classical rule.

gist: Says we affect someone far away just by looking at him, and if you avoid someone he will notice and you want to run; a light remark on gaze.

hindi: यह ग्रह पूर्ण असर देते हैं
says: These planets give their full effect on us. He concludes that planetary influence is complete and not weak.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge; 'देते हैं' continues in the next chunk. The word 'पूर्ण' could also mean 'complete' in the sense of whole.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह गुरु ग्रह है मुख्य यह हमारे शरीर का और दिमाग का मुखिया है जो हमारी खोपड़ी को गवर्न करता है कि हम सोचेंगे क्या
says: Jupiter is the chief of our body and mind and governs the skull, that is, what we will think. He assigns the thinking head and the mind's direction to Jupiter.
classical_check: Classical texts link Jupiter with wisdom and the intellect, but the head and skull are usually given to the Sun and to Aries; the skull link is his own.

hindi: यदि यही ग्रह नेगेटिव हो जाए तो हम ज्ञान से विरुद्ध हो जाते हैं
says: If this planet turns negative in the chart, the person becomes opposed to knowledge. An afflicted Jupiter makes one hostile to learning and wisdom.
ambiguity: 'Negative' is not defined here; the next sentences define it as bad placement or combustion.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: afflicted Jupiter is said to give poor judgement and contempt for teachers.

hindi: जितने लोगों के जुपिटर में बृहस्पति में दोष है यानी कि वो दूषित जगह पड़ा है या अस्त है
says: A fault in Jupiter means it is placed in a spoiled place or is combust. These are the two ways of calling Jupiter faulty here.
cells_derived_method: A spoiled place is read from the house (dusthana or enemy house) and the sign (debilitation or an enemy sign); combustion is read from nearness to the Sun.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 6th (lagna Leo, since 10 minus 6 plus 1 = 5). A bad sign in a trouble house: a clear 'spoiled place'.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 12th (lagna Cancer, since 3 minus 12 plus 1 = -8 which is 4). Mercury's sign, an enemy, in the loss house: a spoiled place.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio, since 4 minus 9 plus 1 = -4 which is 8). Not spoiled in sign or house; only combustion could still spoil it.

ambiguity: 'दूषित जगह' is not defined; I read it as a bad house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees with the standard view that debilitation, enemy signs, dusthana placement and combustion weaken a planet.

hindi: अस्त का मतलब सूर्य के साथ उसकी डिग्री इतनी कम हो गई है कि सूर्य की चमक के आगे फीका पड़ गया है
says: Combustion (ast) means the planet is so close to the Sun in degrees that it fades before the Sun's brightness. He gives no orb number, only the idea of small distance in degrees.
cells_derived_method: Combustion needs Jupiter and the Sun in the same sign or an adjacent one with a small degree gap, so the house and sign of Jupiter equal the Sun's.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter and the Sun together in Aries in the 10th (lagna Cancer, since 1 minus 10 plus 1 = -8 which is 4). Combustion would dim Jupiter's 6th and 9th house matters in the career house.
Derived: Jupiter with the Sun in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries, since 5 minus 5 plus 1 = 1). Combustion would dim Jupiter's 9th and 12th matters in the children and learning house.

ambiguity: 'डिग्री इतनी कम हो गई' could mean degree separation is small, which is the standard meaning; no number is given.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical combustion rule; classical texts give Jupiter's orb as about 11 degrees from the Sun.

gist: Repeats that the Sun is a terrible blaze of light so great that Jupiter cannot be seen, that is, the guru cannot be seen.
Story: a guru comes to a maharaja and the maharaja touches his feet, but when the maharaja himself arrives the whole assembly stands up.

hindi: लेकिन जब राजा आया तो ओ माय गॉड छा गए वो गुरु को भी खा गया थोड़ी देर के लिए
says: When the king arrives he outshines everyone and for a while swallows even the guru. So the Sun, the king, overshadows Jupiter, the guru, when they are together, and this is combustion.
ambiguity: The story is an analogy; the actual rule it illustrates is the combustion definition just given.
classical_check: Agrees with the Sun as king and Jupiter as guru, and with combustion as the Sun's overpowering of the planet.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति अस्त हो जाता है वकृत्व हो जाता है इसमें या ग्रहों का राशि तालमेल गड़बड़ होता है या राशि बुरी में बैठ जाता है
says: Jupiter goes wrong when it is combust, when it is retrograde, when its mix with other planets and signs is off, or when it sits in a bad sign. These are his listed ways Jupiter gets spoiled.
cells_derived_method: Each cause is read per cell: combustion by the Sun's presence, retrogression by motion, sign mismatch by the planets sharing the sign, and a bad sign by dignity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 3rd (lagna Scorpio, since 10 minus 3 plus 1 = 8). Jupiter rules the 2nd and 5th; a bad sign case.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 8th (lagna Libra, since 2 minus 8 plus 1 = -5 which is 7). Venus's sign, an enemy, in the obstruction house; Jupiter rules the 3rd and 6th.

ambiguity: 'वकृत्व' is garbled and is probably 'वक्री' (retrograde).
classical_check: Differs on retrograde: classical texts treat a retrograde Jupiter as strong in motion (cheshta bala), not as a spoiled state.

hindi: तो यह बृहस्पति के गड़बड़ होने वाले व्यक्ति भयंकर बहस करते हैं
says: People whose Jupiter is spoiled argue fiercely. A bad Jupiter shows up as quarrelsome debating.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts speak of poor judgement and arrogance for afflicted Jupiter, but not of debating.

hindi: इनको कन्विंसिबल जो किसी भी बात पर गुस्सा कर सकता है एक सेकंड में अहंकार लड़ाका बन सकता है किसी भी बात पर टीटा पाड़ कर सकता है
says: Such people are hard to convince, can get angry over anything and turn into ego-driven fighters in a second, and can make a fuss about any matter. These are the temperament traits he gives to a spoiled Jupiter.
ambiguity: 'कन्विंसिबल' is probably 'कन्विंस करना मुश्किल' or 'not convincible'; the caption is garbled. 'टीटा पाड़' is slang for making a scene.
classical_check: Agrees loosely: afflicted Jupiter is said to give ego and obstinacy.

hindi: उसका जुपिटर भ्रष्ट उसको किसी तरह से भी किसी ना किसी बड़े महाराज को चरण पकड़ के पूजने चाहिए
says: Whoever has a corrupted Jupiter should somehow take hold of the feet of some great maharaj and worship him. The remedy is humble reverence to a great teacher.
ambiguity: 'भ्रष्ट' means corrupted, here the same as spoiled by combustion or placement.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical remedy of honouring teachers for Jupiter; it differs from his warning in an earlier lecture of this series that guru worship harms when Jupiter is debilitated.

hindi: अच्छा वो पूजे का है ही नहीं क्योंकि वो तो ऑलरेडी गुरु है
says: But such a person will not do it, because he already thinks he is a guru himself. A spoiled Jupiter brings the pride of being the teacher, which blocks the remedy.
ambiguity: The caption 'पूजे का है ही नहीं' is garbled; I read it as 'will not worship'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्तियों के लिए पुखराज इत्यादि पहनाए जाते हैं और कुछ उपाय होते हैं वो बातें उपाय के टाइम पर हम करेंगे
says: For such people yellow sapphire and similar gems are prescribed, and there are other remedies that he will take up when the remedy section comes. So gem remedy for a spoiled Jupiter is named but not detailed.
classical_check: Agrees: yellow sapphire (pukhraj) is the classical gem for Jupiter, with the usual caution about choosing it by lordship.

hindi: यह बृहस्पति जब राजा के यहां जाता है पांच नंबर में लाजवाब फल देता है यानी कुंडली में पांच नंबर राशि का यदि बृहस्पति होगा तो बहुत बढ़िया फल है
says: When Jupiter goes to the king's house, sign number 5 (Leo, the Sun's sign), it gives excellent results. So Jupiter in Leo is a very good placement in a chart.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Leo is good in any house, with the house deciding the life area and the lagna deciding the lordships it carries.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 5th (lagna Aries). Jupiter rules the 9th and 12th and sits in the house of learning and children, a strong placement.
Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 9th (lagna Sagittarius, since 5 minus 9 plus 1 = -3 which is 9). Jupiter is lagna lord and 4th lord, in the fortune house.
Derived: Jupiter in Leo in the 8th (lagna Capricorn, since 5 minus 8 plus 1 = -2 which is 10). Jupiter rules the 3rd and 12th and sits in the obstruction house, so the sign help is partly offset.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर' is taken as sign 5, Leo, because he says राशि and 'राजा के यहां' fits the Sun's sign.
classical_check: Agrees in general: Leo is the sign of Jupiter's friend the Sun, so Jupiter does well there, though it is not exalted.

hindi: यह गुरु जी है गुरुजी जब परिवार में जाते है राजा के यहां तो यह राजा की पत्नी है यह ज्ञान जल के समान होता है
says: Using the allegory of the guru visiting the king's family, he introduces the king's wife and says knowledge is like water. This points to a water-sign figure, probably the Moon's sign Cancer, as the queen who receives Jupiter.
ambiguity: He does not name the sign here; the water image and the sign number 4 two sentences later suggest Cancer, but that is my reading.
classical_check: Silent: the king-and-queen allegory is his own; the Moon as queen and Cancer as a water sign are standard.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति धरती पर सबसे बड़ा फल देता है जब चार नंबर राशि का हो
says: Jupiter gives the greatest result on earth when it is in sign number 4, Cancer. When the queen honours the guru, the king is not even needed, which is his image for Jupiter's peak strength in Cancer.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter exalted in Cancer is strong in every house, and the house sets which area benefits: self, children, fortune and so on, while the lagna sets which lordships carry the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 1st (Cancer lagna). Jupiter rules the 6th and 9th and lifts the self and health, with fortune support.
Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 5th (lagna Pisces, since 4 minus 5 plus 1 = 0 which is 12). Jupiter is lagna lord and 10th lord, strong for children, learning and career.

Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 9th (lagna Scorpio, since 4 minus 9 plus 1 = -4 which is 8). Jupiter rules the 2nd and 5th and sits in the fortune house, a strong wealth and dharma placement.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर राशि' is taken as the sign number, Cancer, which matches Jupiter's exaltation.
classical_check: Agrees: Cancer is Jupiter's exaltation sign, where it is strongest.

gist: Final fragment 'यानी आप गुरु को जब' is cut off at the end of the slice, so the sentence cannot be read.

hindi: जल देते हैं तो गुरु प्रसन्न होता है
says: Offering water is said to please Jupiter (guru); water is the substance that Jupiter responds to, so a water offering is treated as a Jupiter remedy.
cells_derived_method: none: a planet-level remedy, not dependent on house or sign. Only the choice of when to do it would depend on Jupiter's house and dignity.
ambiguity: Does not say which kind of water offering (to the sun, to ancestors, to Shiva); the next sentences give ancestors as the example.
classical_check: Classical texts give Jupiter a Thursday, yellow, turmeric, gold type of remedy set; water offering as a Jupiter remedy is not a standard classical item, so mostly silent.

hindi: आपने देखा होगा पितरों को जल देते हैं हमारे पितरों की पूजा की जाती है तो पितरों के लिए होता है तर्प यामी ऐसे तर्पण इत्यादि देते हैं
says: He points to the familiar custom of offering water (tarpan) to ancestors and uses it as the proof that ancestor worship belongs to Jupiter's department.
cells_derived_method: none: custom-level statement. Houses linked to ancestors in the tradition (9th for father and lineage, 4th for mother side) would decide whose tarpan matters, but he does not say this here.
ambiguity: 'तर्प यामी' in the caption is a garble of tarpan; meaning is clear from context.
classical_check: Tarpan is a Vedic ritual; classical Jyotish links ancestors (pitri) mainly to the Sun, 9th house and Rahu or Ketu in pitri dosha, with Jupiter as the 9th-house natural karaka. So partly agrees.

hindi: जो भी पितरों की पूजा की जाती है पित मींस हमारे डीएनए डीएनए मींस जो सेक्सुअल रिलेशनशिप के साथ हमारे परिवार में आ गया अनुवांशिक पीढ़ियां चलती चली गई वो पितर बन गए जो गुजर गए
says: He defines pitar (ancestors) as our DNA: the hereditary material that came into the family through sexual relationships and passed down generations; those who have died become pitar but their DNA is still inside us.
cells_derived_method: none: a definition of what ancestors mean, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence does not yet name Jupiter; the link to Jupiter comes in the following sentences.
classical_check: Classical texts describe pitri as departed forefathers and the lineage line; the DNA framing is his modern reading and is not in any classical text.

hindi: उन सब पितरों की जो पूजा की जाती है उसके अंदर इस उंगली से टीका नहीं लगाते यह सूर्य की उंगली है
says: In ancestor worship the tilak is not applied with the finger he is showing, which is the Sun's finger (ring finger); the Sun finger is kept out of the pitar rite.
cells_derived_method: none: ritual finger rule, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: He is pointing at a finger on camera, so the caption cannot say which finger; 'Sun's finger' is the ring finger in palmistry. The sentence is slightly garbled; later he says the pitar tilak is made with the index finger (Jupiter), which supports this reading.
classical_check: Tilak finger rules for pitri karma (index finger or thumb in some texts) are ritual-tradition, not Jyotish classics; silent.

hindi: पमिस्ट की बात होगी तोय सूर्य की है बुध की है यह शनि की है
says: Moving to palmistry: each finger belongs to a planet, with the ring finger for the Sun, the little finger for Mercury and the middle finger for Saturn (the index finger being Jupiter's, shown later).
cells_derived_method: none: a planet to finger mapping, not house or sign dependent.
ambiguity: Which finger each planet gets is inferred from standard palmistry because he is pointing on camera; caption is garbled ('तोय').
classical_check: Agrees with standard Hindu palmistry: index Jupiter, middle Saturn, ring Sun, little Mercury.

hindi: क्योंकि हमारा जो मेडुला ऑफ लंगटा है थर्ड आई के पीछे यहां पीछे पड़ता है ये ब्रह्म रंद्र यहां छ छ छत पर है हमारे और ये पिछले बालकनी में ये वेस्ट एरिया है
says: Using a house as a metaphor for the head: the medulla lies behind the third eye, the brahmarandhra is on the roof and the back of the head is the rear balcony, which is the west area.
cells_derived_method: none: a body to vastu direction map, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'पिछली बालकनी' (rear balcony) is a metaphor for the back of the skull; 'रंद्र' is brahmarandhra.
classical_check: Silent: this is a vastu purusha style mapping of the head; not a Jyotish text rule.

hindi: यहां ईस्ट से सूरज निकला ये वेस्ट में गया ये एरिया है जहां हमारा पॉन्स होते हैं जहां से हमारे अब ये साइंटिफिक बात है जहां से हमारा पूरा का पूरा स्पाइनल कॉर्ड बनता है
says: The sun rises in the east and goes to the west, and the west region of the head is where the pons sits and where the whole spinal cord originates; he marks the west of the head as the origin of the nervous system.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence is long and the 'जहां से हमारे' phrase is broken in the caption.
classical_check: Silent: anatomical statement by him.

hindi: और जहां सेरेब्रो स्पाइनल फ्लूइड लिक्विफिकेशन करता है सारा ग्रीसिया तो खोपड़ा यही है भगवान यही है
says: The cerebrospinal fluid does its liquefying work in this same west part, which he calls the real skull and the place of God; so the divine seat is the rear of the head.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'सारा ग्रीसिया' is an unreadable word in the caption; the main sense is that the fluid-producing region is the God place.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यही वेस्ट के अंदर आपके ईश्वर रखे जाते हैं हर मंदिर के अंदर चाहे वह किसी भी धर्म के हो किसी भी धर्म के भगवानों को देवताओं को वेस्ट में रखा हुआ हर मंदिरों में
says: Deities are placed on the west side inside every temple, whatever the religion, because west is the seat of the divine in the head-house map; a vastu rule he derives from the body map.
cells_derived_method: none: a vastu placement claim, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: He means the idol sits at the west wall of the temple facing east; in the caption he only says 'west'.
classical_check: Partly agrees with vastu: idols face east or west by tradition, and the deity wall is often the west wall of the sanctum. Not stated in Jyotish classics.

gist: He says the people who made these rules were scientists, not religion, and that is why they keep it in this place.

hindi: यही बृहस्पति जल जब जलाभिषेक करते हैं तो जुपिटर का सारा काम होता है
says: When water is poured on the deity in jalabhishek, all of Jupiter's work is done, so the water offering is the practical Jupiter remedy.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: classically jalabhishek is Moon or Shiva worship; assigning it to Jupiter is his own link.

hindi: शिवजी क्या है चंद्रमा इस पर क्लास की हुई है पहले
says: Shiva is the Moon in his scheme, and he reminds the audience that a class on this was already given earlier in the series.
cells_derived_method: none: deity to planet mapping, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the Moon is associated with Shiva (Chandrashekhara) in the tradition, though classical deity-planet lists give Shiva for the Sun in some texts and for the Moon in others.

hindi: हमने यानी कि जुपिटर को समर्पित करते हैं अहंकार समर्पित करते हैं प्रेम से चलते हैं इस य सबसे बढ़िया फल देता है
says: We dedicate to Jupiter, meaning we surrender the ego and proceed with love, and that attitude gives the best result; surrender of ego is the working remedy.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: Words 'इस य' are broken; sense is that surrender with love gives the best fruit.
classical_check: Silent: ego surrender as a remedy is a general spiritual idea, not Jyotish.

hindi: अब यही जुपिटर यही बृहस्पति ज्ञान आग की तरह भकता है जब सेनापति के पास जाता है यही सेनापति भी है
says: When Jupiter goes near the commander (Mars), its knowledge flares up like fire, and Jupiter is itself also a commander; Jupiter plus Mars gives fiery, forceful knowledge.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter with Mars (conjunction or aspect) turns knowledge into action; the effect depends on the house and sign of the combination. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter with Mars in the 10th in Mars's own sign; knowledge turned into commanding career action.
Derived: both planets in Capricorn in the 4th. Mars is at full strength there. Jupiter is at its weakest; mixed, the fire is strong but the knowledge side is strained.
Derived: Jupiter with Mars in the 2nd in Scorpio; forceful, argumentative speech used to teach or advise.

ambiguity: 'सेनापति' here is the commander planet Mars; 'यही सेनापति भी है' (this one is also a commander) is unclear: it may mean Jupiter is also the army chief, in the sense of a counsellor.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter and Mars are natural friends and their conjunction (Guru-Mangala yoga) is considered energetic and beneficial for action and learning.

hindi: यह सेनापति राजा यह मां भी है राजा की पत्नी मान के चले यह बिटिया है बहन बुआ बेटी
says: Jupiter's family roles: commander or king, and also the mother, the king's wife, the daughter, the sister and the father's sister; Jupiter is the planet of the senior woman in the family and of the female blood relatives.
cells_derived_method: Which relative is meant shows by house: the 4th for mother, the 3rd and 11th for sisters, the 5th for daughter, the 7th for wife. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter exalted in Cancer in the 4th, mother-related house; the mother figure is strong and protective.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 7th; the wife or female partner side is strained, in his female-relatives reading.

ambiguity: The list mixes male roles (commander, king) and female roles; it is read as a list of relatives Jupiter can stand for.
classical_check: Differs: classically Jupiter is karaka of husband (for a woman's chart), sons and elders; female relatives are assigned mostly to Venus and the Moon.

hindi: यही बृहस्पति ज्ञान अग्नि के तौर पर धधक है क्योंकि आपका जो सूर्य है व यही प्लेस यही अग्नि है
says: Jupiter's knowledge burns as fire, because the Sun's place and the fire element are at the same location in his map; so Jupiter's knowledge is tied to the Sun's fire.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'यही प्लेस' means the same place in the body map; the caption is run-on.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter and Sun are natural friends and both lean toward fire and light; 'Jupiter as fire' is not classical.

hindi: बृहस्पति ही आपके जीवन में ज्ञान देता है
says: It is Jupiter alone who gives knowledge in your life; he restates the Jupiter equals knowledge karaka as a plain rule.
cells_derived_method: Knowledge shows through the 4th and 5th houses and Jupiter's dignity; Jupiter in the 5th Cancer or Sagittarius is a standard strong-learning pattern.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 5th gives teaching and higher knowledge as a theme.
Derived: Jupiter in the 12th in Gemini, an unfriendly sign; learning is scattered and may be gained away from home.

classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the main significator of knowledge and wisdom (jnana karaka).

hindi: मंगल नाभि पर है यह धधक होता है तो बृहस्पति ग्रह जब सेनापति के पास भी जाता है तो भी प्रणाम ही करता है उसे
says: Mars sits at the navel and is blazing; when Jupiter goes to the commander Mars it still respectfully bows to him, so Jupiter stays courteous toward Mars.
cells_derived_method: none: body location plus attitude, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Navel for Mars is not classical (Mars rules marrow, blood and the upper abdomen). The friendly attitude agrees with the natural friendship of Jupiter and Mars.

hindi: वो कहता है आइए महाराज बैठिए कोई दिक्कत नहीं है यह मंगल से भी पूर्ण मित्रता है एक नंबर का बृहस्पति भी बहुत बढ़िया है
says: Jupiter greets Mars with respect and offers him a seat, because the two have complete friendship, and the Jupiter with Mars is very good; a clear statement that Jupiter and Mars are fully friendly.
cells_derived_method: A Jupiter-Mars relation reads good in most places; house sets the topic: 10th career action, 4th property and home, 9th dharma and luck. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 9th with Mars aspecting from a friendly angle; fortune is backed by energy.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 10th with Jupiter joined; strong leadership career pattern.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 6th with Jupiter joined; victory over rivals and competitive skills.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is a natural friend of Jupiter in Parashara's table.

hindi: बृहस्पति या बुध के जाता है हवा ज्ञान हवा में यदि ज्ञान हवा में घुल जाता है तो आधा अधूरा सा फल देता है यानी हवा में ज्ञान भी है और हवा में घुल भी गया
says: When Jupiter goes to Mercury, who is air, the knowledge dissolves into the air and so gives only a half-finished result: there is knowledge, but it gets lost in the wind.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter joined or aspected by Mercury yields partial results; the topic follows the house: 3rd and 5th about writing and teaching, 7th about trade and partnership. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Mercury's sign in the 3rd; much talking and writing, with scattered or incomplete results.
Derived: Jupiter in Virgo (Mercury's sign) in the 7th, a kendra: knowledge applied to dealing and analysis but fault-finding and diluted.
Derived: Jupiter in his own sign Sagittarius in the 5th with Mercury joined: knowledge holds since the sign is Jupiter's, so the 'half result' is lessened.

ambiguity: Mercury is not named but read from 'बुध'; 'हवा' (air) is his element for Mercury.
classical_check: Differs partly: in Parashara's table Mercury is an enemy of Jupiter, which agrees with a weak outcome; Mercury as air agrees with classical elements (Mercury is earth in some texts and air in others).

hindi: अब बृहस्पति जो है यह बहन बुआ बेटी साली अक्सर बहन बुआ बेटी साली यानी
says: Jupiter signifies the sister, the father's sister, the daughter and the wife's sister, which he repeats; the sentence is cut off at the end of the slice.
cells_derived_method: Which relative shows is by the house: 3rd and 11th for sisters, 5th for daughter, 7th for wife and her sister. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 3rd; the sister bond is supportive and she is learned.
Derived: Jupiter in the 11th in Saturn's sign; older sister relation is dutiful but cool.

ambiguity: The sentence ends with 'यानी' and the continuation is in the next batch.
classical_check: Differs: classics give Jupiter elder brothers and sons; sisters are mainly Mercury or Venus.

gist: A social remark that women were kept away from knowledge on the logic that learning would make trouble for the household.
Retells the Puranic story that the Moon ran away with Jupiter's wife as the backstory for the Jupiter-Mercury relation.
Sarcastic remark that the Puranas made sweet stories with no head or feet.

hindi: अब चंद्रमा को व्यक्ति बना दिया बृहस्पति को कोई व्यक्ति बना दिया तो बृहस्पति की पत्नी को चंद्रमा भगा के लेगा क्यों
says: His reading of the myth: the Puranas turned planets (principles) into persons, and only then does a story of the Moon abducting Jupiter's wife make sense; he asks why a planet would do such a thing, meaning the story is a personification and the planets should be read as forces.
cells_derived_method: none: an interpretive stance on the myths, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Silent in Jyotish. Puranic Tara-Soma story is in Vishnu and Bhagavata Puranas; the astrological text tradition does not use it for calculation.

hindi: चंद्रमा महा कामुक है मुन्ना है ये यह छेड़खानी करता है वासना ही वासना है कई स्वरूप चलते यह भी है यह भी है यह भी
says: He calls the Moon highly lustful and flirty, full of desire, with many forms in which this shows; the Moon carries a strong desire and teasing nature in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Desire strength reads from the Moon's sign and house: the Moon in the 5th, 7th or 12th or in Venus's or Mars's signs carries this more. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon exalted in Taurus (Venus's sign) in the 5th; romance and pleasure themes at full strength.
Derived: Moon debilitated in Scorpio in the 12th; intense and secret desires, hidden affairs in the tradition.
Derived: Moon in its own sign in the 10th; emotional rather than sensual, so the desire nature shows mainly through public popularity.

ambiguity: 'मुन्ना है ये' is slang and unclear; the meaning is taken as 'a naughty boy'.
classical_check: Partly differs: classics give the Moon mind, emotions and mother; lust is mainly Venus and Mars. Moon's fickle and amorous nature is mentioned in some texts for the waxing Moon in Venus signs.

hindi: हां चंद्रमा बहुत कुछ है शनि बहुत कुछ है मंगल बहुत कुछ है
says: Each planet stands for many things at once, for example the Moon, Saturn and Mars each carry a wide range of meanings, so no planet should be read by one meaning alone.
cells_derived_method: The meaning that comes out of a planet's many meanings is chosen by the house it sits in and the sign it holds. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 4th in own sign shows its home, land and vehicle side before its fighting side.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 10th shows its work and discipline side.

classical_check: Agrees: classical karakatva lists give each planet dozens of significations, chosen by house.

gist: Says that Tara (the name, not stars in the sky) was the abducted wife and a son was born through her.

hindi: अब व पुत्र कौन है बुध तो चंद्रमा का बेटा ही बुद्ध है
says: The child of that story is Mercury, so Mercury is the son of the Moon; this is the parentage he uses to explain why Mercury relates to Moon and Jupiter the way it does.
cells_derived_method: none: a parentage statement, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: He says 'बुद्ध' for Mercury; it is the same planet (Budha).
classical_check: Agrees with Puranic tradition: Budha is the son of Soma (Moon) and Tara.

gist: Remarks on the odd situation that the Moon's son Mercury was born from Jupiter's wife, as the story says.

hindi: तो गुरु की पत्नी के साथ यह दुष्कर्म करके जो बुद्ध पैदा हुआ
says: Mercury was born out of the Moon's wrongdoing with the guru's wife, which in the myth makes Mercury both Jupiter's rival and a kind of son; he uses this to explain the mixed Jupiter-Mercury relation to come.
cells_derived_method: none: myth-level statement, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the slice boundary and finishes with 'बुध कौन है' in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic account; classical Jyotish records the Jupiter-Mercury relation as enmity (Jupiter regards Mercury as an enemy), which fits the story.

hindi: बुध कौन है बुद्धि वाणी
says: Mercury stands for intellect (buddhi) and speech (vani), so Mercury is the planet of how one says things.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's speech and intellect show in the house it sits in: 2nd (speech), 3rd (communication), 5th (intellect). Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo in the 2nd; precise, analytical speech and a clear way of expressing.
Derived: Mercury in own sign in the 3rd; strong communication and writing skill.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the classical karaka of intellect, speech, trade and learning.

hindi: बृहस्पति कौन है ज्ञान मन बुद्धि चित्त अहंकार
says: Jupiter stands for knowledge, mind, intellect, memory-stuff (chitta) and ego, which is the inner instrument (antahkarana) set placed entirely under Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: none: karaka list, not dependent on house or sign here.
ambiguity: He lists mind, intellect, chitta, ego together; in the classics mind is the Moon and ego is the Sun, so this is his own grouping.
classical_check: Differs partly: Jupiter is the jnana karaka classically, but mind (manas) belongs to the Moon, and ahamkara is a Sun trait.

hindi: एक विवेक होता है एक बुद्धि होती है आप कैसे किसी चीज को इंप्लीमेंटेशन करेंगे यह विवेक होता है
says: Viveka (discrimination) and buddhi (intellect) are different: viveka is the skill of how you will implement something, so it is practical judgement as against raw intellect.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet owns viveka; given the next lines, Jupiter holds it.
classical_check: Silent: the viveka versus buddhi distinction is a Vedanta idea and not part of Jyotish.

hindi: ज्ञान उसके बारे में जानते कितने हैं उसके बारे में बोलते क्या यह बुद्ध है यह हमारी वाणी आती है
says: Jupiter is how much you actually know about a thing, while what you say about it is Mercury; so knowledge sits with Jupiter and its spoken form is Mercury's speech.
cells_derived_method: none: a division of roles, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'बुद्ध' is Mercury (Budha), not the Buddha.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Jupiter for depth of knowledge, Mercury for speech and expression.

hindi: तो बुद्ध वाणी हमेशा बृहस्पति बिगड़ा वाणी खराब
says: Mercury's speech follows Jupiter: whenever Jupiter is spoiled in the chart, speech turns bad; the quality of what you say is tied to the soundness of Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter weak by debility, by the 6th, 8th or 12th house or by malefic affliction is read as spoiling speech. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 8th in Mercury's sign (enemy), a doubly poor placement; speech lacks depth and tends to mislead.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 2nd, the speech house; speech is harsh or empty in his scheme.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 2nd; speech is wise and carries weight, so the rule is not triggered.

ambiguity: The caption is terse; 'बृहस्पति बिगड़ा वाणी खराब' is read as a conditional (if Jupiter is spoilt, speech is spoilt).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter in the 2nd or well placed gives good speech in the classics; the rule as a general cause is his own.

hindi: हमारी खोपड़ी ऐसे न्यूरो कनेक्शन बनाती है कि जो हमारे खोपड़े के अंदर शब्द चल रहा है जो हम फील कर रहे हैं जैसा हमें ज्ञान है जैसा हमारा सोच है उसी जैसा महसूस करने की क्षमता वैसे ही हम
says: The brain builds neural connections so that the words running inside the head, what we feel, know and think, come out as speech; therefore what you say is a readout of your inner knowledge and feeling.
cells_derived_method: none: a mechanism claim, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: Long run-on caption; the claim is as stated: speech reflects inner feeling and knowledge.
classical_check: Silent: a neurological explanation of his own; classical texts do not discuss it.

gist: Says again that the brain makes the mouth say whatever the inner feeling is.
Example about two people reacting differently to a samosa, one calling it great and one calling it fried.

hindi: कौन है ये शब्द अलग-अलग क्यों निकल रहे हैं क्योंकि हम जुपिटर के द्वारा बृहस्पति के द्वारा वैसा ही ज्ञान रखते हैं समोसे के बारे में
says: The words differ from person to person because each of us holds a different knowledge through Jupiter, so the samosa example shows Jupiter's stored knowledge shaping what Mercury speaks.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: his illustration of the Jupiter-to-Mercury flow.

hindi: शब्द अलग-अलग है तो शब्द अक्सर हमारे दुश्मनी करते हैं यह कहते हैं ना एक चुप स सुख
says: Words often turn into enmity between people, and the saying 'one silence, a hundred comforts' applies; hence careless speech makes enemies and silence is safer.
cells_derived_method: none: a proverb-level caution, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: Caption reads 'एक चुप स सुख', completed as the proverb 'एक चुप सौ सुख'.
classical_check: Silent: proverb, not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: तो बुद्ध एक्सप्रेशन देता ही है इसलिए मुंह से जबान से बदतमीजी निकलती है अगर ज्ञान हो तो बहुत उत्तम निकलेगी
says: Mercury always gives the expression, so rude speech comes out when knowledge is poor and excellent speech comes out when knowledge is good; Mercury is the voice and Jupiter the content.
cells_derived_method: none: the quality of speech depends on the combined condition of both planets, covered in the next rows.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk ('बहुत उत्तम निकलेगी').
classical_check: Silent: his own formulation.

hindi: तो यह डिपेंड करता है ये दोनों कैसे हो क्योंकि यह एक्सप्रेशन है बुध बोलना
says: Speech quality depends on the condition of both Jupiter and Mercury, because Mercury is the expression itself, the act of speaking; neither planet alone decides it.
cells_derived_method: none: it depends on both planets' dignity and house, which the next rows detail.
classical_check: Agrees in outline with the classical reading of speech from Mercury and the 2nd house with Jupiter as supporter.

hindi: इसलिए यदि कुंडली में बुध का दोष हो छठे आठवे बव घर में हो किसी प्रकार से अस्त पड़ा हो सूर्य के साथ अक्सर अस्त रहता है
says: A Mercury fault in the chart means Mercury sitting in the 6th, 8th or 12th house or being combust; Mercury is often combust because it stays close to the Sun, and that combustion is a Mercury dosha.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in a dusthana loses strength, and the sign decides how much: own or exalted signs reduce the harm, enemy or debilitated signs raise it. Combustion is read by the degree gap from the Sun, which he does not give.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted and own in Virgo in the 6th; the dusthana weakness is eased, so speech is sharp but argumentative.
Derived: Mercury in Mars's sign in the 8th; secretive, probing speech with a tendency to say hurtful things.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 12th; the worst case in this list, with vague, hesitant expression.

ambiguity: 'छठे आठवे बारहवें घर' read as houses 6, 8, 12 (not sign numbers).
classical_check: Agrees in part: Mercury in dusthana and combust Mercury are classically weak; he does not give the combustion orb (about 14 degrees for Mercury).

hindi: ये अक्सर सुस्त रहता पड़ा हुआ या फिर जपि बुध की वक्र हो या फिर कहीं दोष बैठा हो
says: Mercury is also treated as faulty when it lies sluggish, when it is retrograde, or when some other affliction sits on it; so retrogression and affliction count as Mercury dosha alongside the 6-8-12 and combustion tests.
cells_derived_method: Retrograde Mercury is weighed by sign: in own or friendly signs it is workable, in enemy signs it weakens expression. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: retrograde Mercury in own sign in the 3rd; speech and writing work but slowly or repeat themselves.
Derived: retrograde Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 9th; confusion in beliefs and teaching, expression suffers.

ambiguity: The caption has a garbled word ('जपि') before 'बुध'; the retrograde reading is inferred from 'वक्र' (vakra).
classical_check: Partly agrees: retrograde and afflicted Mercury are treated as weak in some texts, though classical texts also say retrograde planets gain strength (cheshta bala).

hindi: तो ऐसा व्यक्ति बोलेगा बहुत ज्यादा हड़ तब शब्द बिगड़े हुए होंगे हकला सकता है उसकी वाणी में शुद्धता नहीं होगी बोलते बोलते वो अटक सकता है अटक अटक के बोलेगा ये बुद्ध के दोष के कारण ही
says: With a Mercury fault the person may talk a lot in a hurried way, with distorted words, and may stammer or get stuck mid-sentence; speech will lack purity, and he blames all of this on Mercury's dosha. This is a trait claim only, not a speech diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Severity depends on how many of the Mercury tests (6/8/12, combust, retrograde, affliction) are met and on the 2nd house. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Aries in the 2nd, combust by the Sun; abrupt, rushed speech patterns in his scheme.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 8th; halting, unclear speech where the dosha is strongest.

ambiguity: The caption 'बहुत ज्यादा हड़ तब' is garbled; 'hurried' is a best guess. The rest of the sentence is clear.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: classical texts link a weak or afflicted Mercury and 2nd house with defective speech and stammering. This is tradition, not a clinical diagnosis.

hindi: आप अपने ज्ञान को प्रॉपर्ली बोल नहीं पाएंगे एक्सप्रेस नहीं कर पाएंगे
says: The result of Mercury dosha is that even a person with good knowledge cannot put it across properly; ability and expression come apart.
cells_derived_method: none: a consequence of the Mercury faults above, not dependent on house or sign by itself.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts say a weak Mercury hampers expression even when Jupiter gives learning.

hindi: इसलिए बृहस्पति तीन नंबर राशि के अंदर मध्यम मध्यम फल देता है चूंकि बेटा है इसका इसलिए बच्चे को मारता तो नहीं है ये
says: Jupiter in sign number 3 (Gemini, Mercury's sign) gives only middling results; because Mercury is like Jupiter's son, Mercury does not destroy the father, though he does not help much either.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Gemini gives middling results in every house, and the house sets the topic that gets mediocre results: 5th children and learning, 9th luck, 10th career. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 5th; children and education come but without depth or ease.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 9th; many ideas about dharma and luck but no firm path.
Derived: Jupiter in Gemini in the 10th; career in teaching or advising that spreads thin.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर राशि' is read as sign 3 = Gemini, as it is the sign of Mercury; it could be read as house 3, but the Mercury-son argument fits the sign reading.
classical_check: Agrees: Gemini is Mercury's own sign and Mercury is an enemy of Jupiter in Parashara's table, so Jupiter is uncomfortable there.

hindi: अब मजे की बात क्या है बुध जब बृहस्पति की ही दूसरी राशि केतु में जाता है लोन दी हुई है राशि केतु न और 12 एक ही जगह होते हैं तो बुद्ध पूरी दुश्मनी निभाता है
says: When Mercury goes into Jupiter's other sign, number 12 (Pisces), which Jupiter has lent to Ketu, Mercury plays out the full enmity; in his scheme Ketu and sign 12 are the same place.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Pisces is hostile to Jupiter's household in every house; the house decides which area is hit: 1st self, 4th home, 7th partnership, 10th career. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 1st; confused self-expression and unreliable thinking.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 7th; misunderstandings and vague communication inside partnerships.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 10th; work that requires clear commerce or speech suffers.

ambiguity: The caption 'लोन दी हुई है राशि केतु ने और 12 एक ही जगह होते हैं' is garbled; read as 'the sign is given on loan to Ketu, and Ketu and 12 are at the same place'. Ownership of Pisces by Ketu is his scheme, not classical.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces and is an enemy of Jupiter. Ketu as co-lord of Pisces is not classical (it is a modern or Ketu-Pisces scheme).

hindi: फर्स्ट क्लास बाप की ऐसी की तैसी लेकिन बर्बाद नहीं करता है क्योंकि यहां केतु को दिया हुआ
says: In that sign Mercury humiliates his 'father' Jupiter first-class but does not wreck him, because the sign has been given over to Ketu; the lending to Ketu limits the damage.
cells_derived_method: Same as the previous sentence: embarrassment or insult in the house topic, but no ruin. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 2nd; humiliating speech episodes in the family but wealth is not lost.
Derived: Mercury in Pisces in the 6th; trouble from rivals and servants that does not become ruin.

ambiguity: 'बाप' is Jupiter (the father figure to Mercury in the story); a slangy phrase 'ऐसी की तैसी' means insult.
classical_check: Silent: the 'limits the damage because of Ketu' claim is his own.

gist: Says this is complicated and will come gradually as the series proceeds.
Repeats that Jupiter in the sign number 3 stays middling.

hindi: बृहस्पति अब आता है शुक्र की राशि में शुक्र दैत्यों का गुरु है बृहस्पति देवताओं का गुरु है
says: Now Jupiter enters Venus's sign; Venus is the guru of the demons and Jupiter the guru of the gods, so Jupiter is going into the house of the rival teacher.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Taurus or Libra sits in the sign of its rival teacher; the result is read by the house topic: 2nd, 4th, 7th, 11th are the main places. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 7th; partnership and law themes are pulled by Venus's desires.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 11th; gains come but through comfort-seeking and bargaining.
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 4th; home life leans to luxury and social polish over learning.

ambiguity: He says 'शुक्र की राशि' without a number; the next lines specify sign 2 (Taurus). Libra is included because it is also Venus's sign, but only Taurus is later mentioned.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is the guru of the Asuras (Shukracharya) and Jupiter of the Devas; Jupiter and Venus are enemies in Parashara's table (Venus treats Jupiter as neutral).

hindi: एक इनाड़ी है एक पिंगला है एक कहती है हां एक कहती है ना एक कहती रिलैक्स एंड डाइजेस्ट दूसरी कहते है भाग जाओ भाग जाओ फाइट एंड फ्लाइट दोनों उल्टे हैं
says: He compares the two guru-planets to the ida and pingala channels: one says yes and tells you to relax and digest, the other says no and tells you to fight or flee; they pull in opposite directions, like the two halves of the nervous system.
cells_derived_method: none: an analogy, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet is ida and which is pingala; the pairing is only 'one yes, one no'.
classical_check: Silent: the ida/pingala analogy is a yoga-tradition idea. Jupiter-Venus opposition as gods-demons is traditional.

hindi: लेकिन दोनों का ही तालमेल चाहिए कितना लड़ना है कितना भागना है इसके अंदर कला कलाकार तो कृष्ण जी थे
says: The two forces need to be balanced, since one has to know how much to fight and how much to run, and the artist of that balance was Krishna; the skill lies in the proportion.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे उन्होंने जाना तो बहुत ही सीधे सपाट रास्ते की बात है कि दोनों हमें चाहिए देवता भी चाहिए राक्षस भी चाहिए
says: Krishna understood a plain truth: a person needs both the divine and the demonic side, the Jupiter energy and the Venus energy; neither can be thrown away.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The first words 'हमारे उन्होंने' are garbled; the sense is that Krishna knew this.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह राक्षस के पास जब बृहस्पति जाता है दो नंबर के अंदर तो शुक्र इसको बेवकूफ बनाने के लिए पटरी देता है बैठने को आइए बृहस्पति महाराज पर साले मार दूंगा तेरे को
says: When Jupiter goes to the demon (Venus) in sign number 2 (Taurus), Venus offers a seat to fool him, saying 'welcome, Lord Jupiter', while really meaning to beat him; the welcome is a trap, and Jupiter's results there are spoiled.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Taurus looks comfortable but under-delivers; the house decides what is spoiled: 2nd wealth, 5th children, 9th dharma, 11th gains. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 2nd; wealth looks easy but is lost to comforts or bad deals.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 9th; a materialistic approach to dharma, with luck being deceptive.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 12th; spending on pleasure with spiritual gains lost.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर' is read as sign 2 = Taurus, since Venus owns it; the house reading (2nd house) is possible but the sign reading matches Venus's home.
classical_check: Differs: classically Jupiter in Taurus is a neutral-to-enemy placement with mixed results, not outright spoiling; Venus regards Jupiter as neutral, not as an enemy.

hindi: यानी कि अच्छा फल देने लायक स्थिति नहीं रहती नेगेटिव यह दुश्मन है एक दूसरे के
says: So Jupiter is not in a position to give good results there, the outcome is negative, and he states that Jupiter and Venus are enemies of each other.
cells_derived_method: Same cells as the previous sentence: the negative result shows through the house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 5th; children and study results are weak or delayed in his scheme.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 10th; career flows towards luxury trades but the wisdom role is lost.

ambiguity: 'Enemy' is mutual in his words; the classical table shows only Jupiter's side as enemy.
classical_check: Differs: Parashara lists Venus as neutral towards Jupiter, though Jupiter treats Venus as an enemy.

hindi: जो हमारा बृहस्पति है इसका केसरिया रंग है
says: Jupiter's colour is saffron (orange-yellow), so saffron is the Jupiter colour in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: none: a colour mapping, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the 16:07 chunk boundary.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classics give yellow for Jupiter; saffron or orange is close to it.

hindi: बृहस्पति ग्रह कहां बैठा है हमारा यह है वॉलेट यह वॉलेट है इंडिगो ब्लू यह ब्लू है ग्रीन
says: On the body figure he runs down the chakra colours from the top: violet (the caption says 'wallet'), then indigo, then blue, then green; this is the rainbow order laid on the body, ahead of showing where Jupiter sits.
cells_derived_method: none: a colour to chakra ordering, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'वॉलेट' is a caption error for violet. Positions are pointed on screen, so only the colour order is known.
classical_check: Silent: the rainbow to chakra scheme is modern yoga, not Jyotish.

hindi: अब यह हमारा ऑरेंज रंग था यह जुपिटर है बृहस्पति यह शनि है हमारा काला
says: The orange band is Jupiter, and Saturn takes the black end at the bottom of his colour map; orange for Jupiter, black for Saturn.
cells_derived_method: none: a colour mapping, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: Whether black is at the bottom is inferred from Saturn being the root-centre planet earlier.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual colour lists for Saturn (black); orange for Jupiter is near the classical yellow.

hindi: कई किस्म से कलर चलते हैं यह पोर्टल्स के कलर्स है
says: Colour schemes run in several ways, and what he is showing here is the set of colours for the portals (the body centres), not the only mapping possible.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'पोर्टल्स' means the energy centres (chakras).
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और यह सूर्य के द्वारा जो सात है सभी कुछ चलेगा
says: The seven colours come from the Sun's rays, and everything runs on those seven, so the Sun is the source of all the colour-planets in this map.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: Caption 'जो सात है सभी कुछ चलेगा' is loose; read as seven rays and the whole system running from them.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the seven rays or seven horses of the Sun link to the seven planets in tradition.

hindi: यही तो खिचड़ी है ज्योतिष कठिन क्यों हो जाता है क्योंकि बहुआयामी है बहुत सारे आयाम मल्टी डायमेंशन है
says: This mixture is why astrology is hard: it is multi-dimensional, with many layers (colours, body centres, planets, deities) all running together, so one cannot read it along a single line.
cells_derived_method: none: a general statement, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical authors also warn that results come from combining many factors.

hindi: अब विबग्योर के अंदर यह लाल रंग की रश्मिया यहां है और इसके ठीक ऊपर है ऑरेंज यह हो गया हमारा ऑरेंज
says: In the VIBGYOR order the red rays sit at the lowest point and orange comes just above them; so red is the base colour and orange, the Jupiter colour, is the next centre up.
cells_derived_method: none: a colour ordering, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: He points at positions on a figure; red is not named with a planet here (it would be Mars by the usual lists).
classical_check: Silent on chakra colours; consistent with his earlier claim that Saturn is at the root and Jupiter just above.

hindi: अब यह हार्ट चक्र है इसके ऊपर किस किया है ग्रीन शुक्र
says: The heart centre is green and belongs to Venus, so Venus is green and placed at the heart in his body map; the exact words after 'heart chakra' are garbled.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'इसके ऊपर किस किया है' is garbled and could mean 'above this is green' rather than 'this is green'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: green is a Mercury colour in the usual lists, with Venus usually white or variegated; so his Venus-green link is his own.

hindi: यह है जुम्मे का दिन शुक्रवार मुस्लिम लोग हरा रंग ही ओके करते
says: Friday (Jumma) is Venus's day, and the green colour is the one Muslims use; he links Friday, green and Venus together.
cells_derived_method: none: a day and colour association, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk ('हैं'). Venus equals Friday agrees with the classical weekday lord.
classical_check: Agrees on Friday as Venus's day; the green link is his own, not classical.

hindi: जितने सनातनी लोग हैं हिंदू धर्म को मानने वाले वो सारे के सारे रिलीजन को चलते हैं व सारे के सारे ऑरेंज केसरिया रंग को ही फॉलो करते हैं
says: All Sanatani Hindus follow the orange or saffron colour, so that colour is the signature of Jupiter's group in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: none: a colour association, not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: A broad generalisation about a community.
classical_check: Silent: saffron is a Hindu symbolic colour; classical Jyotish lists yellow for Jupiter.

gist: Claims that the saffron group and the green group (Jupiter and Venus) can never reconcile in the world, a social prediction about communities, not a chart rule.

hindi: क्योंकि यह एक दूसरे एक दैत्यों एक देवताओं के इस प्रकार शब्द कहे गए हैं यानी एक प्लस का है एक माइनस का है तो दोनों अलग नाड़ियों है
says: Jupiter is of the gods and Venus of the demons, one is a plus and the other a minus, and they run on separate channels; so the two are opposite polarities and cannot merge.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: Which one is plus and which one is minus is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Jupiter as deva-guru and Venus as asura-guru is classical.

gist: Blames the Islam-related quarrel on troublemakers on both sides, a political comment, not a chart rule.

hindi: पर ये क्यों है क्योंकि जिस जिसके शुक्र में दोष आ गया और बृहस्पति में दोष आ गया वो लड़ मरेंगे
says: Those whose Venus and Jupiter are both faulty will fight each other bitterly; a double affliction of Jupiter and Venus is the cause of quarrels, whether in individuals or couples.
cells_derived_method: The strength of the quarrel theme depends on where the two afflicted planets sit: the 7th house for marriage, the 2nd for family speech. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 7th with Jupiter also afflicted; the strongest marital quarrel pattern in this list.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 2nd with Venus afflicted; family fights through speech.
Derived: Venus in Mars's sign in the 8th with Jupiter afflicted; sudden, hidden conflict.

ambiguity: 'दोष' is not defined (debility, enemy sign, aspect of malefics); 'लड़ मरेंगे' is hyperbole for fighting hard.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: classical texts link afflicted Venus and Jupiter with marital discord, but not the strength he claims.

hindi: अब सबसे सुंदर मजेदार बात क्या है बृहस्पति जो इसे पति मानते हैं शुक्र को पत्नी मानते हैं भगवान
says: The nicest point: Jupiter is taken as the husband and Venus as the wife, so a marriage is seen as a Jupiter and Venus pairing in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Husband and wife show by the 7th house and its lord, with Jupiter and Venus as karakas; they colour the pairing by their own dignity. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 7th; the husband karaka is strong and the marriage has a teacher-like husband.
Derived: Venus in own sign in the 7th; the wife karaka is strong, with charm and attachment as the stress.

ambiguity: 'भगवान' at the end is a filler. He says husband is Jupiter and wife is Venus without mentioning that classics use Jupiter for a woman's husband and Venus for a man's wife.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Jupiter is the husband karaka (for a female chart) and Venus the wife karaka (for a male chart).

hindi: अब लड़ो अब कहते हैं मेरी पत्नी मुझसे बहुत लड़ती है नहीं जो लड़ सकती है वही पत्नी
says: A wife who fights with you is the real wife: the one who can fight is the wife, and the complaint 'my wife fights me a lot' is natural for the Venus and Jupiter pairing.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk with 'है'.
classical_check: Silent: his own humorous point.

hindi: गर्लफ्रेंड लड़ कभी आप ही नहीं लड़ो
says: A girlfriend does not really fight, the contrast being that only a wife (Venus matched to Jupiter as husband) quarrels; the exact second half is unclear and may mean 'you also should not fight'.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: 'लड़ कभी आप ही नहीं लड़ो' is garbled; two readings: the girlfriend never fights, or both of you should not fight.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बोले मेरा पति बहुत कुत्ते की तरह भकता है अरे जो कुत्ते की तरह भोक रहा है तेरे प वही पति है बाकी तो बॉयफ्रेंड होता क्योंकि वो तो बात ही प्यार से करेगा
says: If a woman says her husband barks at her like a dog, that is exactly what a husband is; a boyfriend speaks only sweetly, so the barking is the Jupiter husband role showing up.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
ambiguity: A humorous generalisation, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joke about a boyfriend offering to bring the moon, two plates of moon and three stars to his girlfriend.

hindi: ये सारे के सारे जो हैं जब जैसे ही बृहस्पति और शुक्र बन गए पति और पत्नी गए युद्धम समर्पयामी होना ही है किसी के माई के लाल में दम नहीं है
says: As soon as Jupiter and Venus become husband and wife, war is certain: nobody can stop it; the marriage bond itself sets the two opposing planets at war.
cells_derived_method: Conflict is read where the pair sits: Venus or Jupiter in the 7th, in each other's sign, or in aspect. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign in the 7th with Jupiter aspecting; marriage with frequent verbal duels.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 1st with Jupiter in Scorpio in the 7th, directly opposite; self and spouse pull against each other.
Derived: Jupiter in Taurus in the 7th, Venus's sign; the wife's house is hosted by the rival, so the spouse is argumentative.

ambiguity: 'युद्धम समर्पयामी' is a mock Sanskrit phrase meaning 'I surrender to war'.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts note friction when Jupiter and Venus are linked, but not that war is certain.

hindi: यही शुक्र संदेह पैदा कर देता है यही बृहस्पति जिद पैदा करता है इसलिए स्त्री संदेह करती ही है
says: Venus creates suspicion and Jupiter creates stubbornness, so a wife is bound to be suspicious (Venus role) and a husband stubborn (Jupiter role); the two karakas supply doubt and obstinacy.
cells_derived_method: none: karaka statement, not dependent on house or sign here.
ambiguity: A broad generalisation about women and men.
classical_check: Silent: suspicion for Venus and stubbornness for Jupiter are not classical karakatvas.

hindi: अब बोले यार कितनी शक्खी है मेरी पत्नी यार पत्नी है ये तो शकी हो नहीं है यार ये पति कितना अहंकारी है मेरा बदतमीज जिद्दी वो जिद्दी होना है वो प्रकृति ने ही मूल रूप दिया है
says: People complain that the wife is suspicious and the husband is egoistic and stubborn, but these traits are what nature gave the two roles at their root; the complaint is about a built-in design.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
