ambiguity: 'जॉइंट' is a caption error for giant.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe the planet's physics. It is correct that Jupiter is a gas giant.

hindi: इतना बड़ा गैस का गोला है कि इससे बड़ा कुछ है ही नहीं सूरज ही है इससे बड़ा बस इतना बड़ा है यह बहुत ही विशाल
says: Jupiter is so big a gas ball that nothing is larger except the Sun; he stresses that Jupiter's size is second only to the Sun's in the solar system.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Silent: Jupiter is the largest planet, and only the Sun is larger.

hindi: अब यह बृहस्पति गैस के गोले के साथ केतु के साथ ही रहता है तो यह अपना सा ही घर है
says: Jupiter, a ball of gas, stays with Ketu, the smoke-cloud, so for Jupiter this is like its own home; Jupiter is comfortable in Ketu's sign because both are gas and cloud in nature.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Pisces is at home, so results are reliable in the house topic: 1st, 4th, 9th and 12th are the stronger places. Not stated by him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in the 1st in Pisces; at-home strength gives a gentle, spiritual self.
Derived: Jupiter in the 4th in Pisces; a peaceful home and mother, with inner contentment.
Derived: Jupiter in the 8th in Pisces; at home in the occult house, so research and hidden knowledge are favoured.

ambiguity: 'अपना सा ही घर' means 'a home of its own kind'; it might mean Pisces is Jupiter's own sign, which classically it is.
classical_check: Agrees in outcome: Pisces is Jupiter's own sign, so strong; his gas-and-cloud reasoning is his.

hindi: लेकिन केतु कौन है राक्षस
says: But who is Ketu? A demon (rakshasa); Ketu is the demonic principle in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: none: not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: Ketu is the headless demon of the Puranic story (the tail of Svarbhanu).

hindi: केतु कौन है केतु हमारा लिंग है केतु योनि है केतु स्त्री के स्तन है केतु हमारे कान है
says: Ketu stands for the male organ, the female organ, the woman's breasts and our ears, so in his body map Ketu holds the sexual organs and the ears.
cells_derived_method: none: a body-part list, not dependent on house or sign.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Ketu the lower limbs, feet and spinal region; the sexual organs belong mainly to Venus and Mars, and the ears to the 3rd house and Mercury.

hindi: इसलिए बृहस्पति जब 12 नंबर राशि का होता है तो ये ध्यान जरूर दें बॉडी पियर्सिंग कराए नाक छेदन कराए
says: So when Jupiter is in sign 12 (Pisces), make sure to do body piercing and nose piercing; piercing the Ketu body parts is a remedy for Jupiter in Pisces.
cells_derived_method: none: a remedy rule, not dependent on house.
ambiguity: 'बॉडी पियर्सिंग' is not specific about which parts; the next rows give nose and ear.
classical_check: Silent: piercing as a Jupiter or Ketu remedy is not classical. As a body procedure it is a personal choice, not a medical recommendation.

hindi: बुध जब नंबर का हो तो नाक छेदन कराए कान छेदन कराए
says: When Mercury is in a certain sign number (the number is lost in the caption), get the nose pierced and the ears pierced; another piercing remedy, this time tied to Mercury.
cells_derived_method: none: the sign is missing, so no house or sign reading is possible.
ambiguity: The sign number is missing ('जब नंबर का हो'); it might be 12 (Pisces, Mercury's debilitation) or another, so no sign is recorded.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A new sentence beginning 'Jupiter's ...' that is cut off by the end of the slice, so it cannot be read.

hindi: बृहस्पति कौन है गुरुजी केतु कौन है सेक्स गणपति ज्ञान सारा देवता यही है और प्रजनी भी यही है संतति प्राप्ति भी यही है
says: Ketu is the planet of sex drive, Ganapati, the deity who gives knowledge, and also the planet of procreation and of getting children. Jupiter is the guru; Ketu is paired with it as the other side of the same pair.
cells_derived_method: Ketu's sex, knowledge and progeny role shows differently by house topic: in 5th it touches children and learning, in 7th the marital bed, in 12th bed pleasures and detachment; sign nature of the placement colours how raw or refined it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces (a sign he links to Ketu) in the 5th, knowledge and progeny themes strong but detached.
Derived: Ketu in an airy talkative sign in the 7th, sexual matters become a topic inside marriage.
Derived: Ketu in Virgo in the 12th, detail-minded withdrawal from bed pleasures.

classical_check: Classical texts give Ketu moksha and Ganesha association; sex and progeny are more usually Venus and Jupiter, so this is his emphasis.

gist: Girl is married, nose piercing became a joke, the husband has to put a rein in her nose and there is no rein.

hindi: वो इमीडिएट उसका केतु प्रोटेक्ट करते हैं आपने देखा होगा बड़े-बड़े संत है संत बड़े बड़े ज्ञानी बर्बाद हुए
says: The ear and nose piercing of a married woman acts as an immediate Ketu protection for the household; he then moves to the example of big saints and scholars who were ruined.
ambiguity: Caption is run together; the protected party (husband or household) is implied, not named.
classical_check: Silent; piercing as a Ketu or Saturn remedy is folk tradition, not in Parashari texts.

hindi: सिर्फ सेक्स सैंडल से कहीं ना कहीं किसी स्त्री का नाम आया चाहे सत्य में हुआ चाहे नहीं हुआ चाहे झूटा केस हुआ स्त्रियों के द्वारा वह नष्ट हुए हैं
says: Many great saints and scholars were destroyed only through sex scandals, where a woman's name came up, whether true or a false case. He says this is the danger of Ketu to a Jupiter person (knowledge, reputation).
ambiguity: Caption text for the final word is Ketu danger; whether he means Ketu conjunct Jupiter or Ketu generally is not stated.
classical_check: Silent; classical Ketu with Jupiter gives gnana and moksha, not scandal, so this is his own reading.

hindi: जैसे ही नाक छिदी है बीवी की उसके बाद यह निश्चित हो जाता है कान छिदे हैं नाक छिदी यह केतु है
says: Once the wife's nose and ears are pierced, the matter is settled for the husband; the pierced ear and nose are the Ketu parts of the body.
ambiguity: What exactly becomes certain is not said in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu is classically linked to ears in some texts but nose is not standard.

hindi: यह आप कल देखेंगे ह्यूमन हड्डी खोपड़े के अंदर मास नहीं है यहां पर यह होते ही नहीं
says: Ketu stands for the bony parts with no flesh in the human skull and face, such as ear and nose cartilage; he says he will show this tomorrow, so this is only a pointer.
ambiguity: Garbled; he points at the skull while speaking, exact body parts are guessed.
classical_check: Classical Ketu is skeletal, fleshless and headless in myth; broadly agrees.

hindi: इसको छेदने मात्र से वो स्त्री अपने पति को कभी बदनाम नहीं करेगी इसलिए स्त्री को पहले कहते तेरे कान छेद दो नाक छेद दो
says: Piercing ear and nose is claimed to make the woman never defame her husband; that is why girls were first told to get ears and nose pierced.
classical_check: Silent; this is a folk-tradition claim, not classical.

hindi: यह आपके मंथ की डेट वगैरह इत्यादि वगैरह को सबको सेटल कर रखता है संतान प्राप्ति हेतु आपकी मेंसी साइकल सब बढ़िया चलती है
says: Ketu, through this piercing, keeps the monthly dates and menstrual cycle settled so that getting children goes well. This is a tradition claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: The sentence begins in this chunk and ends in the next; one row covers both halves.
classical_check: Silent; menstrual cycles are classically Mars and Moon matters.

hindi: इसलिए पहले के समय में पुरुष भी कान छेदते थे और वह किसलिए ताकि केतु बृहस्पति का नाश ना पीट दे
says: In earlier times men also pierced their ears so that Ketu would not wreck Jupiter, meaning knowledge, reputation and children.
classical_check: Silent; tradition and folk custom only.

hindi: ये इसको धोखे की कुर्सी देता है बादल की कुर्सी देता है आइए बैठिए और लुढ़क के गिरा और चरित्र हनन के द्वारा उसको बर्बाद कर देता है
says: Ketu offers Jupiter a chair made of cloud, an illusory seat; Jupiter sits, tumbles down, and Ketu ruins him through character assassination.
ambiguity: Whether he means conjunction, aspect or any link between the two is not said.
classical_check: Silent; classical Guru-Ketu gives spirituality, so this is his own reading.

hindi: इसलिए बृहस्पति य बहुत सेंसिटिवली काम करता है
says: Jupiter works very sensitively; it is a delicate planet whose results can be spoiled easily by Ketu-type influences.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts call Jupiter robust, so this differs in tone.

hindi: लेकिन अगर यहां पर केतु यानी कि आपका सेक्स का स्यापा खत्म हो चुका है कुंडलिनी आपकी संतुष्ट है जीवन भर
says: If the Ketu matter, the sexual restlessness, is finished and the kundalini is satisfied for life, then Jupiter is not harmed; this is the safe state.
ambiguity: How this is seen in a chart is not explained; it is described as a state of the person.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नहीं तो लोग खोपड़े में सेक्सी सोचते रहते हैं स्पेसिफिकली वासना की बात हो रही है तो ज्ञान नहीं बनता और आपका बृहस्पति कभी भी कुंडलिनी को ऊपर राइज नहीं करने देता
says: Otherwise people keep thinking about sex all day; with lust in the mind knowledge does not form, and Jupiter will never let the kundalini rise upwards.
classical_check: Silent; kundalini is not a graha topic in Parashari texts.

hindi: महा अहंकारी होते हैं यह दोनों च है जहां कुंडलिनी विराजमान है
says: He calls these two, Jupiter and Ketu, extremely egoistic, and begins pointing to where the kundalini sits. The word after dono is garbled.
ambiguity: The pair meant could also be Jupiter and Venus; the garbled letter after dono prevents certainty.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कुंड में लीन कुंडलिनी यह है कुंड और इसके ऊपर यह है
says: The kundalini lies absorbed in the kund, the pit at the base of the body, and the next level sits above it; he is pointing at body positions.
ambiguity: Body locations are shown by gesture, not named in the caption.
classical_check: Tantra view, not in Jyotish classics.

hindi: भाड़ में जाए हनुमान जी वाला चक्र भाड़ में जाए यहां से शुरू होता है इसलिए भाड़ में भेजने को हम कहते हैं भाड़ में भेज यार जैसे ही भाड़ में भेजा कुंडलिनी ऊपर राइज कर गई है तो ट्रैप नहीं हुई जुपिटर में
says: Wordplay on the colloquial phrase send it to hell: the Hanuman chakra is where lust is dismissed; once you dismiss it, the kundalini rises and is not trapped by Jupiter.
ambiguity: Caption is garbled around the chakra name and the pun; meaning is a best reading.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जुपिटर बहुत पावरफुल है भाई अटैक करके रखता है आपको काम नहीं करने देगा
says: Jupiter is very powerful and attacks the native, not letting him get work done when it is against him.
ambiguity: Condition under which Jupiter attacks is not stated here.
classical_check: Differs from classical view of Jupiter as the greatest benefic.

hindi: यही बृहस्पति जब आठ नंबर का होता है तो इंद्र के साथ है इंद्र भी देवताओं का गुरु है गुरु महाराज को प्रणाम करता है सारे टाइम
says: When Jupiter is in number 8, which in his scheme is the sign owned by Indra (Uranus), it sits with Indra, who always bows to the guru Jupiter.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Scorpio in different houses: the house topic of the placement gets the Indra-Jupiter blend, modified by the house's matters, with Scorpio's intensity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio in the 8th, hidden knowledge and research with Indra's protection.
Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio in the 2nd, speech and family wealth coloured by secrecy and intensity.
Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio in the 11th, gains through research, insurance or hidden channels.

ambiguity: Number 8 could be sign 8 (Scorpio, his Indra sign) or the 8th house; sign reading is chosen because the next lines give signs 7, 10 and 11 the same way.
classical_check: Scorpio is a friendly sign for Jupiter classically (Mars lord), so it agrees in tone; Indra as lord is his own scheme.

gist: Story that Indra's kingdom was attacked by the demons and he fled the throne to Brihaspati's feet asking for a way.

hindi: तो इंद्र क्या है हमारी थाइज थाइज में क्या है ग्रोथ हार्मोन
says: Indra, the planet Uranus in his scheme, is the thigh area of the body and the growth hormone.
classical_check: Uranus is outside classical Jyotish; thighs are classically Sagittarius, ruled by Jupiter, so this is his own assignment.

hindi: सारे के सारी बॉडी जैसे ही ग्रोथ हार्मोन डाउन करती है आप हॉस्पिटल पहुंचते हैं डॉक्टर कहता कुछ नहीं हो रहा पैर चलने बंद हो जाते हैं तो सारा का सारा लिवर टेकओवर करता है
says: When growth hormone drops, the person goes to hospital and the doctor finds nothing, the legs stop moving, and then the liver takes over the whole work. He is describing medicine, not a chart rule, so treat it as a health claim in tradition.
ambiguity: Liver is implied to be Jupiter here but the sentence does not name the planet.
classical_check: Liver is classically Jupiter; the Indra link is his own. Medical content, not to be used as diagnosis.

hindi: लीवर पूरी बॉडी की गंदगी हटाता है डॉक्टर कहता है लीवर डिटॉक्सिफाई करो इसके लीवर को सेट करो
says: The liver clears the dirt of the whole body, so doctors say detoxify and set the liver right; Jupiter is the liver planet that does this cleansing.
ambiguity: Planet is inferred from later lines where he says Jupiter washes it off.
classical_check: Agrees: classical texts give liver to Jupiter.

gist: Doctors flush the whole body with antibiotics which kill every germ, and antibiotics themselves are poison that kills bacteria.

hindi: उस एंटीबायोटिक को कौन धोए डॉक्टर्स को पता है अरे लीवर धो देगा अरे बृहस्पति धो देगा
says: Who washes out the antibiotic itself? Doctors know the liver will wash it, and in his language Jupiter will wash it, so Jupiter is the detoxifier of the body's poisons.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter is liver, but detox role is his gloss.

hindi: तो इंद्र जब काम नहीं करता बॉडी में एंटीबॉडीज नहीं होती जान नहीं होती तो ऑटोमेटिक आप जुपिटर काम करता है
says: When Indra stops working there are no antibodies and no vitality in the body, and then Jupiter automatically takes over; so Indra and Jupiter are a backup pair for body strength.
ambiguity: Medical language; not a diagnosis and not to be used as one.
classical_check: Silent; Indra as immunity is his scheme.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति इ ऑलवेज गुड यर लाजवाब फल देता है
says: With Indra, in the sign 8 set-up just described, Jupiter is always good and gives excellent, unmatched results.
cells_derived_method: Same as the sign-8 statement: quality stays high but its field depends on house, for example 5th gives scholarly children, 10th gives research careers, 12th gives foreign or hidden gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio in the 5th, deep study and a serious intelligent child.
Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio in the 10th, career in research, healing or investigation.
Derived: Jupiter in Scorpio in the 12th, expenses toward hidden or spiritual ends.

ambiguity: The first words are garbled (in always good year); read as Jupiter in 8, is always good.
classical_check: Scorpio is a friend sign for Jupiter classically so good result is plausible; word always is his.

hindi: ये वरुण देव है सात नंबर अब यह भी एक ही पोर्टल पर अटके हुए हैं यही बृहस्पति है आपका यही यही शुक्र है और यही वरुण देव है लेकिन वरुण यह समुद्र का देवता है
says: Varuna, the sea god (Neptune), owns number 7 which is Libra; Venus and Varuna are stuck on the same portal (Libra), and the Jupiter-guru theme is also tied in. Varuna is the god of the ocean.
ambiguity: Garbled: he says Jupiter, Venus and Varuna in one breath; probably meaning Jupiter reaches Libra, where Venus and Varuna both rule.
classical_check: Libra is classically Venus only; Neptune as co-lord is his scheme.

hindi: सात नंबर में बृहस्पति स्टिल बेटर ओके फल देगा
says: Jupiter in number 7, Libra, still gives better or acceptable results, a notch below the Indra sign but fine.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Libra gets the house meaning of the placement: in the 7th it supports marriage and partnership, in the 4th a cultured home, in the 10th diplomacy or law careers.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 7th, wise, fair-minded spouse and good partnerships.
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 4th, refined home and good vehicles.
Derived: Jupiter in Libra in the 10th, career in law, advice or the arts.

ambiguity: Number 7 as sign (Libra) chosen because he is naming the Varuna sign.
classical_check: Classically Libra is Venus's sign, an enemy of Jupiter, so Jupiter is only neutral; his OK-level fruit is roughly consistent.

hindi: कुंडली के अंदर 11 नंबर यमराज का है मौत का घर यह भी शनि को ही शनि का ही लोन दिया हुआ है
says: Number 11, Aquarius, belongs to Yamaraj (Pluto), the death house; but Saturn has lent it to him, so it is really Saturn's own house on loan.
ambiguity: He calls 11 the house of death while classical death house is the 8th; here he clearly means the sign numbered 11 since he then talks of Saturn's 10 and 11.
classical_check: Classically Aquarius is Saturn's only; Pluto lordship is his scheme and the 8th is the death house, so 11 as death house differs from texts.

hindi: 10 नंबर भी शनि का 11 भी ये दोनों जॉइंट है आपस में जुड़े हुए भाई है ये ये गोला और यह गोला ये जुड़े हुए हैं 10 और 11 शनि के पास ही
says: Numbers 10 and 11, Capricorn and Aquarius, are both Saturn's and are joined together like brothers, drawn as two linked circles; both stay with Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees: Capricorn and Aquarius are Saturn's signs.

hindi: है ये यमराज को लोन दिया हुआ है इसने भाई है इसका
says: Saturn has lent the Aquarius sign to Yamaraj because Yama is his brother; this finishes the loan story.
classical_check: In myth Yama and Shani are half-brothers (sons of Surya), so this fits mythology; the lordship is his scheme.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति यहां भी नीच का है और यहां भी नीच का है
says: Jupiter is debilitated both in sign 10 and in sign 11 according to him.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 4th, home and property results weak or delayed.
Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 7th, trouble in marriage.
Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 5th, study and children results weak by his claim.

classical_check: Differs: Jupiter is debilitated only in Capricorn; in Aquarius it is not debilitated (Saturn is neutral to Jupiter), so his claim for sign 11 is wrong by classical rule.

hindi: अगर पढ़ाई के स्थान में बैठा है तो बच्चे का पढ़ाई का एक साल खराब होएगा या एक कोर्स वेस्ट करेगा चाहे 11 है चाहे 10 है
says: If Jupiter sits in the study house while in sign 10 or 11, the child will lose one year of study or waste one course.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 4th, school-level year loss.
Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 5th, a higher-course delay or a wasted course.
Derived: Jupiter in Capricorn in the 9th, higher education or university stage disrupted.

ambiguity: Study house number not stated; cells use house * because the sentence names only the sign and the purpose house.
classical_check: Silent on exact one year loss; a weak Jupiter in 4th or 5th harming study is consistent in direction.

hindi: शादी के स्थान में है तो एक शादी फेल करेगा चाहे 10 में है चाहे 11 में
says: If Jupiter in sign 10 or 11 sits in the marriage house, one marriage will fail.
cells_derived_method: Marriage failure shown from the 7th; same sign pair in other houses would damage other topics (4th property, 10th career) instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 7th, first marriage breaks.
Derived: Jupiter in Aquarius in the 7th, marriage with an older or serious spouse that falters.
Derived (contrast): same sign in the 10th, marriage not hit directly, work life affected.

ambiguity: Marriage house assumed 7th; he only said marriage ka sthan.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not say Jupiter in Aquarius fails marriage; Jupiter debilitated in 7th is classically a negative.

hindi: स्थानों स्थान अनुसार बात आगे होगी
says: Results will depend place by place, house by house; he will go through the other placements later.

hindi: घर और राशि दोनों ही सेम हो तब क्या तब रिजल्ट्स में होते रहे घर तो सेम ही रहेगा ना वो 12 खाने तो सेम ही रहेंगे राशि भी वही सेम है तो फल तो फिर भी राशि से ही चलेगा जैसा ग्रह बैठा है

hindi: सातवां घर फिक्स है पत्नी का है पांचवा घर फिक्स है संतान का है चौथा घर फिक्स है प्रॉपर्टी का है जायदाद का है इन्हेरिटेंस का है

hindi: गिफ्ट वेल रैप्ड गिफ्ट बढ़िया वाले गिफ्ट है अगर वेल रैप्ड गिफ्ट आप दे रहे हैं तो आपने उच्च क्वालिटी का शुक्र दिया है
says: A well-wrapped, fine gift is high-quality Venus; if you give such a gift you have given Venus of high quality.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए सबको लड़कियों को क्यों सारे टाइम ये कहते हैं इसको फूल दे दे लाल फूल कौन है मंगल लाल शुक्र शुक्र कौन है फ्लावर शुक्र फूल फ्लावर है और लाल फूल कौन है मंगल
says: Why is it always said to give girls a flower, a red flower: the flower is Venus, and the red colour is Mars, so a red flower is Venus combined with Mars.
ambiguity: Sentence runs across two chunks; one row.
classical_check: Agrees: red is Mars and flowers are Venus.

hindi: मंगल शुक्र अट्रैक्शन का देवता लाल रंग क्या है मंगल मंगल देवता लाल हनुमान जी को लाल लगाते हैं ना
says: Venus is the god of attraction, and the red colour is Mars, the Hanuman deity, which is why Hanuman is offered red.
classical_check: Agrees that red is Mars; Hanuman as Mars is his scheme.

hindi: लड़की को क्या कहते हैं लाल लहंगा पहनेगी शादी वाले दिन लाल सिंदूर लगाएगी लड़की कौन है शुक्र आग लग जाती है कहते हैं परी लग रही है अप्सरा लग रही है
says: A bride wears a red lehenga and red sindoor on the wedding day; the girl is Venus, red adds Mars, so fire starts and people say she looks like a fairy or an apsara.
classical_check: Silent; a cultural illustration of the colour map.

hindi: ये लाल रंग स्त्रियों के लिए क्यों विशेष कहा गया है शुक्र में मंगल डाल देने से ऑटोमेटिक भयंकर अट्रैक्शन होती है ऑटोमेटिक
says: Red is said to be special for women because adding Mars to Venus automatically produces strong attraction.
classical_check: Silent; the Venus plus Mars attraction idea is classical in conjunction results.

hindi: जिसने जीत ली वो बृहस्पति उसने जीत ली जेब में वो लाल लाली उसके पीछे पीछे आएगी या उल्टा काम चलेगा दुनिया लाली के पीछे जाएंगे और वो लाली उस बृहस्पति के पीछे होगी
says: The person who has conquered, the Jupiter nature, keeps that red attraction in his pocket and it follows him; otherwise the world runs after the attraction, but the attraction itself runs after the Jupiter person.
ambiguity: Caption jumbles lali (redness or beauty) and the or-reverse clause.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Story that women of brothels, wayward women, nuns and widows all became Buddha's followers, and Buddha did not waver.

hindi: जब आप बुद्ध हो जाते हो तो बृहस्पति आपका जेब में सारी दुनिया को लेकर घूमता है ऑटोमेटिक आपके पीछे लाली भी चलती है कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं है
says: When you become like Buddha, enlightened, Jupiter carries the whole world in your pocket and the red attraction also follows you automatically, no problem at all.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Lecture flow: which planet were we on, Saturn; I speak too much, so let us go into express detailing.

hindi: कन्या लगन वाले टू मच शनि महाराज
says: For Virgo ascendant people there is too much Saturn, since Saturn rules two houses there; the caption is short and garbled.
ambiguity: Only the lagna is named; Virgo lagna is house 1, sign Virgo, not a planet cell. The audience context is unclear.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn lords the 5th and 6th for Virgo lagna.

hindi: शनि महाराज कहां पहुंचे थे शुक्र के यहां पहुंचे थे दो नंबर शुक्र राशि हां यह बहुत बढ़िया कार्यक्रम चलता रहेगा
says: Saturn had reached Venus's house, number 2, Taurus, and there a very good program keeps running.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Taurus gives steady benefit in the house topic: in the 9th luck, in the 10th career, in the 11th gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Taurus in the 9th, Virgo lagna, slowly built luck and steady religion.
Derived: Saturn in Taurus in the 10th, Leo lagna, stable, comfort-oriented career.
Derived: Saturn in Taurus in the 11th, Cancer lagna, steady gains.

ambiguity: Number 2 is Taurus; Libra is Venus's other sign but not named here.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn and Venus are friends, a good placement.

hindi: तो तेल के पराठे भी बनते हैं आपके और घी के भी बनते हैं बहुत धासू होते हैं तो शुक्र का रूप मिल जाए मजा आ जाए
says: Parathas are made with both oil and ghee and both are tasty; so if Saturn gets the form of Venus, joy comes; oil and ghee, Saturn and Venus, work well together.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn and Venus are friends.

hindi: इसलिए अपनी सारी चीजें धो दबा के पैक करके नमस्कार करके दो आप घर के सेवक को अपनी यूज चीजें देते हैं वो बहुत खुश होता है और आपकी औरा जाती है
says: So wash all your things, pack them well and give them with a namaskar; when you give used things to household servants he is very happy, and your aura, the load of those items, leaves you.
classical_check: Silent; a folk charity remedy.

hindi: कोई बुराई नहीं वहम मत करो पाप होंगे उनके कर्म ले लेंगे उनका भला तो है ही आपका भी है
says: There is no harm in this and no need for superstition about passing on sins; they will take on their own karma, it does them good and you good as well.
ambiguity: The sentence about sins and karma is garbled, so the exact reasoning is a best guess.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यही शनि जब राहु महाराज के य जाता है तब राहु तो इसकी छाया है बस यही एक मजा है
says: When Saturn goes to Rahu's house, Rahu is its own shadow, so Saturn is at ease there; this is the one fun case.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Rahu's sign works in the house field: in the 6th service and enemies, in the 12th losses and foreign lands, in the 3rd effort and writing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Virgo in the 6th, Aries lagna, wins over enemies and debts by hard work.
Derived: Saturn in Virgo in the 12th, Libra lagna, expenditure and foreign service.
Derived: Saturn in Virgo in the 3rd, Cancer lagna, persistent effort and communication.

ambiguity: Rahu's sign was given earlier as number 6, Virgo; the sentence itself does not give the number; the caption ends at the slice end.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu acts like Saturn; Rahu as sign lord is his scheme.

hindi: शनि कहता है भाई देख सारे संसार का ब्रह्मांड का सारा सोना चांदी गहना मुन्ना मुन्ना है शनि
says: Saturn is presented as the owner of all gold, silver and jewellery in the universe (the word 'munna' is a garbled caption, probably 'mine'); the point is that Saturn is the planet of stored wealth and precious metal.
ambiguity: Garbled word 'munna munna'; unclear if he means Saturn owns the metals or merely controls their flow.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn rules iron, lead and base metal; gold is Sun/Jupiter and silver Moon/Venus.

gist: He announces an exclusive Saturn class, noting earlier classes covered other planets, and asks how to get Saturn to do the work for you.

hindi: जब राहु के घर जाता छ नंबर के अंदर राहु कौन है शनि की छाया
says: When Saturn goes into Rahu's house, which he numbers 6, you must remember Rahu is simply Saturn's shadow, so the two work as one block of energy.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Rahu's sign (Virgo in his scheme) behaves as Saturn plus its own shadow: the house topic of that placement gets slowed, made obscure and unpredictable. The nature of the house decides what stalls: action houses show delayed work, money houses show irregular income, relationship houses show unclear commitments.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Virgo in the 3rd, effort and initiative become shadowy and delayed, courage shows up late.
Derived: Saturn in Virgo in the 10th, career moves in irregular bursts, authority tied to hidden or indirect work.
Derived: Saturn in Virgo in the 7th, partnerships are slow to form and vague in terms.

ambiguity: 'Number 6' could mean sign Virgo (his Rahu sign) or the 6th house; he calls it Rahu's house so sign Virgo is assumed.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give Virgo to Rahu; in his scheme Rahu co-lords Virgo, and Saturn-Rahu is called shrapit yoga in later tradition.

hindi: छाया रोक दी किसी की किल लगा दी तो बंदा भी रुक गया ... राहु उल्टा है आपकी छाया रुक गई तो आपका शनि रुक गया
says: Nail a person's shadow and he stops walking; Rahu works in reverse, so when Rahu stops your shadow, your Saturn (your work and karma) stops too, even though Saturn itself would otherwise keep moving.
ambiguity: The sentence is a metaphor; it does not say which houses or signs, so it is read as a general Saturn-Rahu link.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not describe Rahu as Saturn's shadow in this way (Rahu is said to act like Saturn, which is close).

hindi: शनि वैसे आलसी है जिसकी कुंडली में शनि पराक्रम स्थान में बैठा तीसरा घर पराक्रम का होता है
says: Saturn is basically lazy, and when it sits in the 3rd house, the house of effort and courage, the native does not actually make effort, so the very house of action is made idle.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 3rd is read as low initiative. The sign it sits in modifies how: in a fire or movable sign the laziness is partly overridden by drive, in a water or fixed sign it deepens inertia, in an airy sign it becomes talk without action.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Aries (debilitated in classical terms) in the 3rd, restless Mars sign fights the inertia but Saturn is weak, so effort comes in short angry bursts.
Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn in the 3rd, laziness is steady and structured, effort happens only on a fixed schedule or under duty.
Derived: Saturn in Libra (exalted classically) in the 3rd, sustained effort possible but only through partnership or negotiation.
Derived: Saturn in Cancer in the 3rd, effort is held back by moods and domestic comfort.

classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn in the 3rd (an upachaya house) is considered good for effort and gain, so he is contradicting the usual view.

hindi: वो आद पराक्रम नहीं करता उसे महाल स अवार्ड दिया जा सकता है शनि और बृहस्पति तीसरे घर के हो तो महाल स अवार्ड क्योंकि बृहस्पति भी गुरु है एक
says: Such a native makes no effort and could win a 'laziness award'; if Saturn and Jupiter both sit in the 3rd the laziness award is guaranteed, because Jupiter, also a heavy guru planet, adds to the staying-put quality.
cells_derived_method: Saturn and Jupiter conjunct in the 3rd: both slow-moving heavy planets in the house of courage. The sign they share decides flavour: in a Saturn sign the inertia is disciplined, in a Jupiter sign it is comfortable and faith-based, in a Mercury or Venus sign it becomes intellectual or pleasure-driven idleness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn and Jupiter in Sagittarius in the 3rd, Jupiter's own sign dominates, philosophical contentment with little personal initiative.
Derived: Saturn and Jupiter in Aquarius in the 3rd, Saturn's own sign, detached and collective-minded, effort handed to groups or machines.
Derived: Saturn and Jupiter in Taurus in the 3rd, comfort and sensual ease keep the native seated.

ambiguity: Captions say 'mahaals award'; read as 'maha-aalas' (great laziness) award.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not call this combination lazy; Jupiter in the 3rd is usually noted as weakening courage but not idleness as such.

hindi: जगह बैठ गए तो बैठ ही गए महाराज हिलेगे नहीं कोई हिला के दिखाए
says: Once these heavy planets settle in one place they stay settled; the native will not budge, and nobody can force him to move, which is why the sitting-down quality is the core of the Saturn-Jupiter combination.
ambiguity: Refers back to the previous sentence about the 3rd house; unclear if he generalises to all houses.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mimicking a child refusing to wake up: mother, the sun has not risen, I will not get up.

hindi: तो शनि महा आलस का देवता है
says: Saturn is the god of extreme laziness and slowness, the deity whose nature is inertia rather than action.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Saturn is called manda (slow) and aalasya (laziness) karaka in classical texts.

hindi: ऐसे बच्चे बच्चों को आप कहो पढ़ जल्दी उठ जितना जल्दी उठेगा शनि वीक होगा राहु से रोक देगा इसलिए उसको बोलो बेटा पड़ रे
says: Do not force such children to wake early: the earlier he is made to rise, the weaker his Saturn becomes and Rahu will then block him, so tell him to rest, which is his way to keep Saturn strong.
ambiguity: Only about children with Saturn in the 3rd or Saturn-Rahu influence; not stated for every chart.
classical_check: Differs: no classical text prescribes sleeping late; it is his own practical rule.

gist: Joking dialogue: it is only two in the afternoon, let evening come first.

hindi: यह लोग सारी रात जगते हैं सारा दिन सोते हैं और यही से उनका राहु स्ट्रेंथ देता है
says: People who stay awake all night and sleep all day get strength from Rahu through this upside-down routine; the reversed rhythm itself is what feeds Rahu's power in their lives.
classical_check: Silent: Rahu's night and reversal nature is consistent with tradition but this routine claim is his own.

hindi: जितना जमीन से जुड़ा व्यापार है वह सारे के सारे शनि राहु की राशि वाले या उसके असर वाले कमाते हैं
says: All businesses tied to land and property make their money for people whose charts sit in Saturn or Rahu signs, or who are influenced by them; land-linked trade is a Saturn-Rahu earning area.
cells_derived_method: Planets or the lord of the income house placed in Saturn or Rahu signs point to land, property, real estate or ground-based trade. Which house carries the signs tells the route: 2nd and 11th for earnings, 4th for land itself, 10th for the trade as profession.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn in the 11th, gains come from property and long-term holdings, slowly but steadily.
Derived: Aquarius in the 4th, land or housing connected with large groups, plots, townships.
Derived: Virgo (Rahu's sign here) in the 10th, brokerage, dealing, intermediary work in property.

ambiguity: He does not list the exact signs; Saturn signs Capricorn and Aquarius and Rahu sign Virgo are assumed from his scheme.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn and Rahu are tied to land and earth in some later texts; Mars and the 4th house are the usual classical land indicators.

gist: A property dealer sits in his shop, says he is very busy while watching TV and doing nothing.
That same dealer earns lakhs from four deals a month, buys a car, and just says he is busy.

hindi: जितना आलस करेगा उतना उठेगा आपको काम नहीं करना है आपको आलसी रहना है आपका डिसिप्लिन नहीं होना चाहिए
says: For this type of chart the more idle you are, the more you rise; you should not be disciplined, because you cannot know when work, money or expense will arrive, so the unscheduled lifestyle is the method.
ambiguity: He applies this to Saturn-Rahu type charts only; the sentence itself is stated generally.
classical_check: Differs: classical advice is the opposite, Saturn rewards discipline and routine.

hindi: जब आप ऐसे होते हैं तो शनि ही आपको स्पिरिचुअल भी बनाता है स्पिरिचुअलिटी के पूरे गुण है इसमें पता ही नहीं
says: Living in this unplanned state Saturn also makes you spiritual; the spiritual person says 'I do not know', and the not-knowing is itself the main quality of spirituality, so the third eye opens.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn is a classical karaka of renunciation and detachment.

hindi: यह राहु की घर में बेबसी का गजब का काम करता है इसलिए बेबस आराम से बैठे रहो हमारे बस की नहीं है
says: Rahu sitting in a house produces a powerful feeling of helplessness in that house's matters, so the native just sits back and accepts that it is beyond his control.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in any house makes the topics of that house feel out of the native's hands. The house decides the area: 1st self-direction, 7th partner, 10th career, 12th losses and sleep.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 1st, feels unable to steer own identity and decisions, drifts by circumstance.
Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 7th, marriage and deals feel decided by others, helpless acceptance.
Derived: Rahu in Capricorn in the 10th, career direction felt as out of control but rewarded through large organisations.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Rahu is the planet of confusion and obsession in classical and later texts.

hindi: शनि 12 नंबर केतु यह भी राक्षस देवता है यह धुए का बादल बनाता है यह रेसिड्यू इफेक्ट है
says: Saturn going to number 12, which is Ketu's place, meets another demon-god who makes clouds of smoke; Ketu is the residue effect, the leftover after burning.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Ketu's sign (Pisces in his scheme) means Saturn's work gets dispersed into smoke and leftovers: results are diffuse, foreign, hidden or spiritual. The house gives the field: in the 12th it is natural and the effect is strongest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 12th, losses, isolation or foreign stay; work dissolves into spiritual or hidden activity.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 6th, service and routine are diffused, fuzzy health and unclear enemies.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 2nd, speech and family wealth leak or dissolve, inconsistent savings.

ambiguity: '12 number' could be sign Pisces or the 12th house; he calls it Ketu's place so Pisces is assumed.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts give Pisces to Jupiter; Ketu rulership of Pisces is part of his scheme.

hindi: मंगल महाराज हनुमान जी ने पच से आग लगाई शनि के सोने के लंका में सोना है सारा सोने की लंका शनि है उसमें लगाई
says: Using the Hanuman story: Mars (Hanuman) sets fire, and the golden Lanka that burns is Saturn, since all that gold is Saturn's; the fire of Mars on Saturn's wealth leaves smoke, which is Ketu.
ambiguity: A mythological illustration; whether he means a Mars-Saturn combination or only an analogy is not clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: केतु धुए के बादल उठे उस बादल अंधकार में बादल उठेंगे क्या करेंगे घुल मिल जाएंगे शनि महाराज यहां भी पार्टी करते हैं
says: The smoke clouds of Ketu rise into darkness and just merge and blend in; Saturn enjoys himself even here, partying comfortably, so Saturn in Ketu's sign is relaxed, hidden and enjoys itself.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Pisces (Ketu's place) blends into the background: low-profile comfort, escapist enjoyment, comfort in darkness or privacy. House shows where he hides: 5th pleasures and speculation, 8th occult, 12th sleep and bed pleasures.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 5th, quiet creative and romantic enjoyment, private amusements.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 12th, sleep, retreat, bedroom comforts and foreign leisure.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 8th, absorbed interest in hidden or occult pleasure.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन मल्टीपल काम करता है शनि ऐसे में ऐसे व्यक्ति का कार्यक्षेत्र में केतु के साथ 12 नंबर से लिंग को कई सोर्स ऑफ इनकम होते हैं कई बच्चे होते हैं कई पत्निया होती है कई पति होते हैं
says: With Saturn linked to Ketu or number 12, the native does several kinds of work and has many sources of income, many children and many wives or husbands, because the Ketu-smoke multiplies things.
cells_derived_method: Saturn linked with Ketu or Pisces brings multiplicity. House picks what multiplies: 2nd and 11th income streams, 5th children, 7th spouses, 10th occupations.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 11th, many small income streams and large networks.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 7th, more than one significant partnership over life.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 5th, more than one child or several creative lines.

ambiguity: '12 number' is ambiguous between Pisces and 12th house; 'link' also not defined (conjunction, aspect or sign exchange).
classical_check: Differs: classical texts do not give multiple spouses for Saturn-Ketu; multiple sources of income via the 12th is not standard.

gist: Garbled phrase 'jan sa wala laga lo' (roughly 'apply whichever one'); meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: शनि आठ नंबर का है इंद्र के यहां ये कृपण गरीब भिखारी इंद्र के इंद्र महा अहंकारी है महा अयाश
says: Saturn in number 8, which is Indra's (Uranus) place, makes the native miserly, poor or beggar-like in attitude, while Indra himself is hugely arrogant and debauched.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Scorpio (Uranus's sign in his scheme) is cramped and starved: stinginess, scarcity, humiliation. House shows where: 2nd wealth and food, 4th property and comfort, 10th status, 11th gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 2nd, tight-fisted, scarcity around money and family food.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 10th, career recognition withheld, work in hidden or low-status areas.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 4th, lack of domestic comfort, emotionally cold home.

ambiguity: 'Number 8' could be sign Scorpio or the 8th house; he says it is Indra's place so the sign is assumed.
classical_check: Differs: Saturn in Scorpio is classically neutral to mild, not a beggar placement; Uranus is not in the classical scheme.

hindi: वो साइड फेंक देता है बैठ जा इधर कुछ नहीं करना तूने तो उसको थोड़ा बहुत तो कुछ मिल जाता है
says: Indra throws Saturn aside and tells him to sit there and do nothing, yet Saturn still gets a little something, a small gain but without any real role or power.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Uranus's sign is sidelined: gets a minor share. The house shows what is minor: 3rd small efforts, 6th minor service, 11th small income.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 6th, held in a subordinate job with a small steady salary.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 11th, gains small but dependable, no big recognition.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन वहां पर वो चोरी चकारी करता है बहुत सीक्रेट बहुत नेगेटिविटी
says: But there Saturn resorts to petty theft and secret dealings, with a lot of secrecy and negativity, so Saturn in Indra's place shows hidden, dishonest and negative behaviour.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Scorpio gives covert and shady conduct. The house tells which area: 2nd money theft or hidden income, 7th secret partner, 12th hidden expenses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 2nd, hidden income or dishonest means for money.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 7th, secrecy and mistrust inside partnership.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 12th, concealed expenses and secret affairs.

ambiguity: A claim about character; he does not say it applies to every person.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब जाता है वरुण देव के यहां वरुण क्या है समुद्र समुद्र के नीचे ही धरती की सारी लक्ष्मी है
says: Saturn now goes to Varuna's place; Varuna is the ocean, and all the earth's Lakshmi (wealth) lies beneath the sea, so Saturn in Varuna's place sits on the greatest hidden treasure.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Neptune's sign (Libra in his scheme) is positioned over the deepest wealth. The house shows which wealth: 2nd stored money, 4th assets, 9th fortune, 11th gains.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 2nd, large accumulated savings and treasure-like family wealth.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 11th, big gains, profits from large, deep-pocketed sources.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 9th, fortune and inheritance on a large scale.

ambiguity: Which sign is Varuna's is not named in this sentence; Libra is taken from the 7-number link he gives next.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is exalted in Libra, and Libra is classically a strong wealth placement for Saturn.

hindi: पाताल का ही देवता भी है ये तो सब कुछ है लाजवाब है शनि सात नंबर का आपको राजयोग देता है मतलब धरती की पूरी धरती चिजी का राजा
says: Varuna is also the god of the netherworld, so he holds everything and is excellent; Saturn at number 7 gives a raja yoga, meaning you become king of the whole earth's resources.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Libra gives royal status: authority over land and resources. The house tells the domain: 1st personal command, 10th public office, 9th fortune and law, 4th land and property.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 10th, high public authority, rise to a powerful position.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 1st, personal command and an authority-bearing presence.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 4th, ownership of land and large property.

ambiguity: 'Number 7' could be the sign Libra or the 7th house; he ties it to Varuna's place so Libra is assumed.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is exalted in Libra and is called a strong raja-yoga giver there, especially with kendra placement.

hindi: आप संसार के अंदर मल्टी मिलिनेयर बिलिनियर बनते हैं शनि का सात नंबर से लिंक यदि है
says: If Saturn is linked with number 7, you become a multi-millionaire or even a billionaire in the world, so the Saturn-seven link is read as a very large wealth marker.
cells_derived_method: Saturn linked with Libra or the 7th house produces large wealth. The house placement controls how soon and how visibly: kendra and trikona show earlier and public wealth, dusthana shows delay or hidden wealth. This is a wealth-size claim, not investment advice.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 7th, wealth through partnerships and business abroad.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 10th, wealth through office, authority and large enterprises.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 2nd, wealth through savings and family assets.

ambiguity: 'Link' with number 7 is open: conjunction, aspect, placement in Libra or in the 7th house.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn in Libra (exalted) is a strong wealth placement, but billionaire level is his own claim.

hindi: दृष्टि भी अगर होगी इसकी तीसरी सातवी दसवीं यह तो यूनिवर्सल है इससे ज्यादा भी होती है लेकिन हम यही लेकर चलते हैं
says: An aspect also counts as a link; he uses Saturn's aspect on the 3rd, 7th and 10th from itself as the universal ones, noting it can have more aspects, but he will only work with these three.
cells_derived_method: Saturn aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th counted from where it sits. So Saturn in the 4th aspects the 6th, 10th and 1st; Saturn in the 1st aspects the 3rd, 7th and 10th; Saturn in the 10th aspects the 12th, 4th and 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Taurus in the 4th, aspect falls on the 6th, 10th and 1st houses.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius in the 1st, aspect falls on the 3rd, 7th and 10th houses.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 10th, aspect falls on the 12th, 4th and 7th houses.

ambiguity: Whether the aspect lands on houses or on signs is not stated; counts are from Saturn's own position.
classical_check: Agrees: classical Saturn aspects are 3rd, 7th and 10th; he says there are more, which differs from standard parashari.

hindi: तो शनि आपको राजा बनाएगा कैसे होते हैं राजा राजा को पार्टी करनी होती है गुण समझ ले राजा के राजा को पार्टी करनी होती है
says: Saturn will make you a king, and a king's defining quality is that he must host and enjoy parties, so the royal Saturn type is also a social, feasting, party-hosting person.
ambiguity: Is only the Saturn-Libra king in view or any Saturn raja yoga.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Modi says he is a servant and not a king, yet is a remarkable servant.

hindi: बृहस्पति है वो दाढ़ी है उनके थोड़ा सा पेट निकला है बॉडी देखो
says: He points out Jupiter's features in the person he is describing: a beard, a slightly protruding belly and a particular body type, as the physical signature of Jupiter.
ambiguity: Caption jumps between Jupiter and the person's body; unclear if 'beard' belongs to Jupiter or to Saturn.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the classical karaka of a heavy body and belly; beard is not classical.

gist: Remarks on bone density, DNA and how devoted the person has been to his mother.

hindi: जाके नहीं कि पैर दबाने मां के यहां से होती है भक्ति यहां से होता है प्रेम आप प्रेम कहां से करते हैं
says: Devotion starts from the mother's place and love comes from the same place, which he indicates in the body (the heart); the real source of love and bhakti is here, not in physical meeting.
cells_derived_method: If the heart and mother belong to the 4th house, then planets and signs in the 4th show the quality of devotion and love. Moon, Venus or Jupiter there give soft devotion; Saturn or Rahu there make love cold or complicated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 4th house in Cancer, very strong devotion and emotional bonding, mother-linked.
Derived: 4th house in Capricorn, love expressed through duty, reserved devotion.

ambiguity: He points to a body spot without naming it; heart and the 4th house are assumed, not stated.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th house is classically the heart, mother and inner peace.

gist: In long-distance love the boy and girl do not actually meet, it happens in the soul.
Students keep asking for their ishta deity in the class; he says he is tired of repeating it.
Keep your ishta in the heart, but which floor of the heart to keep it on, he does not know.
He does not know where to get so many ishtas; people have drunk his blood asking.
He says this is their love, they keep drinking his blood a little, which is why his body does not build up.

hindi: इसलिए शनि महाराज आपके वरुण देव के साथ जब होते हैं सर्वश्रेष्ठ उच्च का फल देते हैं
says: When Saturn is with Varuna (Neptune's sign) it gives its best, exalted-level results, the top result Saturn can give.
cells_derived_method: Saturn with Varuna is exalted-quality. The house sets the area of the best result: 1st self, 4th property, 7th partnership, 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 1st, self-made stature and respected personality.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 7th, a stable, high-status partner and business success.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 10th, peak career, authority and recognition.

ambiguity: 'With Varuna' may mean in Libra or conjoined with Neptune; Libra is assumed from his scheme.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is exalted in Libra.

hindi: इसके बाद यमराज है ये इसका भाई है मौत का घर है यह परम ज्ञानी बना देता है
says: After that comes Yamaraj (Pluto), Saturn's brother, the house of death, who turns the native into a supremely wise person.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Pluto's sign gives wisdom through the experience of death and loss. Which sign is Pluto's is not stated; in his scheme Pluto shares Aquarius. The house shows the area of lesson: 8th occult knowledge, 12th detachment, 9th philosophy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Aquarius in the 8th, depth in occult, research and transformation.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius in the 9th, philosophical wisdom, detached religion.

ambiguity: The sign number of Yama's house is not stated here; 'house of death' could even mean the 8th house; Aquarius is assumed from his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: Aquarius is Saturn's own sign classically, and the 8th house is the house of death.

hindi: यानी कि मौत आपसे सब कुछ संसार वापस ले लेगी जितनी चीज्जी संसार से बनी संसार विल टेक इट ब्रैक फ्रॉम यू
says: Death takes back from you everything you accumulated from the world; whatever was made from the world, the world will take back, which is the lesson of Yama and Saturn.
classical_check: Silent: a general philosophical statement, no classical rule behind it.

hindi: जब ये आ जाता है तो शनि ही ज्ञानी बना देता है
says: When Yama's influence arrives, Saturn is the one who makes the native a knowledgeable, wise person.
ambiguity: Repeats the earlier wisdom claim with Saturn named as the agent.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn is jnana-karaka in the sense of detachment.

hindi: शनि के द्वारा इफेक्टेड इफेक्टेड नव घर के लोग किसी को पूजा पाठ सूट नहीं करती भगवान को लाइफ से दफा कर दो
says: For people whose 9th house is affected by Saturn, ritual worship does not suit them, so for them it is better to drop God out of their routine life; this is a do-not about puja for Saturn-hit dharma houses.
cells_derived_method: Saturn influencing the 9th house, by sitting, aspecting or lording it, makes ritual puja and fixed religion a poor fit. The sign tells the flavour: in fire signs the person turns to philosophy, in earth signs to work as worship, in water signs to private devotion.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Libra in the 9th, formal religion replaced by ethics and justice as practice.
Derived: Saturn in Capricorn in the 9th, duty and discipline replace ritual.
Derived: Saturn in Pisces in the 9th, private inner devotion rather than rituals.

ambiguity: 'नव घर' could be the 9th house or 'new house'; 9th is assumed since he talks about worship. Statement is advice about religion, not a medical or financial claim.
classical_check: Differs: Saturn on the 9th is classically a weak religion factor but puja is not forbidden.

hindi: यानी जैसे ही आप तमस के इस देवता शनि के रूप में चलोगे
says: As soon as you follow Saturn's path, since Saturn is the deity of tamas (inertia and darkness), your style of life moves toward dropping God and ritual, but this is not atheism.
ambiguity: The caption cuts off; the consequence is taken from the neighbouring sentences.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is a tamasic planet in classical texts.

gist: He says he is not calling anyone an atheist; an atheist is one who does not banish God from life but abuses him.
Finishing the thought: the person who does not banish God from his life is not an atheist.
Two camps fight over whether God exists or not, one threatens to break the other's head.

hindi: शनि महाराज क्या करते हैं भैया दफा हो जाओ दोनों धरा उधर को निकल लो मुझे लेटना है जब आपने यह कर लिया तब शनि एक्टिवेट होगा
says: Saturn tells both quarrelling camps to get lost because he wants to lie down; only when you too stop taking sides in such fights does Saturn become active in your life, so withdrawing from argument is the key to activating Saturn.
ambiguity: 'This' refers to dropping the God-or-no-God quarrel; he does not say whether it is a remedy for a weak Saturn only.
classical_check: Silent: classical remedies for Saturn are service, charity and discipline; this detachment rule is his own.

hindi: शनि एक्टिवेशन वाले व्यक्ति को घर में पहुचा लगाने में भी प्रॉब्लम नहीं होगी तो जिंदगी भर पहुंचा नहीं लगाना पड़ेगा
says: A person whose Saturn is activated has no problem even mopping the floor at home; if you are willing to do the lowest work without shame, you will not have to do such work for your whole life, since humility toward menial work is Saturn's gate to rise.
ambiguity: 'Pochha' (mopping) is taken as a symbol of menial work, not literally only floor mopping.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: serving servants and doing menial work is a classical Saturn remedy.

hindi: उसको अंदर से फीलिंग य होनी चाहिए इट डजन मैटर मृत्यु का भी भय नहीं रहता ऐसे व्यक्ति को किंग बनाता है
says: The inner feeling must be 'it does not matter'; such a person loses even the fear of death, and Saturn then makes him a king, so inner detachment is what Saturn rewards with kingship.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Saturn classically is the karaka of detachment and fearlessness about death (ayu).

hindi: सारे सबसे बड़े से बड़े किंग शनि के हैं प्रॉपर्टी सारी शनि के पास है
says: The biggest kings of the world belong to Saturn and all property is in Saturn's hands, so Saturn is the karaka of rulers and land holdings.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn is a karaka of servants, land and lowly property; kingship is classically the Sun's.

hindi: जितने ये रॉकेट सॉकेट चल रहे सब शनि के पास है सारी स्पेस ट्रेवल सब शनि के पास है
says: All rockets and space travel come under Saturn, so Saturn also covers heavy technology, machines and distant-space enterprises.
classical_check: Differs: not in classical texts; machinery and iron are classical Saturn, space travel is a modern extension.

hindi: सारा सोना सारी शेयर मार्केट शनि के पास है किसी में राहू इवॉल्व है किसी में केतु
says: All gold and the whole share market are also Saturn's; in some of these Rahu is involved and in some Ketu. This is only a karaka statement about Saturn and not advice to invest.
ambiguity: Does not say which of the items are Rahu-linked and which Ketu-linked.
classical_check: Differs: gold is classically Sun or Jupiter; share markets are not classical.

hindi: आप सोचो धरती के ऊपर चिजी चीज्जी चीजें एनर्जी नहीं चिजी यह सारी शनि के पास है
says: Think of everything physical on earth, tangible things rather than energy; all of it lies with Saturn, so Saturn is the planet of matter and material objects.
ambiguity: 'Chiji' appears to mean physical things; caption is garbled.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Saturn is the classical karaka of solid, heavy and inert matter.

hindi: इन सबका किसी ना किसी से जब लिंक बनता है तब जाकर के शनि किंग है आपको किंग बनाता है अपनी लाइन का
says: When your chart links with any of these Saturn fields, then Saturn the king makes you king of your own line of work, so the link between your planets and a Saturn-ruled area decides the field in which you rise.
ambiguity: 'Link' is not defined, could be conjunction, aspect or sign relationship.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जितना यह सोशल मीडिया में लगे हैं जितने लोग यह स्टार्टअप्स कर रहे हैं सब शनि के पास है
says: Social media and startups, everybody working in them, fall under Saturn, so these modern businesses are Saturn fields too.
classical_check: Differs: modern fields, not classical; social media is usually Mercury or Rahu.

hindi: इसलिए आप को सेवा करनी है पत्नी को प्रेम देना है पत्नी को पति से प्रेम लेना है इसलिए रिस्पेक्ट देनी है
says: Because of all this, the way to approach Saturn is service: the husband must give love to the wife, the wife must take love from the husband, and respect has to be given, so service and respect in marriage are tied to Saturn's blessing.
cells_derived_method: If marriage respect is a Saturn matter then the 7th house sign shows the style: in earth signs respect shown through provision, in air signs through conversation, in water signs through emotional care, in fire signs through admiration.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 7th house in Taurus, respect is shown through material comfort and loyalty.
Derived: 7th house in Gemini, respect is shown through talking and listening.

ambiguity: He does not name the 7th house; marriage-based advice is placed in the 7th by assumption, and the link to Saturn is only implied by 'therefore'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A somewhat odd one-sided point: when a husband protects his wife, that itself is respect, because he is protecting only her.
He is not protecting the neighbour's wife, and his own wife would not let him anyway.

hindi: पति भी पत्नी के साथ पूरा प्रेम आदर और उसको धन की कमी ना दे दो बात विशेष समझ ले हर हालत में जरूरी है
says: The husband must give his wife full love, respect and never let her lack money, two points he stresses must be followed in every situation; this is a do-instruction for married men and not a chart rule.
ambiguity: Whether it is tied to any planetary position is unclear; 7th house assumed only as the marriage house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: फ्रीडम देने वाला व्यक्ति ही प्रेम कर सकता है आप जब किसी को धन देते हैं धन सबसे बड़ी चीज्जी की फ्रीडम है
says: Only a person who gives freedom can truly love; money is the biggest freedom, so giving money to your partner is giving freedom, which is the foundation of love.
ambiguity: A relationship principle, no chart element is named.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपने पैसे दिए और पत्नी से यह नहीं पूछा कहां खर्च रही है तो आपने उसे फ्रीडम दी है
says: If you give your wife money and do not ask her where she spends it, you have given her real freedom, and that is what counts as giving.
ambiguity: Marital advice, not tied to any planet.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वह आपको इनएविटेबली प्रेम करेगी रिस्पेक्ट करेगी आपकी क्योंकि ये आदमी मुझे फ्रीडम देता है
says: The wife will then inevitably love and respect you, because she feels this man gives her freedom, so the result of financial freedom is natural love and respect.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Such a wife is happy even with very little and in every situation.
A wife who stays with her husband even when he is wrong; husbands sometimes change for her once or twice.

hindi: जो राक्षसी हो और कुंडली में सत्यानाश हो तो उसको तो लात मार के नमस्ते करनी चाहिए व बात जायज है
says: If the wife is demonic in nature and her chart is a total wreck, he says you should kick her out and say goodbye, and that this is justified; it is a claim about leaving a spouse with a bad chart, with many conditions applying, and is not advice to act on.
ambiguity: 'Satyanash in the chart' is not defined; no specific planet or placement named.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not recommend separation purely from chart reading.

hindi: लेकिन उसके लिए समझदार होना बहुत जरूरी है स्त्री का तो मेनी कंडीशन अप्लाई है
says: He adds that wisdom is needed to judge this, and many conditions apply to the woman's case, so the leave-a-demonic-wife statement should not be applied loosely.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Otherwise life passes in bondage, with crying and suffering.

hindi: यह राहु है राहु महाराज सूर्य के जाते हैं नाश कर देते हैं चंदा मामा के जाते हैं नाश कर देते हैं मंगल के पास जाते हैं ऐसी तैसी कर देते हैं
says: Rahu going into the Sun's house destroys it, going into the Moon's house destroys it, and going into Mars's house wrecks it, so Rahu in the luminaries' or Mars's sign spoils their significations.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in a Sun sign weakens vitality, authority and father matters; in a Moon sign it disturbs mind and mother matters; in a Mars sign it wrecks courage and action.
