derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Leo in the 1st, ego and vitality confused, authority issues, father-linked trouble.
Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 4th, restless mind and disturbed home peace.
Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 3rd, courage and effort scrambled, impulsive and unproductive action.
Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 8th, compulsive and destructive intensity in hidden matters.

ambiguity: 'Goes to' is taken as Rahu in that planet's sign; he does not say conjunction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu with the Sun or Moon is the eclipse yoga, a classical affliction; Rahu in Mars's sign is not classically worse than elsewhere.

hindi: यह बेबसी जब हवा में बातें करती है बेस्ट काम करती है सब हवा में है भैया करना धरना कुछ नहीं सब बातें हैं
says: This helplessness works best when it speaks in the air: everything stays in talk, nothing actually done; Rahu's helpless energy is at its best when it is converted into words rather than action.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राहु तीन नंबर से लिंक हो जाए गजब के वक्ता होते हैं ऐसे लोग बना बोलने में चालने में
says: When Rahu links with number 3, the person is a superb orator, brilliant in speaking and in manoeuvring, so Rahu with the 3rd house or Gemini produces commanding speakers and smart operators.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in the 3rd or in Gemini gives speech power. Combined with the house, Gemini in the 3rd is double; in the 1st it shows a talker's personality, in the 10th a career in speech or media.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 3rd, very strong speaker, communications and media skills.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 1st, the persona is a talker, persuasive and cunning.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 10th, career built on speech, media or sales.

ambiguity: 'Number 3' could be the 3rd house or sign Gemini; both are recorded.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Rahu in the 3rd is classically good for courage and communication.

hindi: राहु ही ज्योतिषी बनाता है क्योंकि उसमें करना धरना कुछ नहीं
says: Rahu is what makes a person an astrologer, because the work is all talk and prediction with nothing physical to do, so Rahu is the karaka of astrologers and advisers.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give astrology to Mercury and Jupiter; Rahu as astrology karaka is a modern view.

hindi: हां सूर्य को खा जाएगा चंद्रमा को खा जाएगा जिसका सूर्य के साथ है उसकी आत्मा कुड़ती रहती है
says: Rahu will eat the Sun and eat the Moon; the person whose Sun is with Rahu has a soul that keeps writhing and burning inside.
cells_derived_method: Rahu with the Sun, or in the Sun's sign, keeps the soul and self-confidence in torment. The house shows the area of inner suffering: 1st self, 5th creative pride, 9th fortune and faith, 10th status.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Leo in the 1st, a constantly dissatisfied self, craving recognition.
Derived: Rahu in Leo in the 9th, faith and fatherly guidance in doubt, restless soul.
Derived: Rahu in Leo in the 10th, hunger for status that never feels satisfied.

ambiguity: 'With the Sun' means conjunction or Sun's sign, not defined.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun-Rahu is the classical grahan (eclipse) yoga, harming the father and self-confidence.

hindi: चंद्रमा की राशि के अंदर मन खिता सीधा बोल दो जिसका चंद्रमा के साथ रहु है तो महा खींचते हो पागल हो गए हो
says: With Rahu in the Moon's sign the mind is dragged around and stretched; put plainly, the person whose Moon is with Rahu is mentally pulled in all directions and feels like going crazy, which he describes in loose words and which is not a medical diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Cancer or with the Moon drags the mind. The house tells which area: 1st the self, 4th home and peace, 7th relations, 12th sleep.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 4th, restless mind, disturbed domestic peace.
Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 7th, emotional turbulence in partnerships.
Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 12th, anxious nights, restless sleep and imagination.

ambiguity: Caption contains mimicry sounds; the 'crazy' remark is loose language.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon-Rahu (also called grahan yoga) is classically a mind-disturbing combination.

hindi: जिसका सूर्य के साथ तुम्हारी आत्मा सड़ी कुड़ी रहती है यह शब्द इस्तेमाल करो
says: For the person with Rahu and Sun he suggests blunt words: the soul stays rotten and burning, so the harshest wording is to be used for the Sun-Rahu result.
ambiguity: Mostly a wording instruction; repeats the Sun-Rahu result.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical eclipse yoga reading.

hindi: वो आदमी मंगल के राशि के साथ है राहु तो बेबस कर देता है पराक्रम देता ही नहीं
says: The man whose Rahu is in Mars's sign is made helpless, and Rahu gives him no courage or effort at all; a garbled phrase about the stomach in the caption is ignored.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in a Mars sign removes drive. The house decides the area: 3rd effort, 6th fighting power, 10th career initiative, 1st physical vigour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 3rd, courage becomes secretive scheming rather than action.
Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 6th, no ability to fight competition, avoids confrontation.
Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 10th, career initiative stalls, ambition without push.

ambiguity: Caption about the 'stomach' is garbled and left out.
classical_check: Differs: classically Rahu in Mars's signs is considered to boost aggression and courage.

hindi: जो एक राहु को काउंटर करता मंगल जब वहां जाता है तो करता है ना अभी तो राहु यहां आया है इसके घर में आएगा मंगल का आसन मिल गया
says: Mars is the one planet that counters Rahu; when Rahu enters Mars's house it has got Mars's seat and so becomes dangerous, because this is the house of its natural counter.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Mars's sign is a special case: Mars's defence is missing there, so Rahu is unrestrained in courage, conflict and body matters. The house controls the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 3rd, unrestrained, reckless courage, risk-taking.
Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 8th, obsessive and dangerous hidden energies.

ambiguity: The caption is confused about who enters whose house; the reading follows the following sentences.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो क्या करेगा तबाही करेगा बेबस कर देगा बिल्कुल जड़ से बेबस कर देगा जब मंगल व जाएगा उसकी ऐसी तैसी फेर देगा
says: Rahu in Mars's house will cause havoc and make you helpless right down to the root, but when Mars goes to Rahu's house, Mars will wreck Rahu in turn.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Mars's sign makes the native helpless at the root; Mars in Rahu's sign (Virgo in his scheme) beats Rahu down. The house shows which area is affected in each case.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 1st, root-level helplessness in personal drive.
Derived: Mars in Virgo in the 6th, Mars overpowers Rahu's confusion in enemies and illness matters.
Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 10th, career moves become helpless and dependent.

ambiguity: Which sign counts as Rahu's house is not stated here; Virgo is assumed from his scheme.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अकेला मंगल ही फेर सकता राहु की ऐसी और कोई नहीं फेर सकता
says: Only Mars can wreck Rahu, no other planet can do it, so Mars is the sole planet that can neutralise Rahu.
classical_check: Differs: classically Jupiter's aspect is the usual Rahu-pacifier.

hindi: लेकिन ये जाता है उसके घर कता आज तो मजा आ गया भाई आज तो साले सारे बदले लूंगा मैं तो
says: But Rahu is the one who goes to Mars's house and gloats that today he will take full revenge, showing Rahu in Mars's sign as the one that gets its payback.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Mars's sign takes its revenge on Mars's themes: courage, siblings, property, blood-linked matters. House gives the target area.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Aries in the 3rd, courage and siblings shaken.
Derived: Rahu in Scorpio in the 4th, property and domestic peace disturbed.

ambiguity: Dramatised speech; the claim is a repeat of the earlier Rahu-in-Mars-sign result.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पराक्रम हटा देता है इसलिए राहु अगर यहां हो और अच्छा फल लेना हो तो ज्यादा पराक्रम मत करो बेबस से बैठ जाओ
says: Rahu removes courage and effort, so if Rahu is in Mars's sign and you want a good result, do not push your effort and just sit helplessly; a do-not on exertion for this placement.
ambiguity: 'यहां' (here) is read as Rahu in Mars's sign from the preceding sentences.
classical_check: Differs: no classical text advises idleness for Rahu in Mars's signs.

hindi: कुछ नहीं करना हार्ड वर्क नहीं करना हार्ड वर्क आपने किया तो आपकी लंका लग जाएगी मजे मजे मेहनत करते हुए चलो राम राम चलेंगे
says: Do not do hard work; if you do, your 'Lanka' will burn, so work gently and cheerfully at an easy pace, chanting Ram Ram as you go, and treat this as a do-not on hard work for the Rahu-in-Mars case.
ambiguity: Whether it applies only to Rahu in Mars's sign or to all Rahu cases is not clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब मंगल शनि के घर आया 10 नंबर में आया तो क्या करेगा शनि मेरा आसन ले लो भाई उच्च का फल देना मेरे को जला मत खाक कर देना
says: When Mars comes to Saturn's house at number 10, Saturn says take my seat and give me exalted results, just do not burn me to ash; Mars in Capricorn is welcomed by Saturn and gives exalted-level results.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Capricorn is exalted and powerful. The house shows where the power lands: 1st body and drive, 4th land, 7th partnership energy, 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 10th, peak career drive and authority.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 4th, strong property and land holdings, with domestic firmness.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 1st, strong body, disciplined energy.

ambiguity: '10 number' is Capricorn, which is also where Mars is exalted classically; confirmed consistent.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn.

hindi: ठीक हो गया मंगल से डरता है वो आग है ना आग आई है पेट्रोल के घर वो बचता फिरे
says: Saturn is afraid of Mars because Mars is fire and Saturn is like petrol; when fire comes to petrol's house the petrol runs and dodges, so Saturn avoids Mars's fire.
ambiguity: An illustration only, the claim is that Saturn is cautious of Mars.
classical_check: Differs: classically Saturn and Mars are enemies, with no comment on who fears whom.

hindi: अब पेट्रोल आ गया आग के घर तो क्या करेगा ब्लास्ट कर देगा शनि कहता पूरे बदले लूंगा तेरे से तो मैं ऐसी की तैसी तेरे घर आया हूं
says: When Saturn (petrol) enters Mars's house (fire) it causes a blast, as Saturn says he will take full revenge now that he is in Mars's house; Saturn in Mars's sign is explosive and destructive.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Aries (debilitated) or Scorpio produces explosive, reactive results. The house shows where the explosion happens: 6th conflicts, 10th career crash, 8th sudden events.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Aries (debilitated) in the 10th, volatile career, clashes with authority.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 6th, strong power to destroy enemies but explosive conflicts.
Derived: Saturn in Scorpio in the 8th, sudden upheavals and secret crises.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn in Aries is debilitated and weak, which matches an unstable result.

hindi: इसलिए राहु जब बुध के य आता है हवा तो अपनी चलती है भाई लाजवाब काम करता है यह भी राजा ही बना देता है
says: Rahu coming into Mercury's house works excellently because air does its own thing there, and this too makes a king; Rahu in Mercury's sign gives royal results.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Gemini or Virgo gives intellect and trading strength that lifts the person to command. The house shows the field: 2nd speech and wealth, 3rd communication, 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 10th, a leader in communications, media, trade.
Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 2nd, wealth through analytical, service or trading work.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini in the 3rd, strong initiative through writing and speech.

ambiguity: Virgo may be Rahu's own sign in his scheme, so the effect there may differ.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Rahu in Gemini is classically considered favourable for intellect and trade.

hindi: राहु जब बृहस्पति के घर पर आता है तो तबाह कर देता है ज्ञान को सत्या नाश कर देता है नष्ट कर देता है
says: When Rahu comes to Jupiter's house it ruins knowledge, destroys and wipes it out; Rahu in Jupiter's sign damages wisdom and learning.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in a Jupiter sign damages knowledge, guidance and faith. The house shows which: 2nd family learning, 5th education, 9th teachers and dharma, 4th schooling.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 5th, disrupted education, unorthodox or misguided learning.
Derived: Rahu in Pisces in the 9th, confusion in faith and guru relationships.
Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 2nd, family values and teaching lost or distorted.

ambiguity: Pisces is also Ketu's sign in his scheme, so the effect there may be mixed.
classical_check: Agrees: Guru-Chandal yoga is classically a damaging combination for wisdom.

hindi: सबसे बड़ी बात पित दोष लगा देता है राहु अकेला ग्रह है जो पित्रों का दोष लगा देता है
says: The biggest thing is that Rahu in Jupiter's house gives pitru dosha, and Rahu is the only planet that can put ancestral affliction on a chart.
cells_derived_method: Rahu on Jupiter or in a Jupiter sign marks pitru dosha. The house shows the area of ancestral burden: 9th fortune, 5th children, 4th home.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 9th, strongest form: fortune and father line blocked.
Derived: Rahu in Pisces in the 5th, ancestral burden through children and progeny.
Derived: Rahu in Sagittarius in the 4th, ancestral issues around the home and land.

ambiguity: Pitru dosha is treated as only from Rahu-Jupiter; classical texts also use the Sun and the 9th house.
classical_check: Differs: classically pitru dosha comes from the Sun and Saturn or the 9th house affliction, not Rahu alone.

gist: Garbled phrase 'tabhi hoga jab hara li hoga' (it will happen only when ... green?), meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: अगर बृहस्पति की दृष्टि राहु के ऊपर है तो फिर भी पितरों को ज्ञान देकर कृपा देक ठीक किया जा सकता है
says: If Jupiter only aspects Rahu, the ancestral problem can still be fixed by giving knowledge to the ancestors and winning their grace, so aspect makes it curable through remedy.
ambiguity: 'Giving knowledge to ancestors' is not defined: rites, scriptural recitation or teaching others in their name.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Jupiter's aspect is classically a pacifier of Rahu's malefic effect.

hindi: लेकिन राहु का बृहस्पति से लिंक हो गया तो रुला देगा पितरों का दो हो
says: But if Rahu is directly linked with Jupiter (not just aspected), the ancestors' dosha will make you cry, so a full link is the severe version.
ambiguity: 'Link' vs 'aspect' difference: link taken as conjunction or sign placement.
classical_check: Agrees: Guru-Chandal yoga by conjunction is classically severe.

gist: A lovely question: do only men get pitru dosha or women too.

hindi: जेंट्स को ही पितृ दोष लगता है लेडी को पितृ दोष शादी के बाद एक्टिवेट होता है पति मिलने के बाद
says: Pitru dosha applies to men; for a woman it becomes active only after marriage, once she has got a husband.
ambiguity: Whether the woman's own chart dosha is meant or her husband's.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts apply pitru dosha to both sexes.

hindi: क्योंकि तब तलक उसको एक्स और वाय क्रोमोसोम का यूनियन हुआ ही नहीं है जब तक संभोग नहीं हुआ तब तक उसका वाय क्रोमोसोम से लिंक बना नहीं
says: His reasoning is that until a woman unites with a man, her X chromosome has not joined a Y chromosome; until intercourse she has no link to the Y line, which carries the ancestral lineage in his view.
ambiguity: A biology-style argument given for an astrological claim; not verifiable.
classical_check: Silent: a modern rationale not found in any classical text.

hindi: इसीलिए स्त्री का जो पितृ दोष है व पुरुष के एक्टिवेशन के बाद ही होता है
says: Therefore a woman's pitru dosha arises only after the man's activation, meaning it is triggered through her husband's lineage and not before marriage.
ambiguity: Consequence of the previous sentence; not clear if it concerns the husband's chart.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Joke about kanjak (girls worshipped) being for women while men are only 'kanjar', and men with two or three girlfriends; the caption ends mid-sentence.

hindi: जिस लड़की के दो तीन बॉयफ्रेंड हो या जिस लड़के के दो तीन गर्लफ्रेंड हो वह सबको पितर दोष लगेगा
says: A girl who has two or three boyfriends, or a boy who has two or three girlfriends, will get pitru dosha; multiple partners are given as a cause of ancestral affliction, a conduct-based rule rather than a planetary one.
ambiguity: Caption begins mid-sentence after a music tag; 'all of them' refers to the people with multiple partners.
classical_check: Silent: classical pitru dosha comes from planetary afflictions to the 9th house or Sun, not from partner count.

hindi: जब स्त्री संतान पैदा करती है तो ... हम अपनी मां के शरीर से बने हैं मां की हड्डियां ली है मां का रक्त लिया है हमने मां की बुद्धि ली है
says: Every child is built from the mother's body: her bones, blood, intellect and nerves are taken in the womb, so the child is physically a part of its mother.
ambiguity: A biological premise used to explain the woman's role in ancestral karma; no chart element is stated.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the Moon and the 4th house are the classical mother indicators.

gist: Biology aside: the mother transferred the father's sperm DNA so one child is male and his sister female; caption has a garbled word.
We are born as a 'pind' (embryo-body) and not from an egg like animals; monkeys and giraffes are born the same way.

hindi: इसलिए मां जब हमसे ज्यादा जुड़ती है तो जायज है क्योंकि हम उसके शरीर का हिस्सा है वो कहती है मेरे शरीर का हिस्सा है इसलिए स्त्री को बहुत कुछ बनाने की इच्छा नहीं
says: It is natural for the mother to be more attached to us because we are part of her body, and for this reason a woman does not have a strong urge to go on creating many other things.
ambiguity: A general remark on women; not linked to any planet or house.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A woman says she made a baby, a miracle.
A man says he has built nothing, so he will build houses, buildings, make a name, set fires; hence his life has a big gap and woman is steadier by nature.

hindi: स्त्री का डीएनए सेम है वह एक्स एक्स ही है उसने बेटा पैदा किया तो वाय क्रोमोसोम लेकिन मां के सेल बच्चे के अंदर है चाहे बेटा है चाहे बेटी है
says: A woman's DNA is XX; when she bears a son he gets a Y chromosome, but the mother's cells stay inside the child whether it is a son or a daughter, so the mother's line is carried in every child.
ambiguity: Biological claim used as a premise for ancestral karma.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब पुरुष का डीएनए पत्नी के साथ जुड़ा संभोग हुआ तो उसका डीएनए भी स्त्री ने रख लिया अब वह पुरुष को भी यहां से सोच के चेंज कर सकती है
says: After intercourse the wife also retains the husband's DNA, so she can influence and even change the man by her thinking from within her body; this is his claim for the wife's hold over the husband.
ambiguity: The 7th house is the marriage house; he does not name it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: स्त्री यहां से जिस पुरुष के लिए नेगेटिव सोचती है जिस बच्चे के लिए नेगेटिव सोचती है उसका नास पिट जाता है उसके पास यहां से इतनी बड़ी शक्ति है
says: If a woman thinks negatively about a man or a child, that person is ruined, because she has this great power from within her body; a woman's negative thought is treated as destructive to those linked with her.
ambiguity: No chart link is given.
classical_check: Silent: it resembles the 'shaap' (curse) idea in tradition but is his own framing.

hindi: इसलिए ये संकेतिक बात है स्त्री को शांत रखो मस्त रखो माता को खुद नहीं पता वो क्या चाह लेगी और आपका नाश पिट जाएगा
says: So the symbolic advice is to keep the woman calm and happy, since even the mother does not know what she might wish and your ruin could follow; this is a do-instruction to please the mother and wife.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: classical texts also say a mother's blessing or curse is powerful.

hindi: इसीलिए कहते हैं आशीर्वाद तो वो अपने पति को भी आशीर्वाद दे रही है क्योंकि उसका भी डीएनए उसके अंदर सुरक्षित है
says: This is why blessing works from her: she also blesses her husband, since his DNA too is kept safe inside her, so a wife's blessing carries real force for the husband.
ambiguity: The sentence straddles two time chunks (1:13:06 and 1:14:04) in the caption.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दादी पैदा हुई थी रेडीमेड सारे एग लेकर के दादी फिर पोती भी उसी में थी दादी के अंदर ही मां पैदा करने का एग था
says: The grandmother is born with all her eggs ready-made, so the granddaughter was already inside the grandmother; the egg that would make the mother existed in the grandmother's body, showing the lineage is passed down the female line.
ambiguity: Biological claim as a supporting premise.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब उसका विवाह हुआ तो मां पैदा हुई एग ऑलरेडी था दादी के पैदा होने से पहले ... दादी के एग में पोती थी यह ट्रांसफर हो रहा है
says: When the grandmother married, the mother was born from an egg that already existed before the grandmother herself was born, and that same egg contained the granddaughter, so this DNA keeps transferring through women.
ambiguity: Repeats the previous row with the mother and daughter stage added.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सिर्फ यह डीएनए जुड़ा हुआ है पोता बाहर से मिलेगा नाती बाहर से मिलेगा नातिन है इसलिए स्त्री का बहुत लफड़ा है
says: Only this female-line DNA is truly connected; the grandson or daughter's son will come in from outside, which is why a woman's side of ancestral matters is complicated.
ambiguity: Captions mix pota, nati and natin; the point is only that male descendants come from another line.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए खुश रखो दया मांगो दया बड़ा कटोरा ले ले हम सब दया मांगेंगे
says: Therefore keep the women happy and ask for their mercy with a big bowl in hand, as all of us will need it; keeping the female relatives pleased is the advised conduct.
ambiguity: Partly humorous in tone.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यही राहु यदि शुक्र के घर में आता है तो हृदय में आ गया मान के चलो
says: If Rahu comes into Venus's house, take it that Rahu has entered the heart; Rahu in Venus's sign afflicts the emotional heart and love matters. This is a feeling-level claim, not a medical statement about the physical heart.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in a Venus sign disturbs love, pleasure and relationships. The house shows the area: 4th inner peace, 5th romance, 7th marriage, 12th bed pleasures.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Taurus in the 5th, intense, obsessive romantic attachments and creative cravings.
Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 7th, unconventional or foreign partner, restless in relationships.
Derived: Rahu in Libra in the 4th, inner peace tied to wanting luxuries and comfort.

ambiguity: Whether 'Venus's house' includes Libra if Neptune holds it in his scheme; both recorded.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Rahu in Venus's signs is classically read as strong material desire.

gist: A question from the audience: how can ladies serve their ancestors.

hindi: जेंट्स तो मजबूर है करना पड़ेगा पजनी के लिए भाग्य के लिए यश के लिए वृद्धि के लिए
says: Men have no choice and must serve the ancestors, for progeny, fortune, fame and growth; pitru seva is compulsory for men and gives children, luck, reputation and progress.
ambiguity: The caption word 'pajani' is garbled and read as progeny; 9th and 5th are inferred from fortune and children, not named.
classical_check: Agrees: ancestral rites for progeny and fortune are classical, linked to the 9th and 5th.

hindi: स्त्री तो अपने तौर पर दोष पुरुष की ओर से लेगी ही नहीं स्त्री को जो दोष लगेगा वह स्त्री वाली जो लीने है उसी से लगेगा
says: A woman will not by herself take any dosha from the man's side; the dosha that touches a woman comes only through her own female line.
ambiguity: This seems to contradict his earlier claim that a woman's pitru dosha gets activated through the husband; he reconciles it in the next sentences.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पुरुष की तरफ की लीने का दोष स्त्री को तब लगेगा जब उसके जीवन में पुरुष आ गया बेटा पैदा हो गया पति मिल गया
says: The male-line dosha touches a woman only when a man comes into her life, that is when a son is born or she gets a husband; the male-line dosha is triggered by the arrival of a man.
ambiguity: 7th and 5th are inferred from husband and son, not named.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पति मिलने के बाद बच्चे हैं कि नहीं है लेकिन आएगा वह पुरुष के द्वारा ही यानी वो एक्टिवेट हुआ है पुरुष के जीवन में
says: Whether or not she has children after getting a husband, the dosha comes only through the man, meaning it gets activated in the man's life; children are not required for it to act.
ambiguity: Unclear whether it is activated in the husband's chart or in the wife's chart.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: किसी की कुंडली में शुक्र बहुत बेहतरीन स्थिति में बैठा है और पत्नी आई नहीं है तब तक हो सकता वो बेरोजगार हो और व धक्के खाता हुआ आदमी शादी के इमीडिएट बाद पांच गुना ज्यादा कमाने लगे
says: A man with a very well placed Venus may be jobless and struggling until his wife arrives and then earn five times more right after marriage; Venus strong but waiting for marriage to give its result.
cells_derived_method: A strong Venus gives its results after marriage. Dignity and house change how: Venus in Pisces (exalted), Taurus or Libra (own) is strong; the 7th, 2nd and 11th houses carry the money result of marriage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in Pisces in the 7th, exalted, rise in finances and status only after marriage.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus in the 2nd, family and wealth improve once a spouse comes.
Derived: Venus in own sign Libra in the 11th, income grows after marriage, through spouse's network.

ambiguity: 'Very good position' is not defined; it could mean dignity or house.
classical_check: Agrees in part: Venus is the classical karaka of marriage and a strong Venus gives gains with the spouse.

hindi: तो कहेंगे पत्नी बड़ी भाग्यशाली आई नहीं उसके खुद की कुंडली के अंदर योग है कि उसका प्लेनेट पत्नी आने के बाद पावर पकड़ेगा
says: People will say the wife is lucky, but it is not her luck; the man's own chart has a yoga in which his planet gains power after the wife arrives, so the credit belongs to his own horoscope.
ambiguity: He does not say which planet gains power.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा भी हो सकता है उसकी शादी फेल हो जाए लेकिन उसकी शादी हुई है इसलिए वो रॉकेट बन गया ऐसा हो सकता है तो वो खुद की कुंडली में होता है
says: It may be that the marriage fails and yet, because the marriage happened, he shot up like a rocket; this too is written in his own chart and has nothing to do with the wife's fortune.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपके जीवन में पितरों की कृपा स्त्रियों ने लेनी तो अपने पितरों का ध्यान करें दक्षिण दिशा की ओर मुख करके हाथ जोड़ कर के पितरों का स्मरण करें बस खत्म
says: For women to get ancestors' grace, remember your own ancestors by facing south with folded hands; that is all, nothing more is needed.
ambiguity: 'Own ancestors' for a woman may mean her maiden family's or her husband's; he says her own.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the south is classically the direction of ancestors (Yama).

hindi: अग्नि हाथ में होनी चाहिए पुरुष को भी यही कार्य करना है अग्नि हाथ में हो दिया बत्ती जो मर्जी हो साउथ की ओर फेस करके
says: A flame must be in the hand, a lamp or wick as you like, and men also do the same thing facing south, so the ancestor remembrance uses a lit lamp for both sexes.
ambiguity: Whether a lamp, wick or any flame works; he says whichever you like.
classical_check: Agrees in part: lighting a lamp for ancestors facing south is a common practice.

hindi: पूछ पितरों से कृपा मांगे कि हे पित्रों कृपा करो बस खत्म आपके पि श्रद्धा के ऊपर काम करते हैं आपको गलत आता करना सही आता ये उनको लेना देना नहीं
says: Ask the ancestors for grace with the simple prayer 'O ancestors, be kind', and that is all; ancestors act on your faith, and whether you know the method rightly or wrongly makes no difference to them.
classical_check: Differs: classical shraddha has fixed rules, but he says sincerity is enough.

hindi: इसमें संध्याकाल और सुबह संध्याकाल का कोई लेनदेन नहीं सब फंग है
says: There is no connection with twilight or morning timing here, all that is just a fuss; the ancestor prayer has no fixed time of day.
ambiguity: 'Fung' in the caption is garbled and read as fuss or noise.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts prescribe specific times (aparahna for shraddha).

gist: Abroad people put food and flowers on elders' graves out of faith; Muslims do the same at a pir baba's tomb.

hindi: हमारे हिंदुओं के मानसिक डायरेक्शन से ही काम हो जाए जैसे मर्जी मानो सारा खेल मानसिकता का है
says: For Hindus too the result comes from mental direction alone; believe whatever way you like, because the whole game is one of mindset, so intention matters more than ritual form.
ambiguity: The sentence starts in the previous chunk.
classical_check: Differs: classical shraddha stresses procedure along with faith.

hindi: इसलिए स्त्री को पुरुष की ओर से पितृ दोष लगने के स्याप से दूर है मामला ही कोई नहीं
says: So a woman is far from the curse of getting pitru dosha through the man's side, there is no such issue at all; he now says a woman need not worry about the husband's ancestral dosha, which sits uneasily with his earlier claim.
ambiguity: Conflicts with the earlier statement that a woman's dosha is activated after marriage through the husband.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts say a wife shares the husband's ritual obligations.

hindi: किसी के जीवन में यह समस्या है कि स्त्री के पास पुरुष नहीं है पूजा करे कौन कोई अनजान भी उस स्त्री की तरफ से विचार करके मन से कर सकता है दोष दूर हो जाएगा
says: If a woman has no man to perform the rite, even a stranger can do it in her name with sincere thought, and the dosha is removed; a proxy puja is accepted.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts expect a son or male relative to perform it.

gist: A deep and sweet question: whether to put up photographs of the departed or not.

hindi: आपके घर के किसी भी गुजरे हुए व्यक्ति की फोटोग्राफ या साजो सामान आपने अपने घर में साउथ वेस्ट के अलावा कहीं भी रख दिया है तो पितृ दोष है
says: If photographs or belongings of any departed family member are kept anywhere in the house other than the south-west, it becomes pitru dosha; south-west is the only permitted place for the dead's items.
ambiguity: This is a vastu claim; the later sentences also name south-south-west as a fault, which conflicts with 'south-west only'.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the south-west is the classical vastu direction of ancestors (Nairritya).

hindi: विशेष तौर पर आपको वेस्ट नॉर्थ वेस्ट में अगर पितरों का सामान रख दिया कुछ भी ये भाऊजी की साइकिल थी ये भाऊजी का पलंग था
says: Especially if ancestors' things, such as the elder's bicycle or bed, are kept in the west-north-west part of the house, pitru dosha will arise; the WNW sector is singled out as a strong cause.
ambiguity: Vastu direction claim with no planet or house; 'bhauji' is a family elder.
classical_check: Silent: classical vastu puts the north-west with Vayu (air), not with ancestors.

hindi: ईस्ट साउथ ईस्ट में है तो दोष लग जाएगा नॉर्थ ईस्ट में रख दिया तो दोष लग जाएगा साउथ साउथ वेस्ट में रख दिया दोष लग जाएगा
says: If kept in the east-south-east, in the north-east, or in the south-south-west, the dosha will also arise; so he now lists ESE, NE and SSW as faulty places for ancestors' belongings.
ambiguity: South-south-west conflicts with the earlier 'only south-west is allowed'; he may mean a narrow sector around the exact south-west.
classical_check: Agrees in part: the north-east is classically the God and pure-water zone, so ancestors' items are not kept there.

hindi: पितर बहुत भयंकर चीज है फोटोग्राफ फोटोग्राफ आपको पितरों की कई स्थान में रख सकते हैं लेकिन किसी को पता ही नहीं
says: Ancestors are a fearsome matter, and photographs of ancestors could be placed in several spots, but nobody knows the correct rules, so wrong placement is common.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled; unclear what 'several places' means.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Aspirin analogy: people take it for headache but it only thins the blood, circulation improves and the headache goes away as a by-product.

hindi: इसी तरह पितरों का कुछ पल्ले नहीं पड़ रहा ना तो साउथ वेस्ट में रख लो कार्य की अपॉर्चुनिटी चाहिए नॉर्थ में रखो आशीर्वाद जैसी कृपा चाहिए
says: Likewise, if the ancestor rules are not clear, keep the items in the south-west; if you want opportunity in work keep them there, and if you want blessing-type grace keep them in the north.
ambiguity: The assignment of south-west to work opportunity and north to blessing is not clear from the garbled caption; the following 'west' clause is lost.
classical_check: Differs: the north is classically linked to Kubera (wealth), not to ancestors.

gist: Garbled clause about keeping items in the west ('west mein rakho aisi hoti hai y photo...'); the intended result cannot be recovered.

hindi: अगर आपने वेस्ट नॉर्थ वेस्ट साउथ साउथ वेस्ट ईस्ट साउथ ईस्ट में रख दिया तो आपको पित दोष लग गया आपको लगना ही लगना है और नॉर्थ ईस्ट में भी नहीं रखना
says: If you keep ancestors' items or photographs in WNW, SSW or ESE you will certainly get pitru dosha, and do not keep them in the north-east either; he repeats the prohibited sectors as a do-not list.
ambiguity: Repeats the earlier direction list.
classical_check: Agrees in part for north-east; other sectors silent.

hindi: प्रॉपर नॉर्थ बढ़िया वो अलग अलग कारण पित्रों की कृपा मिलती है
says: A proper north placement is fine, and different placements give the ancestors' grace for different reasons, so each direction yields its own kind of ancestral blessing.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Final caption fragment ('baney bola ubh chahi bhi ha agar maan lo') is garbled and cuts off.

hindi: अग्नि है ही नहीं तो 10 उंगली के पर्व नाभि प लगा लिए नाभि में अग्नि है हमारे और पितरों का ध्यान कर लिया
says: If no flame is available for the ancestor rite, touch the ten finger joints to the navel, since the fire is already in our navel, and remember the ancestors; the navel substitutes for a lamp.
ambiguity: 'Parv' of the fingers is read as the finger joints; the exact hand position on the navel is not described.
classical_check: Silent: the navel as the seat of fire (Manipura) is yogic, not from the shraddha texts.

hindi: बिना कौन ढूंढता फिरे माचिस दिया सलाई धूप अगरबत्ती नहीं है चलो कोई बात नहीं रात का टाइम है सफर में जा रहे हैं साउथ की ओर ढूंढा कंपास और करके नाभी पर हाथ रख के कर लिया प्रणाम
says: No need to hunt for matches, lamp or incense; if you forgot it, or are travelling at night, find south with a compass, put your hand on the navel and bow, and the remembrance of ancestors is complete.
classical_check: Differs: classical rites require offerings; this is his simplified version.

gist: A very deep question: pitru dosha is present although my parents are alive, can this happen.

hindi: ऐसा होता है मेरे भाई को नहीं है लेकिन मुझे है यह कुंडली की प्रपोजिशनिंग है
says: Yes it happens that pitru dosha is in your chart even while your parents are alive, and your brother may not have it though you do; it depends on the positioning of the planets in each one's own chart.
classical_check: Agrees: pitru dosha is a feature of the individual chart, not of whether parents are alive.

gist: He says he has already given a class on ancestors and can do more, but this is a very deep question.

hindi: हो सकता है आपके पापा जिंदा है लेकिन आपको दोष समझ आ गया तो अपने उपाय कर लो ताकि आपके अपने बच्चों से आपको दुख ना मिले यह गारंटी है
says: Even if your father is alive, once you see the dosha in your own chart, do your own remedies so that your children do not give you sorrow; he calls this a guarantee, which is a tradition claim and not a measured result.
ambiguity: 5th house is inferred from children; he does not name it.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: pitru dosha is classically linked with trouble from children.

hindi: पित दो तो आपके पापा आपसे दुखी होंगे यह गारंटी है क्योंकि उनके भाग में बच्चों का सुख नहीं मिलेगा तो आपको भी अपने बच्चे का द्वारा नहीं मिलेगा
says: If you have pitru dosha then your father will be unhappy with you, guaranteed, because children's happiness is not in his fate and so you too will not get happiness from your own child.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled; the chain of father then child is read as a linked fate across generations.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप अपना पितृ दोष कराया हो बाप का मत करना बाप जिंदा है उसके मरने के बाद कर लेना
says: Get your own pitru dosha remedy done, but do not do the father's while he is alive; do his after he dies, so your remedy is separate from your father's.
ambiguity: The sentence runs on to the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees in part: shraddha for a living father is classically not performed.

hindi: आप कर सकते हो पिता जिंदा है तब भी कर सकते हो क्योंकि आपके स्वयं के जीवन के लिए हो रहा है वो पिता के साथ मत जाना
says: You can do it even while your father is alive because it is for your own life, but do not go along with the father; go on your own.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts say the father performs it first while alive.

hindi: पिता के साथ जाओगे तो आप कर नहीं सकते यह बात पक्की है क्योंकि पित्र पहले पिता को पहचानेंगे आपके फिर बाद में आप आओगे
says: If you go with your father you cannot do it, he says definitely, because the ancestors will first recognise the father and only afterwards you, so the father's rite takes priority and yours is displaced.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: गया श्राद्ध करना सर्वोत्तम है कहीं और करना हो तो भी कोई दोष नहीं लेकिन गया इ लास्ट
says: Doing shraddha at Gaya is the best option; doing it elsewhere is also not a fault, but Gaya is the last and final answer, so go straight to Gaya and finish it.
classical_check: Agrees: Gaya is the classical foremost place for ancestral rites.

gist: Medical analogy: you may be cured by X-ray, or ultrasound or CT scan, but just do the MRI, which is costly but done once; likewise go to Gaya and be done.

hindi: गया में पिता के साथ नहीं जा सकते आप पिता ही करेगा फिर आप नहीं कर सकते तो उसकी भ्रांति बन गई है कि पिता के रहते कैसे करोगे
says: At Gaya you cannot go with your father, because the father will do it and then you cannot; so the common belief arose that you cannot do it while your father is living, which he says is a misunderstanding.
classical_check: Differs: traditional belief is that the son does Gaya shraddha after the father's death.

gist: He says it is just a tangle of words and misinformation: do not take the father along and you can do it.

hindi: यह राहु जब छ नंबर राहु नंबर राशि में आ जाता है तो यह अपने मुखिया के घर में ही है कोई दोष नहीं है
says: When Rahu comes into the sign numbered 6, which is Rahu's own number-sign, it is in its own chief's house and there is no dosha; Rahu in Virgo is at home.
cells_derived_method: Rahu in Virgo is at ease, so its harm is reduced. The house shows where it works well: 3rd and 6th give effort and service gains, 10th gives work through analysis or trade, 7th gives a practical partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 6th, strong over enemies and competition, wins through detail and service.
Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 10th, steady career through analysis, health or trade work.
Derived: Rahu in Virgo in the 7th, a practical, service-minded partner.

ambiguity: Caption is garbled ('six number, Rahu number, rashi'); sign 6 is Virgo in his numbering and Rahu's own sign in his scheme, but he later calls Saturn's house 'the master's house', so which house he means by 'chief' is unclear.
classical_check: Silent: Virgo is not Rahu's sign in classical texts; some later texts treat Rahu as strong in Virgo.

hindi: राहु का मतलब यह होता है कि चंदा मामा धरती और सूरज के बीच में आ जाते हैं तो उसको राहु कहते हैं यानी सूरज को ग्रहण लग गया
says: Rahu means the event in which the Moon comes between the Earth and the Sun, so that the Sun is eclipsed; Rahu is defined as the solar eclipse event.
ambiguity: Strictly the Moon between Earth and Sun is a solar eclipse caused near the lunar nodes; he is simplifying.
classical_check: Differs: classically Rahu is the ascending lunar node, a point, not the eclipse event; the node is related to eclipses.

hindi: राहु एक्चुअली कहीं ग्रह एजिस्ट नहीं करता यह छाया ग्रह है यह सोलर एक्लिप्स कॉज कर देता है
says: Rahu does not actually exist as a physical planet anywhere, it is a shadow planet that causes the solar eclipse; it is a mathematical point and not a body.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu and Ketu are classically chhaya grahas (shadow planets) with no physical body.

gist: Description of an eclipse: sunlight stops reaching Earth, the huge Sun goes black and darkness falls on the earth.

hindi: यानी राहु सूरज को खा गया तो आपकी आत्मा तक को खा जाता है
says: When Rahu swallows the Sun it eats even your soul, so a Sun afflicted by Rahu damages the soul and sense of self.
cells_derived_method: Rahu with or on the Sun drains the soul and identity. The house shows where: 1st self, 5th creative self-expression, 9th faith, 10th public standing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Leo in the 1st, an empty or divided sense of self.
Derived: Rahu in Leo in the 9th, faith and father-line weakened.
Derived: Rahu in Leo in the 10th, hollow public status, attracted by prestige.

ambiguity: Repeats the earlier Sun-Rahu claim in different words.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun-Rahu is the classical grahan yoga.

hindi: राहु और कौन खाता है उसे चंद्रमा चंद्रमा में कौन है सारे पितर रहते चंद्रमा पर
says: The other thing Rahu devours is the Moon, and all the ancestors live on the Moon, so a Rahu-hit Moon also disturbs the ancestors' home.
cells_derived_method: Rahu on the Moon links to ancestral dosha as well as mental unrest. The house shows which side: 4th mother and home, 9th ancestral fortune, 12th ancestral debts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 9th, ancestral blessings clouded, fortune delayed.
Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 4th, ancestral home troubled, restless heart.
Derived: Rahu in Cancer in the 12th, hidden ancestral debt or restless sleep.

classical_check: Agrees in part: the Moon as the world of pitrs (Pitriloka) is classical.

hindi: जल दिया जाता है पित्रों को पानी के द्वारा पि देते हैं मृत्यु के बाद 10 दिन तक घड़ा रखते हैं उसम बूंद बूंद पानी गिरता रहता अस्थियों के पर पानी गिराते हैं पि जल से खुश होते हैं
says: Water is offered to ancestors; after a death a pot with a hole is hung for ten days, dripping drop by drop on the remains, because ancestors are pleased with water, which links the Moon-ancestor idea to the water offering.
ambiguity: The caption has garbled sound-alike words; the dripping pot ritual is read as the ten-day ghat rite.
classical_check: Agrees: tarpan and the ten-day water pot are classical Hindu death rites.

gist: Garbled clause about the north pole region and several months ('kuch nath pol ke paas ... kai mahino ke liye'); meaning cannot be recovered.
An eclipse happens everywhere; it stops the Sun's light reaching Earth because the Moon comes in between.

hindi: यह एक घटना है फिजिक्स की घटना है एक उसको हमने राहु केतु के बहाने से समझाया और कुछ नहीं है नाम है
says: The eclipse is only a physics event; we explained it through the pretext of Rahu and Ketu, and the names are nothing more than names, so Rahu-Ketu are labels for a physical phenomenon.
ambiguity: He says the names are mere labels, but he continues to use their mythology for interpretation.

hindi: शनि भी खा जाता है सूरज को चंदा मामा को डिफरेंटली दब दबा देता है लेकिन राहु खा ही जाता है

says: After a birth (sutak) or death (patak) in the family, the household is considered impure and the gods are not worshipped for the next seven days; he quotes this as the custom.
