classical_check: Dharmashastra gives 10 days for sutak and 10 to 13 for patak depending on varna; he gives seven, so differs.

hindi: भगवान को साइड कर दिया जाता है पितरों के आगे सारे साइड है पितर प्रथम क्योंकि उनकी वजह से हमारे को संसार में जीवन मिला है
says: God is set aside for ancestors; before the pitars everyone else is secondary, the ancestors come first because it is through them that we received life in this world.
classical_check: Consistent with the Vedic 'Pitru Rina' (debt to ancestors) idea.

hindi: आपकी आवाज कौन सुनेगा जो सबसे पास है बहुत दूर बैठा भगवान उसके आवाज ही नहीं पहुंच रही पितरों को पितरों तक पहुंचाओ
says: Your prayer is heard by whoever is nearest; a God sitting far away does not receive your voice, so route the prayer through the ancestors, who are close and will pass it on.
ambiguity: Sentence runs across 1:26:06 and 1:27:06.
classical_check: Silent; this is his pedagogical framing, not a classical rule.

gist: He refers to a story about Ananda and Krishna, but the caption is garbled and no point can be recovered from it.

hindi: आप कृष्ण को पकड़ के बैठा है आपको टेंशन मचा रखी पितरों से सारे काम कराओ
says: You are clinging to Krishna and still carry tension; instead get all your tasks done through the ancestors, which he presents as the more effective route for worldly work.
ambiguity: Names and the first half of the caption are garbled; the sense is a contrast between Krishna worship and ancestor worship.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पितर तो शरीर बदल चुके हैं पर पैदा तो हम उन्ही के डीएनए से हुए वो पितर हमारे अंदर ही तो है
says: The ancestors have changed their bodies, but we were born from their DNA, so the ancestor is present inside us; the link is genetic, not only spiritual.
classical_check: A modern genetic framing; classical texts speak of lineage (gotra) and rina, not DNA.

hindi: उस आत्मा से तो पैदा हुए हम भी हम उसका हिस्सा है वो हमारे अंदर है
says: We are born from that ancestral soul, we are a part of it, and it lives within us; ancestors and descendants share the same stream of being.
ambiguity: Part of the sentence is garbled ('अरफ पतर है जाए'); only the clear half is recorded.
classical_check: Consistent with the Vedic idea that the father is reborn in the son (Atma vai putra nama).

hindi: लेकिन हमारे पर तो कृपा वही देंगे उन्ही के तो बच्चे हम
says: Grace for us will come from the ancestors alone, because we are their children; he treats them as the natural source of blessings for the family line.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Analogy: we can tell an uncle or father to get lost and they do not mind, saying he is just a child.

hindi: उनसे जुड़ना है भगवान है हम भगवान से डरते हैं कि प्यार करते हैं हम डरते हैं
says: We should connect with the ancestors; the contrast he draws is that we fear God out of dread of his anger, whereas we are at ease with ancestors, so ancestors are the approachable way in.
ambiguity: Sentence straddles the 1:27:06 and 1:28:03 captions.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mimics a person fearing that God will get angry and complaining that he never says two kind words.
Analogy of a grandfather with four grandchildren and a mother who never gets angry while a father does.
Audience asks whether ancestors who took a new body are still present in some form.

hindi: जिन एस्टर्स ने नया शरीर लिया है वो अपने कर्मों के अनुसार अगला फल भोगेंगे उनका डीएनए हम में आ चुका है
says: Ancestors who have taken a new body will enjoy the next fruit according to their own karma, separate from us; but their DNA has already come into us and stays in the line.
ambiguity: 'एस्टर्स' is the caption's rendering of 'ancestors'.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical rebirth-by-karma idea; the DNA link is modern.

hindi: वो हमारे अंदर ही है तो अपने अपने डीएनए को इवोक कर रहे हैं उनको कुछ थोड़ी कह रहे वो तो नया आत्मा नई शरीर नए ड्रामे हो चुके हैं
says: When we do ancestor rites we are really evoking our own inherited DNA, not calling the old person, who already has a new soul, body and life; so the ritual is addressed to the lineage within us.
classical_check: Differs from the Puranic view in which the departed pitar receives shraddha directly.

gist: Question: if the chart is said to have pitru dosha, does that mean the dosha is in us; he replies that they are confusing two things.
Complaint that he does not feel like taking questions as the flow breaks; he says he answers anyway, and praises a question as lovely.

hindi: आत्मा जो होती है ना यह होता है स्काई स्काई समझ गए यह बहुत बड़ा स्काई है अभी मैंने बाउंड्री बनाई है इसकी बाउंड्री है नहीं पूरा का पूरा जगह
says: To explain the soul he starts from the sky (akasha): a vast open space with no real boundary; the boundary drawn on the page is only for illustration of the whole space.
ambiguity: Caption is chaotic; the teaching is a drawing explained verbally.
classical_check: Akasha is the fifth element in Samkhya and Vedanta; consistent.

gist: Says this is a lovely topic and he is compelled to teach it because this knowledge is not available elsewhere; he drew the diagram last night.

hindi: अब इस जगह में कुछ है शायद कुछ नहीं है लेकिन कुछ नहीं है भी है यानी कुछ है
says: The empty space seems to hold nothing, but he says nothing is also a something, so the space is not truly void; this sets up the next point that space contains ether.
classical_check: Silent; a philosophical aside.

hindi: यह है स्काई जो कुछ है कुछ नहीं है या तो कुछ नहीं है या कुछ है लेकिन कुछ क्या है खाली जगह है अब बहुत बड़ी जगह है
says: He defines the empty container as the sky: it is just vacant space, extremely large, and either holds something or holds nothing; so sky is the name for the room itself.
ambiguity: Caption is repetitive and stuttering.
classical_check: Consistent with the akasha definition as space.

hindi: डब्बा नजर नहीं आ रहा पूरा स्पेस है बहुत बड़ा स्पेस है कहीं तो अंत होगा अच्छा हमें अंत नहीं पता लेकिन है तो जगह का नाम क्या है स्काई
says: The space has no visible box around it; it is huge and we do not know where it ends, but the name of this place or room is sky.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके अंदर क्या है उसके अंदर है कुछ उसका नाम है ईथर ये है स्काई और ईथर स्काई प्लस ईथर ये है स्पिरिट
says: What fills the sky is called ether; sky plus ether together make 'spirit', which he sets up as the first ingredient of the soul in his model.
ambiguity: His 'spirit' is a technical term in his own scheme, not a classical one.
classical_check: Silent; Sanskrit sources do not define atma as akasha plus ether.

gist: Jokes that heavy Hindi words go over their heads because they never went to school and have no education.

hindi: ईथर क्या है स्पेस व्योम खाली जगह इसमें क्या है इथर इथर क्या है अंतरिक्ष अंतरिक्ष तत्व है इसमें ये दोनों मिल गए क्या बने स्पिरिट
says: He gives the Sanskrit names: space is vyoma, empty room, and ether is the antariksha element; the two together form spirit.
ambiguity: He mixes the words vyoma, akasha and antariksha loosely.
classical_check: Vyoma and antariksha are normally synonyms for akasha, so this separation is his own.

hindi: ये बने अध्यात्म में जो आत्मा होती है जिस आत्मा में मन नहीं है यह खाली है अभी एक बैटरी बन गई यह बैटरी के अंदर आत्मा नहीं है मन नहीं है
says: What results is the soul of spiritual teaching, but at this stage it has no mind and is empty, like a freshly made battery with no soul-identity loaded.
ambiguity: The soul-with-no-mind point is his own battery analogy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आत्मा कहां लगेगी अभी आत्मा नहीं आई यानी पितर नहीं ऑन हुए आपके पितर नहीं ऑन हुए खन्ना वर्मा शर्मा क्या पैदा होने ब्राह्मण क्षत्रिय वैश्य शूद्र कुछ नहीं पता
says: Until the mind is attached the ancestral identity has not switched on: no surname (Khanna, Verma, Sharma) and no varna such as Brahmin or Kshatriya is yet known, so the lineage is not yet active.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह वाली बैटरी कहां लगाओ ये ट्रांजिस्टर में लगा दो उसके पितर ट्रांजिस्टर होए चित्त जुड़ेगा फिर चित्त बन गया टॉर्च में लगा दो उसके पितर टॉर्च हो गए
says: By analogy, the empty soul-battery takes its ancestry from whatever it is plugged into: a transistor makes transistor ancestors, a torch makes torch ancestors; the vessel it enters decides the lineage (khanna, verma and so on), and chitta forms on joining.
ambiguity: The analogy is incomplete in the caption, which ends mid-sentence at the chunk boundary ('खन्ना में गए वर्मा').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब इसके अंदर मुन्ना जुड़ गया प्लस मुन्ना मुन्ना क्या है मन पास्ट कर्मों प्रारब्ध के द्वारा डिसाइडेड हमारे कर्मों का लेखा झोखा
says: When 'munna' (his word for the mind, man) joins the spirit it brings the mind decided by past karma and prarabdha, which is our ledger of deeds; so the mind is the stored karmic account that gets attached to the spirit.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is a nickname-like caption of 'mann' (mind); he does not name Moon here, the planet tag is an inference from Moon as karaka of the mind.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the karaka of mind (manas) and prarabdha is the portion of karma that manifests in this life.

hindi: ये इक्वल टू हो गई सोल आत्मा ये आत्मिक है ये आध्यात्मिक है आत्मिक आध्यात्मिक दोनों अलग है
says: Spirit plus mind-karma equals soul (atma); he stresses that 'atmik' (of the soul) and 'adhyatmik' (spiritual) are two different things, so the soul is a defined compound and not the same as spirit.
ambiguity: The exact distinction between atmik and adhyatmik is not explained here.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own taxonomy.

hindi: यह भी आत्मा यह भी आत्मा यह भी आत्मा है आत्मा ही बोल के छापा मुगा देते हैं क्योंकि इसके विखंडन करना एक लंबा खिचड़ी है
says: All these stages are loosely labelled 'atma' and the label is stamped on them because splitting them apart is a long, tangled job; he admits that the common word hides finer layers.
ambiguity: Wording like 'छापा मुगा' and 'सेनाइज' is garbled caption.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह बन गई सोल ये आत्मा आ गई फिर बन गए जीव जीवात्मा एक व्यक्ति में आ गए कुत्ते बिल्ली जीव मनुष्य में वो हो गई जीवात्मा
says: Once the soul enters a living form (person, dog, cat) it is called jiva or jivatma; the same soul becomes a jivatma when it takes a human or animal body.
classical_check: Consistent with Vedantic usage of jiva and atman.

hindi: अब जीवात्मा के अंदर उसने मशीन गाड़ी मिल गई ना गाड़ी चला एक ड्राइवर है ट्रक चला रहा है ट्रक की बॉडी है कार चला रहा है लड़के की बॉडी है लड़की की बॉडी
says: The jivatma is the driver and the body is the vehicle it is given; a truck body, car body, boy's, girl's or dog's body are just different machines that the same driver operates.
classical_check: Echoes the Gita analogy of the body as a chariot or garment.

hindi: यह जीवात्मा अब जीवात्मा क्या कर रही है मुन्ना के अनुसार स्पिरिट को यूज करके काम कर रही है
says: While alive, the jivatma acts in line with its mind-karma account and uses the spirit as its working energy; deeds follow the stored mind.
classical_check: Consistent with karma following the mind (manas) in Vedanta.

hindi: फिर ट्रक मर गया गाड़ी मर गई इंसान की कुत्ते बिल्ली लड़का लड़की बॉडी मर गई क्या बच गया वापस बच गया आत्मा ये आत्मा निकल ली अतिक्ष में
says: When the body dies the vehicle is gone but the atma remains and departs into space; death ends the body, not the soul.
classical_check: Agrees with Gita 2.22 on the soul leaving the body.

hindi: अब ये आत्मा के अंदर की जो मुन्ना है मुन्ना कजल बॉडी इंग्लिश में इसे बोलते हैं कजल बॉडी
says: The mind-layer inside the departed soul is what English calls the 'causal body' (the caption renders it as 'kajal'); it is the karmic seed that travels on.
ambiguity: 'कजल' is almost certainly 'causal'; confirm in the audio.
classical_check: Agrees with the Vedantic karana sharira (causal body).

hindi: इस कजल बॉडी ने जब शरीर में थी नए शरीर पैदा किए थे यानी संभोग हुआ माता-पिता का एक अंडा मिला अंडाणु और एक शुक्राणु यह दोनों मिलकर के एक नया शरीर बना दिया
says: While embodied, this causal body produced new bodies: the parents unite, an egg meets a sperm and a new body forms; so children's bodies come from the parents' union through the soul's karmic design.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own explanation, with modern biology.

hindi: उस शरीर को किसने बनाया इस आत्मा ने स्पिरिट को इस्तेमाल करते हुए उस शरीर में भी एक स्पिरिट है और कौन सी आत्मा बुलाई नहीं डिफरेंट मुन्ना आया
says: That body was built by this soul using spirit; the child has its own spirit, and no existing soul is summoned into it; a different mind-karma (a different munna) arrives with the child.
ambiguity: Sentence ends at the chunk boundary and continues in the next caption.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन उसके शरीर में क्या था डीएनए वह किससे मिला वो इससे मिला वो डीएनए चला गया अब यह वाला तो पितर बन गया लेकिन अब यह उस शरीर को छोड़ गया
says: The child's body carries DNA that came from the departed parent; the DNA stays in the line while the one who gave it, now a pitar, has left that body behind.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: डीएनए का कोई लेन देन नहीं यह फ्री आत्मा है इस आत्मा को समय आने पर एक नई स्पिरिट मिली तो इसने जाकर के दूसरा जन्म ले लिया सेकंड बर्थ
says: The departed soul has no further dealings with the DNA it left; it is a free soul that in time receives a fresh spirit and takes a second birth.
classical_check: Agrees with the general rebirth doctrine.

hindi: इसका पिछले जन्म के मुन्ना और उसके द्वारा पैदा किए लोगों से कोई लेनदेन नहीं है इसे पता ही नहीं अब इसे नई बॉडी मिली है अब नया डीएनए
says: In the new life this soul has no dealings with, and no memory of, its previous-life mind or the children it fathered; it has a new body and a new DNA.
classical_check: Differs from the classical view where karmic ties across births (rinanubandhan) persist.

hindi: लेकिन इसको डीएनए किससे मिला था अपने पर दादे के दादे से तीन पीढ़ी पहले तक अब उसके द्वारा वह डीएनए एक्टिवेट
says: The new DNA is received from the great-grandfather's line, up to three generations back; so the inherited material that matters spans three earlier generations.
ambiguity: 'पर दादे के दादे' is garbled; 'great-grandfather' and 'three generations' are the clear parts.
classical_check: Silent; the three-generation window is his own and parallels the idea of three paternal generations in shraddha.

hindi: हर तीन पीढ़ी के बाद एपीजेनेटिक्स बोलते हैं इसे चेंज हो गया आपका डीएनए में परिवर्तन आ जाता है ऑटोमेटिक बदल जाते हैं
says: After every three generations the DNA changes automatically (he calls it epigenetics), so the ancestral imprint is renewed in cycles of three generations.
ambiguity: His use of 'epigenetics' is loose; this is a claim from his own framing, not from the science.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसका इस जन्म में अपने उन बच्चों से कोई लेनदेन नहीं जो ये शरीर में पैदा करके आया है ये फिर नए बच्चे पैदा कर लेगा और नया डीएनए लेकर आएगा
says: In this birth the soul has no dealings with the children it produced in its earlier body; it will make fresh children and bring fresh DNA into the new line.
ambiguity: This is close to the earlier no-transaction point but extends it to the next set of children.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: वो बच्चा जो पैदा हुआ वो अपने से पहले की तीन पीढ़ी लाएगा यानी इसकी तीन पीढ़ी उसकी चार पीढ़ी है तो वो चौथी पीढ़ी छोड़ देगा
says: Each newborn carries the three generations before him; the father's three become the child's four counted back, and the fourth generation drops off, so only a rolling window of three generations is carried.
ambiguity: The counting of 'three versus four' is confusing in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; classical shraddha names three paternal ancestors (father, grandfather, great-grandfather), which is a loose parallel.

hindi: तो वो नया बच्चा अगले अगले जन्म में जो पैदा किया था इसने उसका इससे कोई लेनदेन नहीं है ये कहां पैदा हुआ अमृतसर है मद्रास है कि अमेरिका है कि गुजरात है
says: The reborn soul may be born anywhere, Amritsar, Madras, America or Gujarat, and has no dealings with the family of its earlier life; place of rebirth is unrelated to the old lineage.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: A run of words 'बारह पर, फिर वो अपना बारह पर है' repeated; could be the 12th house or a filler, but the caption does not make it recoverable.

hindi: नया जो बच्चा पैदा हो गया है उसने कहा यार मेरा ना बापा था दादा था ये नाराज है मेरे से कहां नाराज है मेरी ही बॉडी में मेरे डीएनए के हिस्से में मेरा डीएनए मेरे से नाराज है
says: The newborn finds that a father or grandfather is 'angry' with him; the anger sits in his own body, as a portion of his own DNA, so what is called ancestral displeasure is his own inherited DNA not working in his favour.
ambiguity: The speaker's voice is a role-play of the new child; the mapping to pitru dosha is implied.
classical_check: Silent; classical pitru dosha is attributed to the Sun, 9th house and the ancestors, not DNA.

hindi: मुझसे काम नहीं कर रहा इसकी साइंस पढ़ने वाले महाराज गुरुजी स्वामी पंडित जोथी को पता है अबे तेरा डीएनए काम नहीं कर रहा लेकिन साइंटिफिकली तुझे समझाना नहीं आ रहा
says: Gurus, swamis, pandits and astrologers who know this science sense that your DNA is not working for you but cannot explain it scientifically, so they just say pitru dosha.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मुझे तुझे पितृ दोष है उसकी रीडिंग कैसे होगी तुम्हें खासी रहती है तुम्हारा आईजी लेवल बढ़ा हुआ है क्या करो दवाई लो यह कैसे हुआ ब्लड टेस्ट से तो ब्लड टेस्ट की रीडिंग आती है
says: How is pitru dosha read? He compares it with a blood test: a cough shows an elevated IgE level and medicine is taken, but a reading came from a test; in the same way a person trained to read ancestors can tell there is pitru dosha. The medical example is only an analogy, not advice.
ambiguity: Medical example (IgE, cough) is an analogy only; do not treat it as a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसका मतलब पता है ऐसे पित्रों की रीडिंग जिसको आती है वह बता देता है अ पित दोष है इसके लिए क्या करो
says: Whoever can read the signals of the ancestors will tell you that pitru dosha is present, and then the question is what to do about it.
ambiguity: He does not say here what sign in the chart is read.
classical_check: Classical pitru dosha is read from the Sun, 9th house and Rahu; he gives no chart rule here.

hindi: गया में स्टोन है ब्लैक स्टोन मीटर का टुकड़ा है वहां जाओ वहां की वाइब्रेशन में पितरों की कृपा लो हो जाएगा
says: Remedy for pitru dosha: go to Gaya, where there is a black stone said to be a meteorite fragment, and take the ancestors' grace in its vibrations; the problem will then resolve.
ambiguity: 'मीटर का टुकड़ा' is read as a meteorite piece.
classical_check: Gaya shraddha is a classical pilgrimage remedy for pitru rina; the meteorite claim is his own.

gist: Says it is all science with a whole class on it, and asks how it will happen.

hindi: हमारे पितर की कृपा इसलिए आपको जो जन्म ले चुके उनसे कोई लेनदेन नहीं है आपके डीएनए में तीन पीढ़ी का हिसाब किताब है उनकी ब्लेसिंग
says: Ancestors who have already taken rebirth have no transaction with you; what matters is the account of three generations in your DNA, and you need the blessings of those three generations.
classical_check: Parallel to classical advice to propitiate three generations in shraddha.

gist: 'मिलो या रॉकेट की तरह जाओगे ढाए ढाए' is a garbled run that seems to say you will go forward fast like a rocket with blessings.

hindi: ये पितर के लिए गया भी जाते हैं करनाल के पास पेवा पेवा जाते हैं वो नारायण बलि की जाती है
says: For ancestors people go to Gaya and also to Pehowa near Karnal, where Narayan bali is performed; so there are two named pilgrimage sites for ancestor remedies.
ambiguity: 'पेवा' is Pehowa (Haryana) by caption sound.
classical_check: Gaya and Pehowa are traditionally named for pitru karma.

gist: Says the topic is lovely and important and should be in school curricula, wonders when God will bless us; also a stray line that our class would change.

hindi: नारायण बलि में उस व्यक्ति की पूजा की जाती है नारायण बलि ये पांडवों की कहानी है उसके साथ जुड़ती है छोटे तौर पर नारायण बली उस व्यक्ति के लिए की जाती है जो प्रेत योनि में ना जाए
says: Narayan bali is a rite for a particular deceased person so that he does not fall into the pret state; he links it loosely with a Pandava story and calls it in short a rite to keep the departed out of pret yoni.
ambiguity: The Pandava story is not told here and the link is unclear.
classical_check: Agrees with the Puranic purpose of Narayan bali for untimely or unnatural death.

hindi: नहीं तो उसको शरीर नहीं मिलता अगला वो स्पिरिट रह जाता है भटकता रहती है उसकी उसकी आत्मा कहां भटकती है
says: Without the rite the departed does not get the next body, stays as a spirit only and keeps wandering.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of a wandering preta without last rites.

hindi: यह जो आत्मा है ना यह आत्मा कोई सुसाइड करता है तो फिर उसका यही तो सुसाइड है नारायण मली
says: In cases such as suicide the soul is the one for whom Narayan bali is meant; the caption is rough, but he links the rite to those who die by suicide. This is a tradition claim and no judgment on any person.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled; the suicide link is the clear part.
classical_check: Agrees: Narayan bali is traditionally for unnatural deaths including suicide.

hindi: ये आत्मा यह तीनों से मिलकर बनी जब इसका ये मुन्ना भटकता है ना अकेला इसको स्पिरिट नहीं मिली इसको बोलते हैं प्रेत इसके लिए प्रेत पूजा की जाती है
says: The soul is made of three ingredients; when the munna (mind-karma) wanders alone and finds no spirit to join, it is called a pret, and a pret puja is done for it.
ambiguity: The 'three' are sky, ether and mind-karma in the earlier teaching, but he does not repeat them here.
classical_check: Silent on this composition; pret as a bodiless wanderer is classical.

hindi: गया में अंधे कुए के अंदर नारियल फेंकते हैं अलग कहानी है यह प्रेत रह जाता है फिर यह प्रेत तंग करते हैं
says: At Gaya a coconut is thrown into a blind well as part of the ritual (a different story he does not tell); he continues that if a soul stays as pret, it then troubles people.
ambiguity: The coconut-and-well detail is mentioned in passing.
classical_check: Silent on the coconut and blind well detail.

hindi: ये किसे तंग करते हैं उसी डीएनए वाले को कहते साले तू मुक्ति नहीं कर रहा यह पितृ दोष है
says: A pret troubles the one who has the same DNA, saying in effect 'you are not freeing me'; he calls this pitru dosha, so the dosha is a trapped ancestor pressing on his own descendant.
classical_check: Differs from the classical chart-based definition (Sun and Rahu afflicting the 9th); here it is defined by lineage, not chart.

hindi: तो ये किसको कर रहे हैं तीन भाइयों में एक को कर रहा है क्यों कर रहा है उसके डीएनए फॉर्मेशन के टाइम वो ज्यादा इवॉल्व था
says: Among three brothers the pret troubles just one; the reason he gives is that this one was more evolved at the time of his DNA formation, so he is the one tuned to the ancestor.
ambiguity: 'इवॉल्व्ड' is not defined; the mechanism is his own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बुआ कर रही है ताई चाची यह कब होता है सेक्सुअल एक्टिविटी के दौरान पुरुष और स्त्री की क्या बुद्धि है यह बड़ा अलग चला जाएगा यह बहुत डेप्थ की चीज है यह उसी पित्र को कॉल कर लिया
says: The same effect can come from an aunt in the family line; he places the link at conception, during the sexual act, when the mental state of the man and woman called that particular ancestor, so the choice of which ancestor attaches is fixed at conception. He says the topic is too deep to go into now.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across 1:37:06 and 1:38:06 and is partly garbled.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link conception timing to the child's chart (garbhadhana) but not this mechanism.

hindi: उस पित्र से वाइब्रेशन हो गई वो प्रेत बना हुआ है इसे तंग कर रहा है बाकी भाई को करता ही नहीं
says: A vibration formed with that ancestor, who is a pret, so he troubles this one brother and not the others.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says all this is a long study with deep classes possible, and that lovely points have come out.

hindi: यह मुन्ना प्रेत ना बने इसके लिए नारायण बलि करते हैं क्योंकि भूमि पर नहीं गुजरा भूमि की ग्रेविटी नहीं मिली खाट में मर गया
says: Narayan bali is done so that the departed mind does not become a pret; the reason given is that the person did not pass away on the ground, did not receive earth's gravity, and died on a cot instead.
ambiguity: Dying on a cot versus the floor refers to the Hindu custom of laying the dying on the ground.
classical_check: The practice of laying the dying on the ground is traditional; the gravity reasoning is his own.

hindi: जैसी जो हमारे धर्म के अनुसार मान्यता मुस्लिम्स की अलग है क्रिश्चन की अलग है जैसा जो बिलीफ सिस्टम है वही आपकी पूजा है
says: Each religion has its own belief about the afterlife; Muslims and Christians differ; the dosha you suffer and the way to remove it follow your own belief system, which is what your worship is.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नारायण बली करने जाते हैं हरिद्वार में ज्यादा अच्छी होती है वैसे वहां करा लो जिसको लगे अच्छे पंडित जी मिल जाए तो कर लो नहीं तो श्रद्धा होनी चाहिए सब श्रद्धा से हो जाता है
says: Narayan bali is better done at Haridwar; get it done by a good pandit if you find one, otherwise faith is what counts, because everything works through faith.
ambiguity: He earlier named Gaya and Pehowa; here Haridwar is said to be better.
classical_check: Traditional sources name Trimbakeshwar, Gaya and Pehowa for Narayan bali; Haridwar is a looser choice.

hindi: फिर है केतु केतु महाराज जब सूर्य की रोशनी में आते पांच नंबर में तो सूरज को ढक देता है
says: Ketu in number 5 comes into the Sun's light (Leo is the Sun's sign) and covers the Sun, so a Ketu in the 5th house or Leo dims or hides the Sun's results.
cells_derived_method: If Leo is the sign, the Sun's house topic is dimmed wherever Leo falls: the 1st for self and vitality, the 9th for father and fortune, the 10th for status and career. If it is the 5th house, children, intelligence and creativity are hidden or detached.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries, Ketu in Leo in the 5th; the Sun's gifts of children, intellect and recognition are covered over.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in Leo in the 9th; the father, dharma and fortune are shadowed.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Virgo, Ketu in Leo in the 12th; the Sun's authority is hidden and withdrawn, with a spiritual leaning.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर' could be house 5 or sign 5 (Leo); both are recorded.
classical_check: Ketu with or in the Sun's sign is classically a weakening factor for the Sun; agrees in spirit.

hindi: ये सरय कंजंक्शन में भी सेम काम करता है या राशि में आने पर भी सेम इफेक्ट है उसमें भी ऐसे भी दोनों
says: He asks whether Ketu covers the Sun only in conjunction or also when it merely sits in the Sun's sign, and says the same effect applies in both cases.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction can happen in any sign and house; the sign case means Ketu in Leo even if the Sun is elsewhere, so the effect travels with sign and not only with a degree-close conjunction.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo, Ketu in Leo in the 1st; Sun's themes of self and health shadowed even if the Sun is in another sign.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio, Ketu in Leo in the 10th; the Sun's status and authority themes of career are dimmed, even if the Sun itself sits in another sign.

ambiguity: The end of the sentence is garbled ('उसमें भी ऐसे भी दोनों'); the 'both' reading is the best fit.
classical_check: Classically conjunction (within orb) matters more than mere sign occupancy; he asserts both.

hindi: जब साथ बैठे दोनों तो बैंड बजा देगा कचूमर निकाल देता है परमा डिग्रीज का खेल है
says: When Ketu and the Sun sit together in the same place Ketu hits him hard and ruins him completely; he adds that how bad it gets is a matter of the exact degrees between them.
cells_derived_method: Conjunction is a same-sign condition, so it can occur in any of the 144 cells; the sign changes the Sun's strength (strong in Aries, weak in Libra) and the house changes which life area is damaged, with closeness in degrees deciding severity.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer, exalted Sun with Ketu in the 10th; status and authority are strong but undermined, closeness of degrees decides the damage.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra, debilitated Sun with Ketu in the 1st; vitality and self-image are shadowed the most.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries, Sun with Ketu in the 9th; father, dharma and luck are covered over.

ambiguity: 'परमा डिग्रीज' is a garbled word, probably 'exact degrees' or 'paramaanu degrees'; the first words continue the earlier Ketu-Sun sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: conjunction orb and closeness (combustion-like) intensify the effect.

gist: Says the science is so deep that chapters will seem maddening, but with study the brain's capacity opens, new dimensions appear and deep thinking becomes automatic.
Says there is no syllabus so he just rambles, and listeners should take whatever fits into their heads and cast the rest as their own dream.
Restates that Ketu in five will eat it, repeating the earlier Ketu-in-5 covers-the-Sun point.

hindi: केतु चंद्र के ऊपर बादल आता है केतु उसे भी चाट मारता है काहे पता ही नहीं मन दब जाता है
says: When Ketu comes over the Moon it acts like a cloud over it and licks it away as well; the mind gets suppressed, and the person does not know why.
cells_derived_method: Moon with Ketu has a different feel by sign (exalted Moon in Taurus, own in Cancer, debilitated in Scorpio) and by house (the 4th touches home peace, the 1st the self, the 10th public life).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries, Moon with Ketu in Cancer in the 4th; mother and home peace become vague and mentally heavy.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo, exalted Moon with Ketu in the 10th; public image is strong but the mind feels detached from work.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio, debilitated Moon with Ketu in the 1st; the emotions are suppressed and mood is unexplained.

ambiguity: Whether this means conjunction, sign or aspect is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in effect with Ketu-Moon being treated as a mental-affliction combination in several texts.

hindi: केतु सूर्य के ऊपर आता है तो सूरज का रोशनी नजर नहीं आती इंसान को जिंदगी में अंधकार में रहता हमेशा ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसकी केतु ऐसा है
says: When Ketu comes over the Sun its light is not seen, and a person with such a Ketu keeps living in darkness in life, not seeing a way forward.
cells_derived_method: The 'darkness' falls on the Sun's topic in the house concerned: self and vitality in the 1st, father and fortune in the 9th, career in the 10th; sign strength changes how bright the Sun was before Ketu covered it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer, Sun exalted with Ketu in the 10th; strong potential for status but he cannot see his path.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer, Sun debilitated with Ketu in the 4th; home and inner peace feel dark and confused.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius, Sun in own sign with Ketu in the 9th; fortune and father shadowed despite Sun's strength.

ambiguity: This is a restatement and extension of the earlier Ketu-covers-Sun sentence; here it describes the felt result in the person's life.
classical_check: Agrees with the general view that Ketu darkens the Sun.

hindi: कहता है यार समझ नहीं आ रहा समझ नहीं आ रहा केतु मंगल के साथ जब होता है ना ओए होय धासू होता है यानी आग के साथ धुआ आग में धुआ है तो क्या प्रचंड आ गया
says: Such a person keeps saying 'I do not understand'; Ketu with Mars, by contrast, is explosive and fierce, like smoke in a fire, and the blaze becomes ferocious.
cells_derived_method: Mars with Ketu is fierce in any sign but the sign sets how it shows: in Aries or Scorpio it is raw force, in exalted Capricorn it is disciplined drive, and the house sets the area of battle.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aquarius, Mars with Ketu in Aries in the 3rd; ferocious courage and risky effort.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries, Mars with Ketu in Scorpio in the 8th; intense, hidden, accident-prone fierceness.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Libra, exalted Mars with Ketu in the 4th; strong drive at home with sudden conflicts.

ambiguity: 'धासू' is slang for powerful; the valence is mixed because fierceness can help or harm.
classical_check: Classical texts treat Mars-Ketu as an aggressive, accident-prone pair; agrees.

hindi: और हनुमान जी की पूंछ आ है केतु पूंछ होता है मछली है मछली पूरी पूंछ है एक छोटी सी आंखें आगे पूरी बड़ी पूंछ है
says: Ketu is the tail: Hanuman's tail, and also the fish, which is almost all tail with a tiny front end of eyes; the tail symbol marks Ketu as the long trailing part of any creature.
ambiguity: The sentence order is jumbled in the caption; the tail, Hanuman and fish pairings are clear.
classical_check: Ketu with fish (Matsya avatar) and flag is classical; the tail is a loose mapping.

hindi: तो केतु से शुरुआत होता है आके मंगल एक नंबर राशि में लाजवाब
says: Ketu with Mars in number 1 (Aries, Mars's own sign) gives an excellent result; the combination starts well in the fiery sign that Mars rules.
cells_derived_method: If the sign is meant, the pairing in Aries works in every house: courage and independent action in the 3rd, a battle with rivals in the 6th, status through force in the 10th. If the 1st house is meant, the self is bold and heated in whatever sign rises.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries, Mars with Ketu in own sign in the 1st; a bold, driven self.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Scorpio, Mars with Ketu in Aries in the 6th; enemies and debts are fought down with force.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Cancer, Mars with Ketu in Aries in the 10th; command and leadership in work.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर राशि' reads as sign 1 (Aries), but 'number 1' could also be house 1; both are recorded.
classical_check: Mars in own sign is classically strong; Ketu-Mars in Aries is generally seen as combative but supported.

hindi: केतु हवा में अब हवा में अगर धुआ हो जाए बादल आ जाए तो हवा तो गई तो सत्यानाश कर देता है केतु बर्बाद कर देता है बुध के तीन नंबर की राशि के अंदर
says: Ketu in air: if smoke and cloud enter the air, the air is lost, so in Mercury's sign number 3 (Gemini, an air sign) Ketu wrecks and ruins the matters of that sign.
cells_derived_method: The damage lands on the house that Gemini occupies: communication and siblings in the 3rd, speech and family in the 2nd, partnership and spouse in the 7th, income and networks in the 11th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: lagna Aries, Ketu in Gemini in the 3rd; effort, writing, siblings and short travel are muddled and spoilt.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Sagittarius, Ketu in Gemini in the 7th; partnership talks and contracts keep getting ruined.
Derived, not said by him: lagna Leo, Ketu in Gemini in the 11th; gains and friends circle disrupted by confusion.

ambiguity: 'तीन नंबर की राशि' is Gemini (sign 3), but could be taken as the 3rd house; both are recorded.
classical_check: Classically Ketu in Gemini is mixed (some texts call it exalted); his 'wrecks it' view differs.

hindi: केतु ही वो देवता है केतु देवता है बेबसी का ये बादल का बादल क्या होता है बादल होता है अधूरा बादल का मतलब है रेसिड्यू बचा हुआ
says: Ketu is the god of helplessness; the cloud that stands for him is an incomplete thing, meaning a residue, a leftover.
classical_check: Ketu as helplessness and residue is within the classical karakatwa of detachment and loss.

hindi: केतु देवता है मिसकैरेज का आपके जीवन में जो भी काम अधूरा हो रहा है कोई भी काम जो अधूरा है वह सब केतु है
says: Ketu is the god of miscarriage in the broad sense of things cut off before completion; every task in your life that stays unfinished is Ketu's. This is a karaka claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: Used for both the pregnancy sense and the general 'abandoned work' sense.
classical_check: Ketu for abortive and incomplete outcomes is accepted in several traditions.

hindi: अधूरा मनुष्य पुरुष अपने आप को अधूरा समझता है स्त्री अपने आप को अधूरा समझते हैं क्योंकि केतु जॉइंट जुड़ने से केतु अधूरा है सिर्फ धड़ है मुंडी है ही नहीं
says: Both men and women feel incomplete because of Ketu, who is joint-less and unfinished, a headless torso with no head at all; the sense of being incomplete in a person comes from Ketu.
classical_check: Ketu as the headless body is Puranic and agrees.

hindi: केतु अंधा है केतु बह रहा है केतु गूंगा है केतु को पता ही नहीं क्या करना है
says: Ketu is blind, deaf (the caption has 'flowing', likely 'deaf') and mute, and has no idea what to do; with no head he lacks sight, hearing, speech and direction.
ambiguity: 'बह रहा है' is probably 'बहरा है' (deaf).
classical_check: Agrees with the headless nature of Ketu.

hindi: तो यह राजा है यह उसकी पत्नी हो गई सेनापति हो गया उनकी बच्ची हो गई गुरु हो गए शुक्र हो गया वहां पर खेलकूद मौद मस्ती करने वाली या घर की बहू कह लो
says: He lays out the planets as a royal household: the Sun is king, the Moon his wife, Mars the commander, Mercury their daughter, Jupiter the guru, and Venus the playful, pleasure-loving girl or daughter-in-law of the house.
ambiguity: The caption does not name the planets; the mapping uses the earlier diagram he drew and the usual court analogy.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical cabinet: Sun king, Moon queen, Mars commander, Mercury prince, Jupiter minister, Venus minister; Venus as daughter-in-law is his own.

hindi: उसके बाद ये शनि महाराज हो गया ये सेवक हो गया सेवक का एजेंट हो गया राहु एजेंट का एक और मंगल है सेनापति उसका एजेंट और उसका भी एजेंट है केतु
says: Next, Saturn is the servant, Rahu the servant's agent, and Ketu sits at the bottom as an agent's agent (the chain through Mars the commander is garbled), so Ketu is the lowest link in the hierarchy.
ambiguity: The chain connecting Mars to Rahu or Ketu is not clearly captioned; the order servant, agent, agent's agent is the clear part.
classical_check: Differs from classical texts, where Rahu and Ketu are not given a rank in the court.

hindi: इसलिए संसार में कोई व्यक्ति ऐसा नहीं है जो किसी एक स्थान पर मारा ना जाए सारे में ही क्योंकि वरुण हजारों आंखों वाला देवता है

hindi: अगर वहां क इंद्र की राशि आठ नंबर आ गई तो आपको खून के आंसू रुला देगा

hindi: हम कृपा से कहां फस सक रहे हैं हम तो वरुण देवता यहां पर सारे की सारी नेगेटिव सजा देता है

hindi: 14 साल की साइकिल है इसकी एक राशि में 14 साल रहता है इसलिए 14 वर्ष के वनवास 14 साल का आजीवन कारावास 14 साल के ड्रामे चलते हैं

hindi: यह वरुण जब यमराज के यहां जाता है तो यमराज बर्फ का गोला चुआ सा कुछ भी नहीं है

hindi: मौत को अगर कोई मात दे सकता है तो वह कृपा है इसलिए वरुण बहुत बड़ा पोर्टल है यह कृपा देता है

hindi: यह मंगल है यह बृहस्पति है अब देखो आप बृहस्पति कितना बड़ा है शनि भी बहुत बड़ा है लेकिन बृहस्पति से छोटू है

hindi: जितने लोग यमराज मींस प्योर डेथ स्टोन खत्म पत्थर बन चुका है बर्फ का गोला बन गया है

says: In the time it takes to eat at one host's house he could help twenty people, take abuse from four, get his sins cut and take blessings from sixteen, which brings more of Varuna's grace; serving many gains blessings, a remedy-like claim.
ambiguity: Garbled words 'चार के काम', 'पाप कटवा उा'; the sense is serving many and gaining blessings. The figures are illustrative.
classical_check: Seva and blessings reducing sin is traditional; Neptune link is his.

gist: He says the point is that all of it is a game of greed.

hindi: कृपा जो प्रेम दे दे बैठेगा उसने मुझे ध्यान ऊर्जा दे दी व हम वैसे ही बिक गए
says: Grace can come as love: whoever gives love and attention has given you energy, and he is sold at once to such a giver. Grace includes attention-energy, not only money.
ambiguity: Starts mid-sentence in the caption.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He admits people like him are egoistic in strange ways and that he is easily won over by children.
He says he feels responsible for two things, his children's marriage and studies, since God gave them as a free gift.
He wants children made fit by discipline, would enjoy being supported by them but takes no money, as one cannot add water to the Ganga.

hindi: दूसरा विवाह क्योंकि विवाह के पश्चात ही साइंटिस्ट पैदा होने ज्ञानी पैदा होने
says: The second purpose is marriage, because it is only after marriage that scientists and wise people are born; he sees marriage as the doorway through which gifted children come. A tradition claim.
cells_derived_method: Marriage is the 7th house and children the 5th, so he links the quality of the 7th-house bond to the 5th-house output.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a well-placed 7th in Libra suggests balanced partnership supporting gifted children.
Derived: a 5th in Sagittarius suggests wise, teaching-minded children following a stable marriage.

ambiguity: No house is named; the 7th and 5th houses are my reading.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts treat progeny from the 5th house, not from the 7th.

gist: He says these two tasks are his core purpose and he cannot refuse what the divine gave free; he only parties.
A questioner asks if selfishness is virtue (swarth punya); he first asks what swarth even is.
He defines swarth as sva-artha, concern for oneself only: not drinking the wife's blood, not nagging children, doing one's duty; being selfish in this sense is good.
He says there are two kinds of selfishness: wanting everyone's good and wanting one's own good.
He says do not interfere with anyone and let people live as they wish; wishing everyone's good is just your own head's wish.
Drinking example: one says it is bad, another says he cannot be happy without it; he says let him drink and let him die, he will be happy.
He says nothing is free service: he only shares knowledge, does nothing free, takes blessings from all and cannot do business.
A questioner asks: if exalted planets in our chart, are things related to them received as charity or gift, or given as charity, a good thing?
He objects to where charity came from in the question, calling this their usual muddle.
He grumbles that people give commands and have not learned command, then says gift versus donation is the difference.

hindi: यह जो दान है शनि के पास चली गई गिफ्ट मिली वरुण के पास आ गई देवता अलग है
says: Donation (daan) goes to Saturn's domain, while a gift received comes under Varuna; the two deities are different, so charity given and gifts received act through different planets.
ambiguity: A reply to the question on exalted planets and donation; he does not state whether exaltation matters.
classical_check: Daan under Saturn is a common remedy classification; gifts under Neptune is his addition.

hindi: टशन देखो मेरी ज्ञान और दान और गिफ्ट दोनों अलग है दान दाता देता है देने वाला कृपा कोई भी दे सकता है
says: Knowledge, donation and gift are all separate: donation is given by a donor who chooses to give, whereas grace can be given by anyone.
ambiguity: 'टशन देखो मेरी' is a flourish; 'ज्ञान' may map to Jupiter, but he does not say so.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कृपा तो छोटा बेबी दे देगा जब वो प्रेम से गले लगेगा क्या दे दिया उसने उसने अपनत्व दिया है अपनी औरा दी है ऊर्जा दी है
says: Even a small baby gives grace when he hugs you lovingly; he gives belonging, his aura and energy. Grace is closeness and life-energy, not an object.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बच्चे में भयंकर ऊर्जा होती है उसकी एनर्जी बॉडी लब लबा आती है वह किसी को कुछ दे दे व रेयर
says: A child carries tremendous energy and his energy body overflows; a child who freely gives something away is rare, and when he does it is a transfer of that energy.
ambiguity: Caption wording is broken in the last clause.
classical_check: Silent; 'energy body' is a modern notion.

gist: He says we make a child hungry and bare, then he will not even share his toy; some children say give it to uncle because their parents have kept them full.
Other parents make children paupers by saying this is not yours; slice ends mid-sentence with 'your Krishna is yours'.
Chat with the questioner: it works because of that, 'we were saved, sir, I felt we had arrived' and similar remarks.

hindi: नीच भंग जब होता है तो किसी भी प्लेनेट का हो सकता है और वो अच्छे रिजल्ट देता है नीच भंग किसी भी प्लेनेट का हो सकता है
says: Neecha bhanga (cancellation of debilitation) can happen to any planet, and when it happens it gives good results.
cells_derived_method: Whenever a planet sits in its debilitation sign (Sun Libra, Moon Scorpio, Mars Cancer, Mercury Pisces, Jupiter Capricorn, Venus Virgo, Saturn Aries) in any house, his rule says its cancellation turns the result good; the house topic decides what improves.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn in the 10th (Aries lagna) with cancellation would turn a weak career signal into success.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in Pisces in the 2nd (Aquarius lagna) with cancellation would repair speech and wealth.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo in the 7th (Pisces lagna) with cancellation would repair marriage matters.

ambiguity: The question asked is not captured; he answers in general terms.
classical_check: Agrees that neecha bhanga applies to any planet and gives raja-yoga results; his condition for it differs from classical rules (below).

hindi: लेकिन पापी ग्रह से होता है ये जितने नीच के ग्रह है नीच भंग नीच पापी ग्रह
says: But the cancellation works through a sinful (malefic) planet: among debilitated planets, it is the malefic ones whose debilitation gets cancelled; a good planet debilitated is not rescued in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: Malefics (Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu, Sun in his view) in their debilitation signs are candidates; the cancellation then depends on the house they sit in (next sentences give dusthanas).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 6th (Aquarius lagna) is a bad planet in a bad house, so by his rule the debilitation is cancelled.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 1st is a malefic in a kendra, so by his rule it is not rescued.

ambiguity: Caption is garbled at the end; it reads 'the debilitation of malefic planets'. Rahu and Ketu debilitation signs are not stated.
classical_check: Differs: classical neecha bhanga rules (Parashara) concern the dispositor, exaltation lord and kendra position, not the planet's malefic nature.

hindi: अब सूर्य का नीच भंग का लेन देन ही नहीं है सूर्य खराब ही करेगा राब जगह चला गया लेकिन खराब ग्रह शनि आठवें घर में चला गया
says: The Sun has no dealing with neecha bhanga: a debilitated Sun in a bad place will only spoil things. By contrast, a bad planet like Saturn going to the 8th house is the real case of cancellation.
cells_derived_method: Sun debilitated in Libra: in his scheme it gets no cancellation in any house, so the harm lands on father, authority and vitality topics of the house it occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in Libra in the 10th (Capricorn lagna) would stay a weak authority signal with no cancellation.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 8th (Pisces lagna) would add harm even in a dusthana, with no rescue.
Derived: Sun in Libra in the 4th (Cancer lagna) would disturb home and mother's comfort without cancellation.

ambiguity: 'राब जगह' is 'kharab jagah' (bad place). Sun is not called 'papi' by him here, which is why he excludes it; this is his own reading.
classical_check: Differs: classically the Sun can have neecha bhanga like any planet; excluding the Sun is his rule.

hindi: मान लो ये है बात जो असली ये है अब ये मान लो खराब ग्रह है शनि महाराज यहां आ गए एक नंबर राशि है तो शनि नीच का हो गया
says: The real point: take Saturn, a bad planet, and if it comes into sign number 1 (Aries) it becomes debilitated.
cells_derived_method: Saturn debilitated in Aries; the house it occupies sets the topic. In his scheme Saturn, being bad, can have cancellation if the house is bad.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 8th (Virgo lagna) is a bad planet in a bad house and is the cancellation case.
Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 6th (Scorpio lagna) is another bad-in-bad case.
Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 1st (Aries lagna) is a bad planet in a good house, so no cancellation in his scheme.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is debilitated in Aries.

hindi: अगर य शनि सात नंबर का है तो उच्च का हो गया
says: If the same Saturn is in sign number 7 (Libra) it is exalted.
cells_derived_method: Saturn exalted in Libra; the effect varies with the house topic: 10th for career power, 7th for partnership discipline, 8th for longevity in his later example.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 10th (Capricorn lagna) gives strong career authority.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 7th (Aries lagna) gives steady, disciplined partnerships.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 8th (Pisces lagna) is his next example, a strong shield.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is exalted in Libra.

gist: He says he will draw two charts: this one with sign 1 and this one with sign 7, with Saturn placed in each.

hindi: सात नंबर का बहुत बढ़िया शनि है यह मौत का खाना है इस मौत के खाने में शनि बैठ गया उच्च का बढ़िया है बढ़िया मौत देगा
says: In the second chart Saturn in sign 7 is a very good (exalted) Saturn and it sits in the 'death box', the 8th house; he says the exalted Saturn there is excellent and will give a good (clean) death, as the 8th house is the death house.
cells_derived_method: Saturn exalted in the 8th gives longevity and a clean ending by classical Saturn-in-8th logic; the sign for the 8th house is fixed by the lagna (Pisces lagna gives Libra in the 8th).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: for Pisces lagna, Saturn exalted in Libra in the 8th protects longevity and gives a peaceful end.

ambiguity: 'Good death' is his phrase; no timing or death prediction is made.
classical_check: Saturn in the 8th is classically a longevity indicator; his 'bad planet in bad place is good' also parallels viparita raja yoga.

hindi: और ये हो गया नीच का एक और सात कैसे राशि राशि लगन के हिसाब से या छ नंबर लगन आ गया तो एक नंबर राशि हो जाएगी 12 नंबर आ गया तो सात नंबर राशि हो जाएगी
says: The first Saturn is the debilitated one; sign 1 lands in the 8th house when the lagna is number 6 (Virgo), and sign 7 lands in the 8th when the lagna is number 12 (Pisces).
cells_derived_method: 8th house sign = lagna + 7. Virgo (6) gives Aries (1); Pisces (12) gives Libra (7). Other lagnas put other signs in the 8th and the dignity of Saturn then changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna: Saturn debilitated in Aries sits in the 8th.
Derived: Pisces lagna: Saturn exalted in Libra sits in the 8th.

classical_check: Arithmetic is correct: Virgo 8th is Aries, Pisces 8th is Libra.

hindi: अब ये नीच का शनि है नीच का शनि ने वैसे ही इस घर को मारना चाहे कोई भी राशि हो नीच का हो गया तो और जोर से नेगेटिव
says: A debilitated Saturn wants to kill its house anyway; whichever sign, debilitation makes the negative stronger. So debilitation normally intensifies Saturn's harm.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Saturn damages the topic of the house it sits in more; the sign it is in (Aries for Saturn) is the same for every house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 7th (Libra lagna) would harden the partnership hard.
Derived: Saturn in Aries in the 4th (Capricorn lagna) would harm home peace.

classical_check: Agrees with the usual view that debilitation weakens or distorts results (ahead of cancellation).

hindi: ये शनि अगर यहां होता तो नीच फल सत्यानाश कर देता अब ये इसका नीच है नीच भंग नीच भंग हो गया क्योंकि खराब जगह बैठ गया
says: If this Saturn were in a good house its debilitation would wreck everything, but because it sits in a bad place (the 8th) the debilitation is cancelled: neecha bhanga, since a bad planet in a bad house cancels.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated malefic in 6th, 8th or 12th: cancellation (his rule). Debilitated malefic in 1, 4, 7, 10 or others: not cancelled.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna: Saturn debilitated in the 8th gets cancellation and gives raja yoga results.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 12th (Taurus lagna) is bad in a bad house and would be cancelled.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 6th (Scorpio lagna) would be cancelled.

classical_check: Differs: classically cancellation depends on dispositor or exaltation lords; malefic-in-dusthana yielding good results is the viparita raja yoga idea.

hindi: उच्च भंग राजयोग खत्म नीच भंग राजयोग शुरू क्योंकि बुरा शनि है यह यह भी बुरा शनि है यह सत्यानाश कर रहा है यह बुरा शनि
says: When an exaltation is broken the raj yoga ends, but when a debilitation is broken the raj yoga starts, because Saturn is a bad planet; both of his Saturns are bad Saturn, and the sinful nature is what makes cancellation of debilitation a raj yoga.
cells_derived_method: For a malefic in the 8th: debilitation cancelled gives raja yoga; exaltation damaged by the bad place ends the exalted result. The sign sets which case applies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna: Saturn in Aries in the 8th, bhanga gives raja yoga.
Derived: Pisces lagna: Saturn in Libra in the 8th, an exalted bad planet, ends the exaltation raja yoga by his statement.

ambiguity: The sentence appears to contradict the next one (which praises exalted Saturn in the 8th for killing death); the caption is muddled and he may mean 'exalted: raj yoga is spoiled' for good planets only.
classical_check: Silent; the ending of exaltation in the 8th conflicts with the classical idea that an exalted planet in a dusthana still gives results.

hindi: क्या कर रहा है यह मौत को मार रहा है तो यह तो उच्च हो गया यह तो लाजवाब काम कर रहा है
says: What is exalted Saturn doing in the 8th? It is killing death, so it is excellent; the 8th-house badness is destroyed by a bad planet that is also exalted.
cells_derived_method: A malefic placed in the 8th with strength removes the 8th's harm (viparita idea). Strength comes from exaltation in Libra; the topic is longevity and sudden events.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces lagna: Saturn exalted in the 8th protects against sudden harm and gives longevity.

ambiguity: Second Saturn is taken to be the exalted one in sign 7 (Libra) from the preceding lines.
classical_check: Parallels viparita raja yoga and the classical rule that Saturn in the 8th gives long life.

gist: '11 12 अलग राशिया है ये नीच की बात नीच भंग राजयोग सिस्टम ती आ' is garbled: roughly 'signs 11 and 12 are different; this is the debilitation-cancellation system'.

hindi: और 12 ये चार जगहो में डेंजर है सबसे डेंजर ये वाला है छह छह नंबर मोस्ट डेंजर आठ नंबर मोस्ट डेंजर 12 नंबर मोस्ट डेंजर ये तीन सबसे डेंजर
says: Of the four dangerous places (3, 6, 8 and 12), the 6th, 8th and 12th houses are the most dangerous; the three dusthanas are the worst.
cells_derived_method: The danger of a dusthana depends on its signs: the 6th (enemies, disease, debts) in a lagna with Mars signs is sharper; the 8th (crisis, death) in water signs deeper; the 12th (loss, isolation) in Pisces spiritual instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio in the 6th (Gemini lagna) gives sharp enemies and secret illness.
Derived: Cancer in the 8th (Sagittarius lagna) gives emotional crises.
Derived: Pisces in the 12th (Aries lagna) gives spiritual loss and seclusion.

ambiguity: Caption begins mid-list 'और 12 ये चार जगहों'; the first two houses are inferred from the following words. Slice says '3' later.
classical_check: Agrees: 6, 8, 12 are dusthanas (trik houses); the classical texts name 3 as a minor dusthana only in some traditions.

hindi: ये लेस डेंजर लेस डेंजर तीन नंबर तीसरा घर लेकिन डेंजर क्योंकि यह आठ में से आठवा है आठ में से आठवा
says: The 3rd house is less dangerous but still dangerous because it is the 8th from the 8th; this gives it a dusthana flavour.
cells_derived_method: Eighth from the 8th = 3rd house. Its sign depends on the lagna; effort, siblings and courage topics are touched by the crisis flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio in the 3rd (Virgo lagna) gives intense effort and sibling friction.
Derived: Gemini in the 3rd (Aries lagna) gives restless communication and sibling distance.

classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd is 8th from the 8th and is sometimes counted as a minor dusthana (upachaya, so it also grows).

gist: Reads the next question: when buying a book on a subject the questioner cannot concentrate on reading it and gets suddenly diverted.

hindi: तो इ करो तो बुध और जुपिटर का दोष है
says: For difficulty focusing on study and sudden diversion, the dosha is of Mercury and Jupiter, the learning and wisdom planets; check their condition in the chart. He gives this as an analysis hint, not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Mercury and Jupiter afflictions show in the houses they occupy or rule, mostly 4 (education), 5 (intellect), 9 (higher learning) and 2 (speech).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a troubled Mercury in Gemini in the 5th (Aquarius lagna: 3-5+1=-1, 11) would scatter attention in study.
Derived: a troubled Jupiter in Pisces in the 9th (Cancer lagna: 12-9+1=4) would blur higher study.

ambiguity: The beginning is cut off ('इ करो' read as 'do this / look at it').
classical_check: Agrees with classical Mercury (intellect) and Jupiter (wisdom) as study karakas.

hindi: पता नहीं कौन सा वक्री है इनका ग्रही वक्री कोई ना वक्री का क्लेश मुख्य क्लेश वक्री का है फिर अस्त का है फिर उसके बाद राशि का है
says: Check which of the two is retrograde; the main affliction is retrograde, then combustion, and after that the sign placement; retrogression is the strongest of the three problems in his ordering.
ambiguity: 'राशि का' is read as sign-placement problems, not 'sign number'.
classical_check: Differs: no classical text ranks the three; combust and retrograde are both known afflictions.

hindi: मान लो य नौ नंबर राशि है आपकी मान लो यह न नंबर राशि है और बृहस्पति यहां बैठा है अब बृहस्पति क्या है य हो गई तीन नंबर य है दो
says: Example setup: sign 9 (Sagittarius) is taken as one house, sign 3 (Gemini) as the lagna and sign 2 (Taurus) where Jupiter sits; Jupiter, lord of Sagittarius, is therefore the 7th lord in the 12th house.
cells_derived_method: Gemini lagna: 7th is Sagittarius (Jupiter) and 12th is Taurus. The 7th lord in the 12th puts the partner topic in the loss and bed-comfort house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini lagna: Jupiter, 7th lord, in Taurus in the 12th.

ambiguity: The caption is broken; the setup Gemini lagna with Jupiter in Taurus is reconstructed from his next lines (6th from own house, 12th house of bed).
classical_check: Arithmetic: Gemini lagna 7th is Sagittarius, 12th is Taurus; Taurus is the 6th from Sagittarius: consistent.

hindi: अब बृहस्पति अपने घर से छटा बैठा है शत्रु कारक हो गया यहां से बारवा हो गया यह सेक्स का घर होता है बेड कंफर्ट का होता है
says: Jupiter sits 6th from its own house, which makes it an enemy-like placement; it is also in the 12th house, the house of sex and bed comfort.
cells_derived_method: A lord placed 6th from its own sign (shadashtak) acts as an enemy of that house's matters; in the 12th it turns this on bed comfort and intimacy. The sign of the 12th changes the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini lagna: 7th lord Jupiter in the 12th, 6th from Sagittarius, strains marriage intimacy.
Derived: Scorpio lagna: Venus, 7th lord and lord of Taurus, in Libra in the 12th is 6th from its own sign Taurus; a similar bedroom-strain pattern.

ambiguity: 'यहां से बारहवा' is read as the 12th house from the lagna of the example.
classical_check: The 12th house as bed pleasure (shayana sukha) is classical; 6th-from-own as shadashtak enmity is standard.

hindi: तो यहां से इधर आ गया तो बेड पर लड़ेगा पति या पत्नी अपने से जो भी इसका प तो बेड प तो मरने मारने की बातें हो जाएंगी
says: With this placement the couple fight on the bed, husband or wife; the quarrels become heated, even to violent threats.
ambiguity: The last words of the sentence are broken.
classical_check: Silent; 7th lord in the 12th is classically seen as loss or distance in marriage.

hindi: और सेक्सुअल एक्टिविटी में लगेंगे तो शत्रु तो क्या होगा कुछ होएगा ही नहीं धक्के खाते रहो सारी जिंदगी कुत्ते बिल्ली की लड़ाई
says: If they try sexual activity with this enemy-like Jupiter nothing comes of it; you keep stumbling through life in a dog-and-cat fight; the marriage stays unfulfilled.
ambiguity: A claim about marital intimacy; not a medical statement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो बृहस्पति का य दोष होगा इसके घर का मालिक अपने से छटा चला गया बैड
says: This is Jupiter's dosha: the owner of the house has gone 6th from itself, which is bad.
cells_derived_method: A lord that sits 6th from its own sign is faulty; the house it owns suffers. For Jupiter, its houses are Sagittarius and Pisces, so the 6th from them are Taurus and Virgo.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter owning a house in Sagittarius sitting in Taurus: 6th from itself.
Derived: Jupiter owning Pisces and placed in Virgo is 6th from Pisces and a bad placement in the house of enemies.

classical_check: Agrees with the general principle of 6/8 relationship between a house and its lord.

hindi: यह भी छठे का योग है ऐसे ही आठवे है बैड तो यह भी करेक्शन मांगता है
says: This is a 6th-house type combination; the same applies to the 8th from the house lord, both bad and needing correction (remedy).
cells_derived_method: A lord 6th or 8th from its own sign (6/8 or 8/6 relationship) is flagged for remedy; house topic varies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna: Venus, lord of Libra, in Pisces in the 6th is 6th from its own sign, a faulty placement for self and partnership.
Derived: Capricorn lagna: Saturn, lord of Capricorn, in Leo in the 8th is 8th from its own sign, bad for self and career.

ambiguity: No remedy is named in this slice.
classical_check: Agrees: shadashtak (6/8) relation is the standard bad relation.

hindi: तो यह ना वक्री है ना अस्त है यह भी दोष है क्योंकि सातव का मालिक छठे में पड़ा अपने से
says: Even though this Jupiter is neither retrograde nor combust, it is still faulty, because the 7th lord has fallen 6th from itself.
classical_check: Agrees: a 6/8 position of a lord is a standard affliction.

gist: Reads the next question: if the lady preserves the DNA of the child, how does it work when the lady has more than one partner.

hindi: नहीं जैसे बच्चे पैदा हुए उसके अनुसार चलेगा पुरुष का तो आ ही गया लेकिन जिसके द्वारा बेटा पैदा बेटी पैदा हुई है उसके ग्रह से एक्टिवेशन होगी
says: It works according to how the children were born: the man's chart already covers his own children, but the activation for a child will come from the planets of the person through whom that son or daughter was born. This is a tradition claim about whose chart is active for each child.
cells_derived_method: Children belong to the 5th house; for each child the relevant parent's 5th house and its lord become active, and the rest stays dormant.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 5th for one parent activates Sun-based signs for the child born through that parent.
Derived: Pisces in the 5th for the other parent activates Jupiter signs for that parent's child.

ambiguity: 'जिसके द्वारा' means the biological parent; the 5th house is my inference from 'children'.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts judge children from each parent's 5th house but not by partner-wise activation.

gist: He says women are told not to have multiple sexual partners, then jokes men are rascals so telling them is useless, and says men too are told to be devoted to one wife.
He says it is a woman's request since she is the carrier and man the implanter, so a woman's character matters more.
He says beyond that there is no binding: a woman does as she feels and adjusts her own planets plus or minus, and men also suffer, say 250 men for every 100 women.
Reads the next question: party and stay on the upper chakra versus do not celebrate, which should be followed.
He says the upper-chakra teaching is about party in a witness state, and the other talk is about hope and contentment; the distinction is missed.
In witness mode everything you do is acting and the party stops entertaining you; you are in the party but unattached.
Reads the next question: he said our ancestors live on the Moon; is the Karva Chauth water offering to the Moon a request to ancestors for the husband's long life.
He says he says a lot of things, and answers yes.

hindi: जब पति के लिए वो लंग इलायची मांगती है तो वो इसीलिए क्योंकि वह भूखे पेट है सारा दिन में जल नहीं लिया है तो पितृ पूर्ण रूप से कनेक्टेड होते हैं
says: On Karva Chauth a woman prays for her husband's long life, and because she has taken no water all day the ancestors (pitar) are fully connected to her; fasting purity makes the link complete.
ambiguity: 'लंग इलायची' is 'long life' (long-elaichi pun).
classical_check: Karva Chauth is a folk vrata; the Moon-pitar link is his (shraddha ties pitrus to the Moon by tithi).

hindi: उस दिन अशुद्धि नहीं हुई है क्योंकि करवा चौथ के दिन इस प्रकार के प्लेनेटरी कॉमिनेशन हैं चंद्रमा की ऐसी पोजिशनिंग है कि उस दिन जल ना ग्रहण करके स्त्री की पुकार वहां पहुंचती है
says: On that day there is no impurity, as on Karva Chauth the planetary combination and the Moon's position are such that, without taking water, the woman's call reaches the ancestors there.
ambiguity: The exact combination is not stated; Karva Chauth is the 4th day after the full moon in Kartik (Krishna Chaturthi).
classical_check: Silent; the claim of a special combination is his.

gist: 'पहला जल उसने पुरुष की पुकार क्यों नहीं पहुचे पहुंचाने की जरूरत है उसके पास वाय है' is garbled, roughly 'why does a man's call not reach, what need does he have'.

hindi: प्रकृति ने भेदभाव किया है स्त्री को आवश्यकता है तो स्त्री पुरुष के थ्रू
says: Nature has made a distinction: since the woman has the need, the request goes through woman on the man's behalf; the ritual is assigned to the wife, who prays for the husband (the sentence stops at the end of the slice).
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the slice end.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पितरों से आशीर्वाद ले रही है सारा साइंस है लेकिन पंगा वही है लोग अपने हिसाब से समझते नहीं
says: Closing the Karva Chauth answer: the wife is taking blessings from the ancestors and he calls all of it science, but people do not understand it on its own terms, they read it their own way.
ambiguity: Refers to the Karva Chauth question in the previous chunk; 'science' is his word for an unexplained mechanism.
classical_check: Silent; Karva Chauth is a folk vrata and not described in the classical Jyotish texts.

gist: He teases a wife who asks why the husband's drama is needed: you are blessed, you will party, he will wander Paharganj lanes on a scooter while you go to a five-star.
He says those who understand the point do the ritual drama.
A questioner says these are the last two questions and that he loves this dialogue.
Question: tell us a practical route; if Jupiter has a dosha in the chart or is combust, what should we do in daily routine.

hindi: पैसे फूको उपाय करो फ्री फंड मौज करो तुम्हारा व्यवहार भी बदल देगा वो स्टोन पहनो
says: For a Jupiter dosha or combust Jupiter, spend money on remedies instead of waiting for things free, and wear the gemstone; it will change your own behaviour too. He does not name the stone here; this is a remedy claim, not financial advice.
ambiguity: The stone is not named; yellow sapphire would be the classical stone for Jupiter. The beginning of the sentence is cut.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical idea of ratna remedies, though classical texts advise gem choice by lagna lord and house position, not just by a weak Jupiter.

gist: Mimics a reluctant person who will not spend on himself because the stone is too costly and says take it after two or six months.

hindi: आप टारगेट बनाते हो ना 5 साल में मैंने मकान बनाना है तो एक साल में पत्थर बनवा लो वो मकान क्या कई बिल्डिंग में बना देगा
says: If you set a target such as building a house in five years, get the gemstone made in the first year and it will help build not one house but several buildings; the stone acts as an accelerator of outcomes. This is a tradition claim, not investment or property advice.
ambiguity: The stone is presumably for the same Jupiter in the question; he does not say so.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not promise multiplication of outcomes from gems.

hindi: अगर लिखा भाग्य में नहीं तो सुधार तो देगा
says: Even if a result is not written in your fate, the stone will at least improve your condition; a remedy cannot create destiny but can lift the present state.
ambiguity: The sentence starts with 'if it is not written in fate' and finishes in the next chunk's idea, that struggle does not end.
classical_check: Agrees with the common tradition that remedies reduce, not delete, prarabdha.

hindi: आपकी जिंदगी में संघर्ष खत्म थोड़ी होंगे चाहे आप पितरों की कृपा ले लो चाहे आप पत्थर पहन लो चाहे कुछ कर लो आपकी लाइफ एलीवेट हो जाएगी
says: Struggle will not end whether you take the ancestors' grace, wear a stone or do anything else; what remedies do is elevate your life to a higher level of comfort.
classical_check: Agrees with the tradition that remedies soften rather than remove karma.

gist: Illustrates elevation: first you fought on a scooter with a tired neck, then in a car, then in a chauffeur-driven car sitting face to face, fighting with the air conditioner on.
He says if knowledge arrives, do not fight at all; otherwise at least raise the level at which you fight.

hindi: हम तो उपाय कराएंगे पार्टी करो करने क्या आए हो धरती पे जो करना है वह जिंदगी अपने आप करेगी प्रारब्ध लिखा के लाए हो हमारी कोई टका औकात नहीं हम कुछ कर ले अपने आप हो रहा है
says: Do your remedies and enjoy life; you did not come to earth to do things, life will do what it must by itself since you arrived with your prarabdha written, and our own doing counts for nothing, as everything happens on its own.
ambiguity: Sets up a strong fatalism; it sits alongside his statement that remedies elevate life.
classical_check: Agrees with the doctrine that prarabdha karma is fixed at birth, but classical texts also hold that effort (purushartha) matters, which he downplays here.

gist: Last question: on 25 January 2025 all planets are going to come in one line; does any special yoga form.

hindi: फिर इससे कोई स्पेशल योग फॉर्म होता है कुछ नहीं होता
says: An alignment of all the planets in one line forms no special yoga: nothing happens from it.
ambiguity: The date he cites is 25 January 2025; the sentence starts with the audience's 'does it form a yoga' and he replies 'nothing happens'.
classical_check: Agrees: classical yogas depend on house, sign and lordship, not on a sky alignment of planets.

gist: He boasts that he lined up even the big planets and asks for applause, saying he will take a number in the line himself.
Starts a joke about a husband who tells his wife that everyone obeys him, even the gods, and that he gets angry otherwise.
In the joke the poor, simple wife asks how, and the couple go to the sea in the evening where the sun is setting; he tells the sun to go inside in half an hour.
The sun went down at his word and the wife called him godlike; he then said he would keep the sun inside, she asked what would become of the light, so he agreed, and after six hours it rose again.

hindi: जो हो रहा है वो हो ही रहा है यूं ही नंबर ले लो 25 तारीख को लाइन में आने हमने किए यूं ही नंबर ले लो फ्री फंड में अरे जो होना है वो होना है
says: Learn the art of seeing that what is happening is happening anyway; you can take the credit for the planet alignment on the 25th for free, but what is to be will be; the alignment is not caused or changed by anyone.
ambiguity: Moral of the sun joke; the date is the 25 January 2025 alignment from the previous question.
classical_check: Silent; fatalism of prarabdha as before.

gist: He tosses off a line about Ram and laughs; it ends the story.
Trailing remark about being unable to say it and having said it already.
He says love yourself: I must first fulfil my own worth, people say love this one and that one, he asks whom to love, just love yourself.
He says make yourself happy; if you want to please others, why would the other be happy with you.
If someone does make another happy the other says do it again; he says he himself sits with a sour face all his life.
He says stay so happy that even your lecture comes out as nonsense; flow in happiness.
He declares the class complete for today.
A student says he has one small request, and that they are not worthy to give anything to sir.
He answers give then, these are excuses for not giving; the student says they come for free knowledge and take everything.
The student suggests that whenever the class finishes they should express their happiness for sir with applause.
Applause is heard; he says he would be happy, then jokes about a fee discount and about arranging charges.
He says he knows nothing besides this; if one rises above enjoyment and insult, life is bliss.
Exchange of love-you's with the audience, joking that a longer hug would lead to love and that love almost happened one and a half seconds ago.
Closing words: very beautiful, it is the grace and kindness of the divine and of all present.
Background music only, with a stray word.
